name: TGL.AreaScale.eta_eq_one_over_two_kappa
head: theorem eta_eq_one_over_two_kappa (kappa : ℝ) : (1 / 2) / kappa = 1 / (2 * kappa) := by rw [div_div]
doc: /-- Com `S = 1/2`: `eta = S / kappa = (1/2)/kappa = 1/(2 kappa)`. -/

name: TGL.AreaScale.newtonPlanck_equivalence
head: theorem newtonPlanck_equivalence (kappa G : ℝ) (hk : 0 < kappa) (hG : 0 < G) : 2 * Real.pi / (1 / (2 * kappa)) = 8 * Real.pi * G ↔ kappa = 2 * G := by have hlhs : 2 * Real.pi / (1 / (2 * kappa)) = 4 * Real.pi * kappa := by rw [one_div, div_eq_mul_inv, inv_inv]; ring
doc: /-- Equivalencia de Newton--Planck: `2 pi / (1/(2 kappa)) = 8 pi G  ↔  kappa = 2 G`. -/

name: TGL.AreaScale.face_area_eq_G
head: theorem face_area_eq_G (kappa G : ℝ) (h : kappa = 2 * G) : kappa / 2 = G := by rw [h]; ring  /-- Sob `kappa = 2G`: `eta = (1/2)/(2G) = 1/(4G)`. -/
doc: /-- Area por face: sob `kappa = 2G`, `A_face = kappa/2 = G`. -/

name: TGL.AreaScale.halfNat_over_two_faces_eq_quarter
head: theorem halfNat_over_two_faces_eq_quarter (G : ℝ) : (1 / 2) / (2 * G) = 1 / (4 * G) := by rw [div_div]; congr 1; ring

name: TGL.ContinuousCorner.ContinuousCornerWitness
head: structure ContinuousCornerWitness where Core : Type [instRing : Ring Core] [instStar : StarRing Core]
doc: /-- Testemunha abstrata do canto continuo: core (anel com estrela), traco em `ℝ≥0∞`, projetor `P` auto-adjunto idempotente partido em duas faces ortogonais de traco igual, com `trace P` positivo e finito. As HIPOTESES sao CAMPOS -- nunca axiomas globais. -/

name: TGL.ContinuousCorner.ContinuousCornerWitness.normalizedTrace
head: noncomputable def normalizedTrace (X : W.Core) : ENNReal := W.trace X / W.trace W.P  /-- `normalizedTrace(P) = 1` (traco de `P` sobre traco de `P`, positivo e finito). -/ theorem normalizedTrace_P_eq_one : W.normalizedTrace W.P = 1 := by
doc: /-- Traco normalizado: `trace X / trace P`. -/

name: TGL.ContinuousCorner.ContinuousCornerWitness.normalizedTrace_P_eq_one
head: theorem normalizedTrace_P_eq_one : W.normalizedTrace W.P = 1 := by unfold normalizedTrace exact ENNReal.div_self W.trace_P_pos.ne' W.trace_P_finite.ne
doc: /-- `normalizedTrace(P) = 1` (traco de `P` sobre traco de `P`, positivo e finito). -/

name: TGL.ContinuousCorner.ContinuousCornerWitness.enn_self_div_two_self
head: private theorem enn_self_div_two_self (a : ENNReal) (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (hat : a ≠ ⊤) : a / (2 * a) = 1 / 2 := by have h2 : (2 : ENNReal) ≠ 0 := by norm_num have h2t : (2 : ENNReal) ≠ ⊤ := by norm_num
doc: /-- Fato auxiliar em `ℝ≥0∞`: `a/(2a) = 1/2` para `a ≠ 0`, `a ≠ ⊤`. -/

name: TGL.ContinuousCorner.ContinuousCornerWitness.equalFaces_normalizedTrace_half
head: theorem equalFaces_normalizedTrace_half : W.normalizedTrace W.Pplus = 1 / 2 ∧ W.normalizedTrace W.Pminus = 1 / 2 := by have hsum_top : W.trace W.Pplus + W.trace W.Pminus < ⊤ := by rw [← W.trace_additive_on_split]; exact W.trace_P_finite
doc: /-- As duas faces conjugadas tem traco normalizado `1/2`. -/

name: TGL.CoreSupport.support_annihilates
head: theorem support_annihilates (q : A) (hq2 : q * q = q) : q * (1 - q) = 0 := by rw [mul_sub, mul_one, hq2, sub_self]  /-- [KERNEL] O representante minimo e' auto-adjunto. -/
doc: /-- [KERNEL] O suporte aniquila o representante minimo: `q·(1−q) = 0`. -/

name: TGL.CoreSupport.hmin_selfadjoint
head: theorem hmin_selfadjoint (q : A) (hqs : star q = q) : star (1 - q : A) = 1 - q := by rw [star_sub, star_one, hqs]  /-- [KERNEL] MAXIMALIDADE: toda projecao que anula `1−q` esta' sob `q`
doc: /-- [KERNEL] O representante minimo e' auto-adjunto. -/

name: TGL.CoreSupport.support_maximal
head: theorem support_maximal (q r : A) (hr : r * (1 - q) = 0) : r * q = r := by rw [mul_sub, mul_one, sub_eq_zero] at hr exact hr.symm
doc: /-- [KERNEL] MAXIMALIDADE: toda projecao que anula `1−q` esta' sob `q` (`r·(1−q)=0 ⟹ r·q = r`) -- `q` E' a projecao espectral do zero, na forma enunciavel. -/

name: TGL.CoreSupport.threeLocksFromSupport
head: noncomputable def threeLocksFromSupport {W : TGLSpecificAQFTWitness} {D : WedgeModularData W} (C : ContinuousCoreData W D) (q qp qm : C.Core) (hq2 : q * q = q) (hqs : star q = q) (hqne : q ≠ 0)
doc: /-- [KERNEL — v32, o CONSTRUTOR do fechamento] Dado o core (DADOS) e um SUPORTE `q_F` (projecao nao-nula de traco 1, partida em duas faces ortogonais de traco igual), os Three Locks sao HABITAVEIS com o representante minimo `H₃L = 1 − q_F`. As hipoteses sao exatamente o que os teoremas EXTERNOS [KNOWN: BW + Takesaki + II∞ difuso] fornecem -- o gap esta' TIPADO. -/

name: TGL.CoreSupport.realizationFromSupport
head: noncomputable def realizationFromSupport {W : TGLSpecificAQFTWitness} (hinf : ¬ FiniteDimensional ℂ W.H) (D : WedgeModularData W) (C : ContinuousCoreData W D) (q qp qm : C.Core)
doc: /-- [KERNEL] O empacotamento: com dimensao infinita + camadas + suporte, a REALIZACAO MODULAR e' habitavel. O habitante pleno reduz-se a QUATRO entradas [KNOWN-COMPOSED]: W, D, C, q_F. -/

name: TGL.CoreSupport.nameGaugeEquiv
head: def nameGaugeEquiv (T1 T2 : JonesTowerData N M Ext) : Prop := T1.markovWeight = T2.markovWeight ∧ T1.indexVal = T2.indexVal  theorem nameGaugeEquiv_refl (T : JonesTowerData N M Ext) : nameGaugeEquiv T T :=
doc: /-- [DEF/AX] Nome-equivalencia: mesmo peso de Markov e mesmo indice. O objeto fisico e' a CLASSE; o representante e' gauge. -/

name: TGL.CoreSupport.nameGaugeEquiv_refl
head: theorem nameGaugeEquiv_refl (T : JonesTowerData N M Ext) : nameGaugeEquiv T T := ⟨rfl, rfl⟩  theorem nameGaugeEquiv_symm {T1 T2 : JonesTowerData N M Ext}

name: TGL.CoreSupport.nameGaugeEquiv_symm
head: theorem nameGaugeEquiv_symm {T1 T2 : JonesTowerData N M Ext} (h : nameGaugeEquiv T1 T2) : nameGaugeEquiv T2 T1 := ⟨h.1.symm, h.2.symm⟩

name: TGL.CoreSupport.nameGaugeEquiv_trans
head: theorem nameGaugeEquiv_trans {T1 T2 T3 : JonesTowerData N M Ext} (h12 : nameGaugeEquiv T1 T2) (h23 : nameGaugeEquiv T2 T3) : nameGaugeEquiv T1 T3 := ⟨h12.1.trans h23.1, h12.2.trans h23.2⟩

name: TGL.CoreSupport.transport_defect_gauge_invariant
head: theorem transport_defect_gauge_invariant {T1 T2 : JonesTowerData N M Ext} (h : nameGaugeEquiv T1 T2) : transportDefect T1.upper T1.eJones = transportDefect T2.upper T2.eJones := by rw [transport_defect_of_jones, transport_defect_of_jones, h.1]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] O DEFEITO DE TRANSPORTE e' invariante de gauge do Nome: torres Nome-equivalentes tem o mesmo defeito `β(1−β)·1`. O contraste e' fisico; o representante nao e'. -/

name: TGL.FiniteThreeLocks.H3L
head: noncomputable def H3L : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n) →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n) := LinearMap.adjoint Dc ∘ₗ Dc + LinearMap.adjoint Db ∘ₗ Db + LinearMap.adjoint Dz ∘ₗ Dz  /-- Cada `D^* D` e' auto-adjunto. -/
doc: /-- O operador dos Three Locks: soma de tres `D_i^* D_i`. -/

name: TGL.FiniteThreeLocks.isSelfAdjoint_adjoint_comp_self
head: theorem isSelfAdjoint_adjoint_comp_self (D : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n) →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) : IsSelfAdjoint (LinearMap.adjoint D ∘ₗ D) := by rw [IsSelfAdjoint, LinearMap.star_eq_adjoint, LinearMap.adjoint_comp,
doc: /-- Cada `D^* D` e' auto-adjunto. -/

name: TGL.FiniteThreeLocks.H3L_isSelfAdjoint
head: theorem H3L_isSelfAdjoint : IsSelfAdjoint (H3L Dc Db Dz) := by unfold H3L exact ((isSelfAdjoint_adjoint_comp_self Dc).add (isSelfAdjoint_adjoint_comp_self Db)).add
doc: /-- `H3L` e' auto-adjunto. -/

name: TGL.FiniteThreeLocks.H3L_quadratic_form
head: theorem H3L_quadratic_form (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) : RCLike.re (inner ℂ x (H3L Dc Db Dz x)) = ‖Dc x‖ ^ 2 + ‖Db x‖ ^ 2 + ‖Dz x‖ ^ 2 := by unfold H3L
doc: /-- Forma quadratica: `⟪x, H3L x⟫ = ‖Dc x‖² + ‖Db x‖² + ‖Dz x‖²`. -/

name: TGL.FiniteThreeLocks.H3L_posSemidefinite
head: theorem H3L_posSemidefinite (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) : 0 ≤ RCLike.re (inner ℂ x (H3L Dc Db Dz x)) := by rw [H3L_quadratic_form] positivity
doc: /-- `H3L` e' positivo semidefinido: `Re ⟪x, H3L x⟫ ≥ 0`. -/

name: TGL.FiniteThreeLocks.mem_ker_H3L_iff
head: theorem mem_ker_H3L_iff (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) : x ∈ LinearMap.ker (H3L Dc Db Dz) ↔ Dc x = 0 ∧ Db x = 0 ∧ Dz x = 0 := by constructor · intro hx
doc: /-- `x ∈ ker H3L ↔ Dc x = 0 ∧ Db x = 0 ∧ Dz x = 0`. -/

name: TGL.FiniteThreeLocks.ker_H3L_eq_threeLocks
head: theorem ker_H3L_eq_threeLocks : LinearMap.ker (H3L Dc Db Dz) = LinearMap.ker Dc ⊓ LinearMap.ker Db ⊓ LinearMap.ker Dz := by ext x
doc: /-- `ker H3L = ker Dc ⊓ ker Db ⊓ ker Dz` (a interseccao dos Three Locks). -/

name: TGL.FiniteThreeLocks.PF
head: noncomputable def PF : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n) →L[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n) := (LinearMap.ker (H3L Dc Db Dz)).starProjection  /-- `P_F` e' idempotente: `P_F ∘ P_F = P_F`. -/
doc: /-- Projetor ortogonal sobre `ker H3L` -- o canto dos Three Locks. (`Submodule.starProjection` e' a projecao ortogonal como endomorfismo.) -/

name: TGL.FiniteThreeLocks.PF_isProjection
head: theorem PF_isProjection : IsIdempotentElem (PF Dc Db Dz) := Submodule.isIdempotentElem_starProjection _  /-- A imagem de `P_F` esta no canto: `P_F x ∈ ker H3L`. -/
doc: /-- `P_F` e' idempotente: `P_F ∘ P_F = P_F`. -/

name: TGL.FiniteThreeLocks.PF_apply_mem
head: theorem PF_apply_mem (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) : PF Dc Db Dz x ∈ LinearMap.ker (H3L Dc Db Dz) := Submodule.starProjection_apply_mem _ x
doc: /-- A imagem de `P_F` esta no canto: `P_F x ∈ ker H3L`. -/

name: TGL.FiniteThreeLocks.PF_isSelfAdjoint
head: theorem PF_isSelfAdjoint (u v : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) : inner ℂ (PF Dc Db Dz u) v = inner ℂ u (PF Dc Db Dz v) := Submodule.inner_starProjection_left_eq_right _ u v
doc: /-- `P_F` e' auto-adjunto: `⟪P_F u, v⟫ = ⟪u, P_F v⟫`. -/

name: TGL.FiniteThreeLocks.PF_eq_self_iff
head: theorem PF_eq_self_iff (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) : PF Dc Db Dz v = v ↔ v ∈ LinearMap.ker (H3L Dc Db Dz) := Submodule.starProjection_eq_self_iff
doc: /-- `P_F` fixa exatamente o canto: `P_F v = v ↔ v ∈ ker H3L`. -/

name: TGL.FiniteThreeLocks.cornerDim
head: noncomputable def cornerDim : ℕ := Module.finrank ℂ (LinearMap.ker (H3L Dc Db Dz))  /-- `tau_F(P_F) = 1`: `Tr_F(P_F) = dim F`, logo `dim F / dim F = 1` (canto nao-trivial). -/ theorem normalizedCornerTrace_PF (h : 0 < cornerDim Dc Db Dz) :
doc: /-- Dimensao do canto (nucleo de `H3L`). -/

name: TGL.FiniteThreeLocks.normalizedCornerTrace_PF
head: theorem normalizedCornerTrace_PF (h : 0 < cornerDim Dc Db Dz) : (cornerDim Dc Db Dz : ℝ) / (cornerDim Dc Db Dz : ℝ) = 1 := by have hne : (cornerDim Dc Db Dz : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast h.ne' exact div_self hne
doc: /-- `tau_F(P_F) = 1`: `Tr_F(P_F) = dim F`, logo `dim F / dim F = 1` (canto nao-trivial). -/

name: TGL.FiniteThreeLocks.equalConjugateFaces_halfTrace
head: theorem equalConjugateFaces_halfTrace (dplus dminus : ℕ) (hsplit : dplus + dminus = cornerDim Dc Db Dz) (heq : dplus = dminus) (hpos : 0 < cornerDim Dc Db Dz) :
doc: /-- Faces conjugadas iguais tem traco normalizado `1/2`. -/

name: TGL.GravitonShadow.ptr
head: noncomputable def ptr (X : Matrix (Fin 2 × Fin 2) (Fin 2 × Fin 2) ℂ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ := Matrix.of fun i j => ∑ k : Fin 2, X (i, k) (j, k)
doc: /-- Traco parcial sobre o segundo fator: `ptr(X) i j = Σ_k X (i,k) (j,k)`. -/

name: TGL.GravitonShadow.bellProjector
head: noncomputable def bellProjector : Matrix (Fin 2 × Fin 2) (Fin 2 × Fin 2) ℂ := Matrix.of fun p q => if p.1 = p.2 ∧ q.1 = q.2 then (2⁻¹ : ℂ) else 0  /-- O projetor do estado PRODUTO `|e₀⊗e₀⟩⟨e₀⊗e₀|` (o controle nao-ligado). -/
doc: /-- O projetor de BELL: `|G⟩⟨G|` com `|G⟩ = (e₀₀ + e₁₁)/√2` -- entradas RACIONAIS `½` nos pares diagonais (sem raizes: o projetor E' o estado, operacionalmente). -/

name: TGL.GravitonShadow.productProjector
head: noncomputable def productProjector : Matrix (Fin 2 × Fin 2) (Fin 2 × Fin 2) ℂ := Matrix.of fun p q => if p = (0, 0) ∧ q = (0, 0) then (1 : ℂ) else 0  /-- `|e₀⟩⟨e₀|` em `M₂` (a reducao do produto). -/
doc: /-- O projetor do estado PRODUTO `|e₀⊗e₀⟩⟨e₀⊗e₀|` (o controle nao-ligado). -/

name: TGL.GravitonShadow.e00
head: noncomputable def e00 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ := Matrix.of fun i j => if i = 0 ∧ j = 0 then (1 : ℂ) else 0  /-- [KERNEL] O projetor de Bell e' idempotente. -/
doc: /-- `|e₀⟩⟨e₀|` em `M₂` (a reducao do produto). -/

name: TGL.GravitonShadow.bell_idem
head: theorem bell_idem : bellProjector * bellProjector = bellProjector := by ext p q rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type] simp only [bellProjector, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] O projetor de Bell e' idempotente. -/

name: TGL.GravitonShadow.bell_star
head: theorem bell_star : star bellProjector = bellProjector := by ext p q rw [Matrix.star_apply] show star (bellProjector q p) = bellProjector p q
doc: /-- [KERNEL] O projetor de Bell e' auto-adjunto. -/

name: TGL.GravitonShadow.bell_trace_one
head: theorem bell_trace_one : Matrix.trace bellProjector = 1 := by simp [Matrix.trace, bellProjector, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Matrix.diag]  /-- [KERNEL] A reducao do Bell e' `I/2` — maximamente misturada. -/
doc: /-- [KERNEL] `Tr(P_G) = 1` — a forma tracial de `ω(I)=1` no canto do graviton. -/

name: TGL.GravitonShadow.bell_reduced_half
head: theorem bell_reduced_half : ptr bellProjector = (2⁻¹ : ℂ) • 1 := by ext i j simp only [ptr, bellProjector, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] A reducao do Bell e' `I/2` — maximamente misturada. -/

name: TGL.GravitonShadow.bell_cci_half
head: theorem bell_cci_half : 1 - Matrix.trace (ptr bellProjector * ptr bellProjector) = 2⁻¹ := by rw [bell_reduced_half, smul_mul_smul_comm, one_mul] rw [Matrix.trace_smul, Matrix.trace_one]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] `CCI(Bell) = 1 − Tr(ρ²) = ½` — a MEIA-NAT de emaranhamento. -/

name: TGL.GravitonShadow.bell_corner_unit
head: theorem bell_corner_unit (y : Matrix (Fin 2 × Fin 2) (Fin 2 × Fin 2) ℂ) : bellProjector * (bellProjector * y * bellProjector) = bellProjector * y * bellProjector ∧ (bellProjector * y * bellProjector) * bellProjector = bellProjector * y * bellProjector := by constructor
doc: /-- [KERNEL] `P_G` e' a UNIDADE do proprio canto (`I_F = P_G`): o graviton nao e' a identidade global — e' a identidade do lugar que ele mesmo abre. -/

name: TGL.GravitonShadow.product_reduced_pure
head: theorem product_reduced_pure : ptr productProjector = e00 := by ext i j simp only [ptr, productProjector, e00, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Prod.ext_iff] fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp
doc: /-- [KERNEL — o CONTROLE] A reducao do estado PRODUTO e' pura (`|e₀⟩⟨e₀|`). -/

name: TGL.GravitonShadow.product_cci_zero
head: theorem product_cci_zero : 1 - Matrix.trace (ptr productProjector * ptr productProjector) = 0 := by rw [product_reduced_pure] have h2 : e00 * e00 = e00 := by
doc: /-- [KERNEL — o CONTROLE] `CCI(produto) = 0`: o produto simples NAO liga. So' o estado de troca da' a Meia-Nat — a correcao do operador, agora teorema. -/

name: TGL.GravitonShadow.GravitonShadowWitness
head: structure GravitonShadowWitness where PG : Matrix (Fin 2 × Fin 2) (Fin 2 × Fin 2) ℂ idem : PG * PG = PG selfadj : star PG = PG
doc: /-- A testemunha-sombra do graviton: o conteudo (o projetor de Bell) carregando as provas de que realiza a forma gravitonica finita. -/

name: TGL.GravitonShadow.canonicalGravitonShadow
head: noncomputable def canonicalGravitonShadow : GravitonShadowWitness where PG := bellProjector idem := bell_idem selfadj := bell_star
doc: /-- [KERNEL] O TERMO — o SEGUNDO habitante construido do programa. -/

name: TGL.GravitonShadow.canonicalGravitonShadow_exists
head: theorem canonicalGravitonShadow_exists : Nonempty GravitonShadowWitness := ⟨canonicalGravitonShadow⟩  end TGL.GravitonShadow
doc: /-- O corolario existencial — SOMENTE via `⟨termo⟩`. -/

name: TGL.HalfNat.halfNat_of_selfConjugate
head: theorem halfNat_of_selfConjugate (x : ℝ) (h : x = 1 - x) : x = 1 / 2 := by linarith  /-- Caracterizacao: `x = 1 - x ↔ x = 1/2`. -/
doc: /-- A fronteira auto-conjugada `x = 1 - x` tem unico ponto fixo `x = 1/2`. -/

name: TGL.HalfNat.selfConjugate_halfNat_unique
head: theorem selfConjugate_halfNat_unique (x : ℝ) : x = 1 - x ↔ x = 1 / 2 := by constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith  end TGL.HalfNat
doc: /-- Caracterizacao: `x = 1 - x ↔ x = 1/2`. -/

name: TGL.HalfNatFresnel.fresnel_selfConjugate_half
head: theorem fresnel_selfConjugate_half (R T : ℝ) (hlossless : R + T = 1) (hparity : R = T) : R = 1 / 2 ∧ T = 1 / 2 := by constructor <;> linarith
doc: /-- Fresnel auto-conjugado: sem perdas + paridade ⟹ pesos `1/2`. -/

name: TGL.HalfNatFresnel.modular_action_halfNat
head: theorem modular_action_halfNat (faceWeight totalAction : ℝ) (hface : faceWeight = 1 / 2) (htotal : totalAction = 1) : faceWeight * totalAction = 1 / 2 := by simp [hface, htotal]
doc: /-- Calibracao da Meia-Nat: peso de face `1/2` sobre acao total normalizada a `1` da' acao de face `1/2` nat. CONDICIONAL a `totalAction = 1` [NORM]. -/

name: TGL.HalfNatJonesTower.Nc
head: abbrev Nc := ℂ abbrev Md := Fin 2 → ℂ abbrev Ex := Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ

name: TGL.HalfNatJonesTower.Md
head: abbrev Md := Fin 2 → ℂ abbrev Ex := Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ  /-- Inclusao constante `ℂ → ℂ²`. -/

name: TGL.HalfNatJonesTower.Ex
head: abbrev Ex := Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ  /-- Inclusao constante `ℂ → ℂ²`. -/ noncomputable def constIncl : Nc →⋆ₐ[ℂ] Md where

name: TGL.HalfNatJonesTower.constIncl
head: noncomputable def constIncl : Nc →⋆ₐ[ℂ] Md where toFun c := Function.const _ c map_one' := rfl map_mul' _ _ := rfl
doc: /-- Inclusao constante `ℂ → ℂ²`. -/

name: TGL.HalfNatJonesTower.E0
head: noncomputable def E0 : Md →ₗ[ℂ] Nc where toFun f := (2⁻¹ : ℂ) * (f 0 + f 1) map_add' f g := by simp; ring map_smul' c f := by simp; ring
doc: /-- Esperanca inferior `E₀(f) = (f 0 + f 1)/2` (a media das duas faces). -/

name: TGL.HalfNatJonesTower.lowerCE
head: noncomputable def lowerCE : ConditionalExpectationData Nc Md where incl := constIncl incl_injective := fun a b h => congrFun h 0 E := E0
doc: /-- Camada inferior: `ℂ ⊆ ℂ²` com a esperanca da media. -/

name: TGL.HalfNatJonesTower.diagIncl
head: noncomputable def diagIncl : Md →⋆ₐ[ℂ] Ex where toFun := Matrix.diagonal map_one' := Matrix.diagonal_one map_mul' f g := (Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal f g).symm
doc: /-- Inclusao diagonal `ℂ² → M₂`. -/

name: TGL.HalfNatJonesTower.E1
head: noncomputable def E1 : Ex →ₗ[ℂ] Md where toFun x i := x i i map_add' _ _ := rfl map_smul' _ _ := rfl
doc: /-- Esperanca superior `E₁(x) = diagonal de x` (compressao ao referencial). -/

name: TGL.HalfNatJonesTower.upperCE
head: noncomputable def upperCE : ConditionalExpectationData Md Ex where incl := diagIncl incl_injective := fun f g h => funext fun i => by have := congrArg (fun m => m i i) h
doc: /-- Camada superior: `ℂ² ⊆ M₂` com a compressao diagonal. -/

name: TGL.HalfNatJonesTower.eHalf
head: noncomputable def eHalf : Ex := Matrix.of fun _ _ => (2⁻¹ : ℂ)  theorem eHalf_idem : eHalf * eHalf = eHalf := by ext i j
doc: /-- O ESPELHO da Meia-Nat: `e = (1/2)·[[1,1],[1,1]]` (o vetor uniforme). -/

name: TGL.HalfNatJonesTower.eHalf_idem
head: theorem eHalf_idem : eHalf * eHalf = eHalf := by ext i j rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] show (2⁻¹ : ℂ) * 2⁻¹ + 2⁻¹ * 2⁻¹ = 2⁻¹

name: TGL.HalfNatJonesTower.eHalf_star
head: theorem eHalf_star : star eHalf = eHalf := by ext i j show star ((2⁻¹ : ℂ)) = (2⁻¹ : ℂ) simp [star_inv₀]

name: TGL.SpecificAQFT.minkowskiSq
head: def minkowskiSq (v : Fin 4 → ℝ) : ℝ := v 0 ^ 2 - v 1 ^ 2 - v 2 ^ 2 - v 3 ^ 2  /-- Separacao tipo-espaco entre regioes: todo par de pontos e' spacelike. -/
doc: /-- Forma quadratica de Minkowski em `ℝ^{1,3}`, assinatura `(+,-,-,-)`. [DATA/geometria] -/

name: TGL.SpecificAQFT.SpacelikeSep
head: def SpacelikeSep (O₁ O₂ : Set (Fin 4 → ℝ)) : Prop := ∀ x ∈ O₁, ∀ y ∈ O₂, minkowskiSq (x - y) < 0  /-- Cunha direita de Rindler: `|x⁰| < x¹`. -/
doc: /-- Separacao tipo-espaco entre regioes: todo par de pontos e' spacelike. -/

name: TGL.SpecificAQFT.rightWedge
head: def rightWedge : Set (Fin 4 → ℝ) := {x | |x 0| < x 1}  /-- Cunha esquerda: `|x⁰| < -x¹` (reflexao da direita). -/ def leftWedge : Set (Fin 4 → ℝ) := {x | |x 0| < -(x 1)}
doc: /-- Cunha direita de Rindler: `|x⁰| < x¹`. -/

name: TGL.SpecificAQFT.leftWedge
head: def leftWedge : Set (Fin 4 → ℝ) := {x | |x 0| < -(x 1)}  /-- Translacao de uma regiao por `a`. -/ def translate (a : Fin 4 → ℝ) (O : Set (Fin 4 → ℝ)) : Set (Fin 4 → ℝ) :=
doc: /-- Cunha esquerda: `|x⁰| < -x¹` (reflexao da direita). -/

name: TGL.SpecificAQFT.translate
head: def translate (a : Fin 4 → ℝ) (O : Set (Fin 4 → ℝ)) : Set (Fin 4 → ℝ) := (fun x => x + a) '' O  /-- [KERNEL, incondicional] As duas cunhas sao tipo-espaco separadas -- geometria
doc: /-- Translacao de uma regiao por `a`. -/

name: TGL.SpecificAQFT.wedges_spacelike
head: theorem wedges_spacelike : SpacelikeSep rightWedge leftWedge := by intro x hx y hy simp only [rightWedge, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hx simp only [leftWedge, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hy
doc: /-- [KERNEL, incondicional] As duas cunhas sao tipo-espaco separadas -- geometria de Minkowski provada pelo kernel, nao assumida. -/

name: TGL.SpecificAQFT.TGLSpecificAQFTWitness
head: structure TGLSpecificAQFTWitness where -- [DATA] o conteudo fisico-matematico concreto /-- massa do campo escalar livre (dado fisico do modelo v21-A) -/ m : ℝ
doc: /-- A testemunha AQFT especifica RIGIDA: o conteudo (rede de von Neumann sobre `ℝ^{1,3}`, vacuo, translacoes, massa) acompanhado das provas de que ele realiza a forma. NENHUMA instancia e' construida em v23. -/

name: TGL.SpecificAQFT.wedge_locality
head: theorem wedge_locality (W : TGLSpecificAQFTWitness) : ∀ a ∈ W.net rightWedge, ∀ b ∈ W.net leftWedge, Commute a b := fun a ha b hb => W.locality rightWedge leftWedge wedges_spacelike a ha b hb
doc: /-- [KERNEL, condicional a `W` -- e aqui `W` e' USADO de verdade] Localidade das cunhas: toda observavel da cunha direita comuta com toda da esquerda, pela localidade de `W` aplicada ao teorema geometrico `wedges_spacelike`. -/

name: TGL.TransportData.ConditionalExpectationData
head: structure ConditionalExpectationData (M Ext : Type) [Ring M] [StarRing M] [Algebra ℂ M] [Ring Ext] [StarRing Ext] [Algebra ℂ Ext] where incl : M →⋆ₐ[ℂ] Ext
doc: /-- Esperanca condicional FIEL como DADOS + equacoes (Tomiyama): inclusao *-algebrica injetiva, retracao linear unital, estrela-equivariante, bimodular sobre a imagem, e FIEL (`E(x*x)=0 ⟹ x=0`). A normalidade fica no ledger externo (nao-enunciavel aqui); a descida so' precisa da fidelidade. -/

name: TGL.TransportData.transported
head: def transported (D : ConditionalExpectationData M Ext) (p : Ext) : M := D.E p  /-- O DEFEITO DE TRANSPORTE (a resistencia): `Δ = E(p) − E(p)²`. -/ def transportDefect (D : ConditionalExpectationData M Ext) (p : Ext) : M :=
doc: /-- A imagem transportada do seletor: `A_F = E(p)` (o que desce ao core). -/

name: TGL.TransportData.transportDefect
head: def transportDefect (D : ConditionalExpectationData M Ext) (p : Ext) : M := D.E p - D.E p * D.E p  /-- A esperanca retrai a inclusao: `E(ι a) = a` (derivada da bimodularidade). -/
doc: /-- O DEFEITO DE TRANSPORTE (a resistencia): `Δ = E(p) − E(p)²`. -/

name: TGL.TransportData.E_retract
head: theorem E_retract (D : ConditionalExpectationData M Ext) (a : M) : D.E (D.incl a) = a := by have h := D.E_bimodular a 1 1 simpa [D.E_unital] using h
doc: /-- A esperanca retrai a inclusao: `E(ι a) = a` (derivada da bimodularidade). -/

name: TGL.TransportData.descent_iff_defect_zero
head: theorem descent_iff_defect_zero (D : ConditionalExpectationData M Ext) (p : Ext) (hp2 : p * p = p) (hps : star p = p) : transportDefect D p = 0 ↔ p = D.incl (D.E p) := by unfold transportDefect
doc: /-- [KERNEL -- teorema da descida do seletor, rodada 2 do especialista] Para `E` fiel e `p` projecao: `Δ = 0 ⟺ p desce` (`p = ι(E p)`). A resistencia e' exatamente a distancia operatorial entre o seletor superior e sua descida. -/

name: TGL.TransportData.JonesTowerData
head: structure JonesTowerData (N M Ext : Type) [Ring N] [StarRing N] [Algebra ℂ N] [Ring M] [StarRing M] [Algebra ℂ M] [Ring Ext] [StarRing Ext] [Algebra ℂ Ext] where
doc: /-- Dados da torre de Jones-Markov: a esperanca inferior `E₀ : M → N` (implementada pela projecao de Jones `e`: `e·x·e = ι(E₀ x)·e`) e a esperanca DUAL `E₁ : Ext → M` que transporta o seletor de volta, com o peso de Markov `E₁(e) = β·1`. O peso `β` entra como VARIAVEL REAL (nunca literal; o valor de runtime e' do um.py), com `indice · peso = 1`. -/

name: TGL.TransportData.transport_defect_of_jones
head: theorem transport_defect_of_jones (T : JonesTowerData N M Ext) : transportDefect T.upper T.eJones = ((T.markovWeight : ℂ) * (1 - (T.markovWeight : ℂ))) • (1 : M) := by unfold transportDefect
doc: /-- [KERNEL -- a correcao fiscal do especialista, encodada] O peso transportado e' `β` (`E₁(e) = β·1`) e o DEFEITO de multiplicatividade e' `β(1−β)·1`: β NAO e' o defeito; e' o peso que atravessa. -/

name: TGL.TransportData.jones_defect_ne_zero
head: theorem jones_defect_ne_zero (T : JonesTowerData N M Ext) [Nontrivial M] : transportDefect T.upper T.eJones ≠ 0 := by rw [transport_defect_of_jones] have hb0 : (T.markovWeight : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
doc: /-- [KERNEL] `selector_lives_upstairs` como TEOREMA (condicional aos dados): com `0 < β < 1` e `M` nao-trivial, o defeito e' NAO-nulo. -/

name: TGL.TransportData.jones_selector_not_descended
head: theorem jones_selector_not_descended (T : JonesTowerData N M Ext) [Nontrivial M] : T.eJones ≠ T.upper.incl (T.upper.E T.eJones) := by intro h exact jones_defect_ne_zero T
doc: /-- [KERNEL] O seletor de Jones NAO desce: `e ≠ ι(E₁ e)`. O contraste nasce porque a passagem nao e' multiplicativa: a porta nao apenas impede -- ela mede. -/

name: TGL.TransportData.facePlus
head: noncomputable def facePlus (P U : A) : A := (2⁻¹ : ℂ) • (P + U)  noncomputable def faceMinus (P U : A) : A := (2⁻¹ : ℂ) • (P - U)
doc: /-- As duas faces do canto, geradas pelo elemento de troca. -/

name: TGL.TransportData.faceMinus
head: noncomputable def faceMinus (P U : A) : A := (2⁻¹ : ℂ) • (P - U)  /-- [KERNEL] `P_+` e' idempotente. -/ theorem facePlus_idem (P U : A) (hP2 : P * P = P) (hU2 : U * U = P)

name: TGL.TransportData.facePlus_idem
head: theorem facePlus_idem (P U : A) (hP2 : P * P = P) (hU2 : U * U = P) (hPU : P * U = U) (hUP : U * P = U) : facePlus P U * facePlus P U = facePlus P U := by unfold facePlus
doc: /-- [KERNEL] `P_+` e' idempotente. -/

name: TGL.TransportData.faceMinus_idem
head: theorem faceMinus_idem (P U : A) (hP2 : P * P = P) (hU2 : U * U = P) (hPU : P * U = U) (hUP : U * P = U) : faceMinus P U * faceMinus P U = faceMinus P U := by unfold faceMinus
doc: /-- [KERNEL] `P_−` e' idempotente. -/

name: TGL.TransportData.faces_orthogonal
head: theorem faces_orthogonal (P U : A) (hP2 : P * P = P) (hU2 : U * U = P) (hPU : P * U = U) (hUP : U * P = U) : facePlus P U * faceMinus P U = 0 := by unfold facePlus faceMinus
doc: /-- [KERNEL] As faces sao ortogonais. -/

name: TGL.TransportData.faces_sum
head: theorem faces_sum (P U : A) : facePlus P U + faceMinus P U = P := by unfold facePlus faceMinus module
doc: /-- [KERNEL] As faces somam o canto: `P_+ + P_− = P`. -/

name: TGL.TransportData.faces_selfAdjoint
head: theorem faces_selfAdjoint [StarModule ℂ A] (P U : A) (hPs : star P = P) (hUs : star U = U) : star (facePlus P U) = facePlus P U ∧ star (faceMinus P U) = faceMinus P U := by constructor · simp [facePlus, star_smul, star_add, hPs, hUs, star_inv₀]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] As faces sao auto-adjuntas (dados `P* = P`, `U* = U`). -/

name: TGL.VerbInhabitant.exp_fixed_of_annihilates
head: theorem exp_fixed_of_annihilates {A : Type} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℂ A] [CompleteSpace A] (a p : A) (h : a * p = 0) : NormedSpace.exp a * p = p := by have hpow : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≠ 0 → a ^ n * p = 0 := by
doc: /-- [KERNEL/UNCONDITIONAL] O teorema do Verbo (forma de Banach): se o gerador anula `p` (`a * p = 0`), a acao gerada fixa `p`: `exp(a) * p = p`. E' o `e^0 = 1` operatorial: `0_mod` (gerador) → `1_abs` (acao). -/

name: TGL.VerbInhabitant.verb_semigroup_fixes
head: theorem verb_semigroup_fixes {A : Type} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℂ A] [CompleteSpace A] (H p : A) (h : H * p = 0) (c : ℂ) : NormedSpace.exp (c • H) * p = p := exp_fixed_of_annihilates (c • H) p (by rw [smul_mul_assoc, h, smul_zero])
doc: /-- [KERNEL/UNCONDITIONAL] O semigrupo do Verbo fixa o selecionado: para qualquer coeficiente `c` (em runtime, `c = −t·β` com `β = α√e` -- variavel aqui, nunca literal), `H·p = 0 ⟹ exp(c•H)·p = p`. -/

name: TGL.VerbInhabitant.VerbWitness
head: structure VerbWitness {W : TGLSpecificAQFTWitness} (R : TGLModularRealization W) where verb : R.core.Core /-- VERBO = NOME: o ato comprimido e' a unidade do canto -/ verb_equals_name : verb = R.threeLocks.PF
doc: /-- A testemunha do VERBO sobre uma realizacao modular: o ato comprimido no canto, carregando as provas de que o Verbo e' o Nome (`verb = P_F = I_F`), de que anula os Locks, e de que a resposta observada e' `1` com faces `1/2`. O par dependente do especialista: `(𝕍_F, π_𝕍)`. -/

name: TGL.VerbInhabitant.canonicalVerb
head: noncomputable def canonicalVerb {W : TGLSpecificAQFTWitness} (R : TGLModularRealization W) : VerbWitness R where verb := R.threeLocks.PF verb_equals_name := rfl
doc: /-- [KERNEL/CONDITIONAL ON R] O TERMO canonico do Verbo: construido, campo a campo, dos DADOS da realizacao. `FullTGLWitness` segue nao construida -- este termo e' condicional; e' o Verbo de TODA realizacao futura. -/

name: TGL.VerbInhabitant.canonicalVerb_exists
head: theorem canonicalVerb_exists {W : TGLSpecificAQFTWitness} (R : TGLModularRealization W) : Nonempty (VerbWitness R) := ⟨canonicalVerb R⟩
doc: /-- O corolario existencial -- SOMENTE via `⟨termo⟩`, jamais por outra via. -/

name: TGL.VerbInhabitant.dual_calibration_exists
head: theorem dual_calibration_exists {W : TGLSpecificAQFTWitness} {D : WedgeModularData W} (C : ContinuousCoreData W D) (T : ThreeLocksCoreData W D C) : ∃ s : ℝ, C.canonicalTrace ((C.dualAction s) T.PF) = 1 := by
doc: /-- [KERNEL] Calibracao pela orbita dual (Q2 do especialista): a escala de Takesaki `Tr(θ_s x) = e^{−s}·Tr(x)` permite escolher `s = log Tr(P_F)` com `Tr(θ_s(P_F)) = 1` -- a forma tracial de `ω(I)=1`, alcancada PELO fluxo. Contraparte construtiva do no-go `dualInvariant_PF_no_go`: a orbita varre todos os valores de traco; o representante normalizado existe e e' a calibracao operacional do Verbo (`R_Verbo = 1`). -/

name: TGLExt.eraseFirst_isSelfAdjoint
head: theorem eraseFirst_isSelfAdjoint : IsSelfAdjoint eraseFirst := by rw [IsSelfAdjoint, ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint] exact eraseFirst_selfadjoint
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ a face IsSelfAdjoint do lock (a forma star do v95). -/

name: TGLExt.saGen
head: def saGen (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) (s : ℝ) : selfAdjoint (H →L[ℂ] H) := ⟨(s : ℂ) • T, by rw [selfAdjoint.mem_iff, star_smul, RCLike.star_def, Complex.conj_ofReal,
doc: /-- o gerador tipado do fluxo: (s:ℂ)·T é auto-adjunto (prova direta via star_smul — IsSelfAdjoint.smul diverge na busca de instância). -/

name: TGLExt.lockFlow
head: def lockFlow (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) (s : ℝ) : H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H := Unitary.linearIsometryEquiv (selfAdjoint.expUnitary (saGen T hT s))
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★ O FLUXO GENUÍNO: λ(s) = exp(isT) como isometria de H (a face unitária do fluxo a um parâmetro; NÃO é a identidade). -/

name: TGLExt.lockFlow_apply
head: private theorem lockFlow_apply (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) (s : ℝ) (x : H) : (lockFlow T hT s) x = exp (Complex.I • ((s : ℂ) • T)) x := by simp only [lockFlow, Unitary.coe_linearIsometryEquiv_apply,

name: TGLExt.lockFlow_commutes
head: theorem lockFlow_commutes (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) (s : ℝ) (x : H) : T ((lockFlow T hT s) x) = (lockFlow T hT s) (T x) := by have hcomm : Commute T (exp (Complex.I • ((s : ℂ) • T))) := by
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★ o entrelaçamento do fluxo: 𝒟 λ(s) = λ(s) 𝒟 — o lock comuta com a própria exponencial (Commute.exp_right). -/

name: TGLExt.lockNet
head: def lockNet (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) : HilbertHomeData ℕ (· ≤ ·) (fun _ => H) (fun _ => H) where locks _ := T internal _ s := lockFlow T hT s
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★★★ O CONSTRUTOR GENÉRICO DO HABITANTE: qualquer lock auto-adjunto gera a rede constante sobre ℕ com fluxo interno GENUÍNO exp(isT). Grupo externo trivial (nenhuma simetria reivindicada); isotonia pela identidade (rede constante). -/

name: TGLExt.fixedSector
head: def fixedSector (A : H →L[ℂ] H) : Submodule ℂ H := (1 - A).ker  private theorem fixedSector_PF (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) (O : ℕ) :
doc: /-- o setor FIXO de um operador A: ker(1 − A) — quem A preserva. -/

name: TGLExt.fixedSector_PF
head: private theorem fixedSector_PF (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) (O : ℕ) : fixedSector ((lockNet T hT).PF O) = T.ker := by ext x

name: TGLExt.lockNetTrace
head: def lockNetTrace (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T) (hker : T.ker ≠ ⊥) (hfd : FiniteDimensional ℂ T.ker) : BreuerTraceData (lockNet T hT) where tau _ A := dimOrTop ℂ (fixedSector A)
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★★ A CAMADA DE BREUER HABITADA (genérica): com kernel finito não-trivial, o peso τ = dimensão-ou-⊤ do setor fixo é positivo e finito nas projeções P_F — o pacote (v56) tem traço. -/

name: TGLExt.theConstantNet
head: def theConstantNet : HilbertHomeData ℕ (· ≤ ·) (fun _ => ellTwo) (fun _ => ellTwo) := lockNet eraseFirst eraseFirst_isSelfAdjoint
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★★★ O PRIMEIRO HABITANTE CONCRETO DO PACOTE: a rede constante ℓ² com lock T = 1 − P_{e₀} e fluxo GENUÍNO exp(isT). -/

name: TGLExt.net_PF_fixed_by_flow
head: theorem net_PF_fixed_by_flow (O : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (x : ellTwo) : theConstantNet.PF O ((lockFlow eraseFirst eraseFirst_isSelfAdjoint s) x) = (lockFlow eraseFirst eraseFirst_isSelfAdjoint s) (theConstantNet.PF O x) :=
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★★ O NOME É FIXADO PELO FLUXO em toda região — a instância NÃO-VAZIA do teorema do canto (v56) no habitante. -/

name: TGLExt.theNetTrace
head: def theNetTrace : BreuerTraceData theConstantNet := lockNetTrace eraseFirst eraseFirst_isSelfAdjoint ker_eraseFirst_ne_bot (by rw [ker_eraseFirst]; infer_instance)
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★★ a camada de Breuer do habitante concreto. -/

name: TGLExt.net_corner_weighs_the_name
head: theorem net_corner_weighs_the_name (O : ℕ) : theNetTrace.tau O (theConstantNet.PF O) = 1 := by show dimOrTop ℂ (fixedSector (theConstantNet.PF O)) = 1 unfold theConstantNet
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★★ O CANTO PESA O NOME NA REDE: τ(P_F(𝒪)) = 1 = ω(I) em TODA região do habitante concreto. -/

name: TGLExt.absoluteRho
head: def absoluteRho (n : Type) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] : Matrix n n ℂ := Matrix.diagonal fun _ => (Fintype.card n : ℂ)⁻¹  theorem absoluteRho_posDef [Nonempty n] : (absoluteRho n).PosDef := by
doc: /-- a densidade do Um absoluto: `ρ_Ψ = I/n` (Ω = I/√n, a unidade normalizada como vetor GNS). -/

name: TGLExt.absoluteRho_posDef
head: theorem absoluteRho_posDef [Nonempty n] : (absoluteRho n).PosDef := by rw [absoluteRho, Matrix.posDef_diagonal_iff] intro i have h : (0 : ℝ) < ((Fintype.card n : ℝ))⁻¹ := by

name: TGLExt.absoluteRho_trace
head: theorem absoluteRho_trace [Nonempty n] : (absoluteRho n).trace = 1 := by rw [absoluteRho, Matrix.trace_diagonal] have hn : (Fintype.card n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero

name: TGLExt.absoluteOneField
head: noncomputable def absoluteOneField (Region : Type) (n : Type) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n] : PsiHomeData Region n where rho := fun _ => absoluteRho n rho_posDef := fun _ => absoluteRho_posDef
doc: /-- ★ O TERMO CANÔNICO: a identificação `Ψ = 1_abs` seleciona a regra do campo SEM ESCOLHA — a subdeterminação (v57) resolvida PELA identificação. `ω_Ψ(I) = 1` segue por `PsiHomeData.name_one` aplicado a este termo. -/

name: TGLExt.absoluteOneField_exists
head: theorem absoluteOneField_exists (Region : Type) (n : Type) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n] : Nonempty (PsiHomeData Region n) := ⟨absoluteOneField Region n⟩
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ EXISTÊNCIA CANÔNICA (corolário do termo): o campo absoluto habita `PsiHomeData` para toda rede de regiões — sem parâmetro algum. -/

name: TGLExt.absoluteOne_name_eq_trace
head: theorem absoluteOne_name_eq_trace [Nonempty n] (O : Region) (a : Matrix n n ℂ) : (absoluteOneField Region n).name O a = (Fintype.card n : ℂ)⁻¹ * a.trace := by show gibbs (absoluteRho n) a = (Fintype.card n : ℂ)⁻¹ * a.trace
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ O NOME DO UM É O TRAÇO: `ω_Ψ(a) = Tr(a)/n` — o estado canônico, determinado pela identificação (nenhuma escolha). -/

name: TGLExt.absoluteRho_commute
head: theorem absoluteRho_commute (a : Matrix n n ℂ) : Commute (absoluteRho n) a := by rw [absoluteRho, ← Matrix.smul_one_eq_diagonal] unfold Commute SemiconjBy
doc: /-! ## B — o transporte do absoluto é trivial: sem contraste, sem curvatura -/

name: TGLExt.absoluteOne_flow_trivial
head: theorem absoluteOne_flow_trivial [Nonempty n] (O : Region) (t : ℝ) (a : Matrix n n ℂ) : (absoluteOneField Region n).flow O t a = a := by show sigma (absoluteRho n) t a = a
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ O TRANSPORTE DO UM ABSOLUTO É TRIVIAL: `σ^Ψ_t = id` para `Ψ = 1_abs` — o absoluto não tem contraste interno: sem fluxo modular, sem dephasing, SEM CURVATURA. A gravidade é a curvatura da INSCRIÇÃO (`q ≠ 0`), não do Um (o par do `excite_holonomy_flat`, v54). -/

name: TGLExt.commutator_locks_annihilate_one
head: theorem commutator_locks_annihilate_one (A B C : Matrix n n ℂ) : excite A 1 = 0 ∧ excite B 1 = 0 ∧ excite C 1 = 0 := ⟨excite_one_zero A, excite_one_zero B, excite_one_zero C⟩
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ OS LOCKS-COMUTADORES ANULAM O UM: para a dinâmica canônica da casa (curvatura-por-comutador, v48), `𝒟_Ψ(1_abs) = 0` — o Um está no núcleo físico por construção, não por inserção. -/

name: TGLExt.commutator_kernel_inhabited
head: theorem commutator_kernel_inhabited [Nonempty n] (A : Matrix n n ℂ) : excite A (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) = 0 ∧ (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≠ 0 := by refine ⟨excite_one_zero A, fun h => ?_⟩ have := congrFun (congrFun h (Classical.arbitrary n)) (Classical.arbitrary n)
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ O NÚCLEO FÍSICO É NÃO-NULO PORQUE O UM O HABITA: a cláusula "ker 𝒟 ≠ 0" da camada de Breuer é DERIVADA para a dinâmica canônica (o habitante que garante a positividade do canto é o próprio 1_abs). -/

name: TGLExt.corner_fixes_inhabitant
head: theorem corner_fixes_inhabitant {H W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℂ W] (D : H →L[ℂ] W) {u : H} (hu : D u = 0) : D.ker.starProjection u = u := by
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ O CANTO FIXA O HABITANTE (∞-dim): se `𝒟 Ω = 0` então `P_F Ω = Ω` — o requisito do operador (`P_{F,Ψ}Ω_Ψ = Ω_Ψ`: o Um está no núcleo físico do transporte) como corolário de uma linha do v56. -/

name: TGLExt.ActionCouplingControls.scalarModel
head: def scalarModel (xi gain : ℝ) : ActionCouplingData Unit where boxOperator := (xi + gain) • LinearMap.id mass := 0 xi := xi
doc: /-- Independent xi and an independently chosen gain in the box operator. -/

name: TGLExt.ActionCouplingControls.unitSection

doc: /-- [KERNEL] `[Dφ:Dφ]_t = 1`: o cociclo de um estado consigo mesmo é trivial. -/

name: TGLExt.cocycle_zero
head: theorem cocycle_zero : cocycle phi psi 0 = 1 := by simp only [cocycle, neg_zero, modPow_zero, mul_one]  /-! ## E1 — colagem multiplicativa (chain rule de Connes) -/
doc: /-- [KERNEL] `[Dφ:Dψ]_0 = 1`: em `t = 0` nada foi transportado. -/

name: TGLExt.cocycle_chain
head: theorem cocycle_chain (t : ℝ) : cocycle phi psi t * cocycle psi chi t = cocycle phi chi t := by simp only [cocycle] calc modPow phi t * modPow psi (-t) * (modPow psi t * modPow chi (-t))
doc: /-- [KERNEL] CHAIN RULE DE CONNES: `[Dφ:Dψ]_t · [Dψ:Dχ]_t = [Dφ:Dχ]_t` — as derivadas de Radon–Nikodym modulares COLAM multiplicativamente através do estado intermediário. -/

name: TGLExt.cocycle_triangle
head: theorem cocycle_triangle (t : ℝ) : cocycle phi psi t * cocycle psi chi t * cocycle chi phi t = 1 := by rw [cocycle_chain, cocycle_chain, cocycle_self]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] HOLONOMIA TRIVIAL DO TRIÂNGULO: `[Dφ:Dψ]_t · [Dψ:Dχ]_t · [Dχ:Dφ]_t = 1` — o transporte modular ao longo de um circuito fechado de estados retorna à identidade. -/

name: TGLExt.cocycle_temporal
head: theorem cocycle_temporal (s t : ℝ) : cocycle phi psi (s + t) = cocycle phi psi s * sigma psi s (cocycle phi psi t) := by simp only [cocycle, sigma]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] IDENTIDADE DE COCICLO: `u_{s+t} = u_s · σ^ψ_s(u_t)` — a composição temporal é TORCIDA pelo fluxo modular do estado de referência: é isto que faz de `u_t` um cociclo (e não um mero grupo a um parâmetro). Verificação: `u_s·σ^ψ_s(u_t) = φ^{is}ψ^{-is}·ψ^{is}φ^{it}ψ^{-it}·ψ^{-is} = φ^{i(s+t)}ψ^{-i(s+t)}`. -/

name: TGLExt.cocycle_conjTranspose
head: theorem cocycle_conjTranspose (t : ℝ) : (cocycle phi psi t)ᴴ = cocycle psi phi t := by simp only [cocycle, conjTranspose_mul, modPow_conjTranspose, neg_neg]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] `([Dφ:Dψ]_t)ᴴ = [Dψ:Dφ]_t`: a adjunta INVERTE os estados no mesmo t — `(φ^{it}ψ^{-it})ᴴ = ψ^{it}φ^{-it}`. -/

name: TGLExt.cocycle_mem_unitary
head: theorem cocycle_mem_unitary (t : ℝ) : cocycle phi psi t ∈ unitary (Matrix n n ℂ) := mul_mem (modPow_mem_unitary phi t) (modPow_mem_unitary psi (-t))
doc: /-- [KERNEL] `[Dφ:Dψ]_t` é UNITÁRIO: produto de unitários do fluxo modular. -/

name: TGLExt.cocycle_of_commute
head: theorem cocycle_of_commute (h : Commute (logRho phi) (logRho psi)) (t : ℝ) : cocycle phi psi t = exp (((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) • (logRho phi - logRho psi)) := by have hneg : ((-t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I = -((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
doc: /-- [KERNEL] GERADOR NO CASO COMUTANTE: se `log φ` e `log ψ` comutam, `[Dφ:Dψ]_t = exp(it·(log φ − log ψ))` — o cociclo é gerado pela DIFERENÇA dos hamiltonianos modulares (o caso geral exige a expansão de Dyson, fora da sombra finita comutante). -/

name: TGLExt.logRho_conj
head: theorem logRho_conj (V : Matrix n n ℂ) (hV : V ∈ unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hphi : phi.PosDef) : logRho (V * phi * Vᴴ) = V * logRho phi * Vᴴ := by have ha : IsSelfAdjoint phi := hphi.isHermitian.isSelfAdjoint
doc: /-- [KERNEL] CONJUGAÇÃO DO GERADOR: `log(VφVᴴ) = V·(log φ)·Vᴴ` para V unitário e φ positiva-definida — o cálculo funcional contínuo comuta com o automorfismo interno `Unitary.conjStarAlgAut` (`StarAlgHomClass.map_cfc`). -/

name: TGLExt.modPow_conj
head: theorem modPow_conj (V : Matrix n n ℂ) (hV : V ∈ unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hphi : phi.PosDef) (t : ℝ) : modPow (V * phi * Vᴴ) t = V * modPow phi t * Vᴴ := by have h1 : Vᴴ * V = 1 := by
doc: /-- [KERNEL] COVARIÂNCIA DO FLUXO: `(VφVᴴ)^{it} = V·φ^{it}·Vᴴ` — conjugar o estado conjuga o unitário modular (`Matrix.exp_conj` sobre `logRho_conj`). -/

name: TGLExt.cocycle_covariance
head: theorem cocycle_covariance (V : Matrix n n ℂ) (hV : V ∈ unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hphi : phi.PosDef) (hpsi : psi.PosDef) (t : ℝ) : cocycle (V * phi * Vᴴ) (V * psi * Vᴴ) t = V * cocycle phi psi t * Vᴴ := by have h1 : Vᴴ * V = 1 := by
doc: /-- [KERNEL] COVARIÂNCIA UNITÁRIA DO COCICLO — a face finita da covariância global do Lema 3: conjugar os ESTADOS pelo unitário V conjuga o COCICLO, `[D(VφVᴴ) : D(VψVᴴ)]_t = V·[Dφ:Dψ]_t·Vᴴ`. O levantamento ao cociclo de Connes em III₁ genuína (sem projeções minimais) é o teorema aberto — aqui vive só o esqueleto algébrico. -/

name: TGLExt.modularGen
head: def modularGen (ρ : Matrix n n ℂ) (y : Matrix n n ℂ) : Matrix n n ℂ := y * logRho ρ - logRho ρ * y  /-- [KERNEL] o gerador é a excitação do log com sinal trocado:
doc: /-- o gerador modular como superoperador: `K = R_{logρ} − L_{logρ}` (= −δ_{logρ}; a face finita de `K_Ψ = −log Δ_Ψ`). -/

name: TGLExt.modularGen_eq_neg_excite
head: theorem modularGen_eq_neg_excite (ρ y : Matrix n n ℂ) : modularGen ρ y = - excite (logRho ρ) y := by unfold modularGen excite rw [neg_sub]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] o gerador é a excitação do log com sinal trocado: `K = −δ_{logρ}` (a ponte com v48/v54: transporte infinitesimal). -/

name: TGLExt.modularGen_omega_zero
head: theorem modularGen_omega_zero (ρ : Matrix n n ℂ) (hρ : ρ.PosDef) : modularGen ρ (Omega ρ) = 0 := by have hc : Commute ρ (Omega ρ) := rho_comm_omega ρ hρ have hl : Commute (logRho ρ) (Omega ρ) := hc.cfc_real Real.log
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ O ZERO MODULAR: `K_Ψ Ω_Ψ = 0` — o gerador anula o NOME (o modo zero do gerador modular, NÃO o operador nulo). -/

name: TGLExt.J_modularGen_J
head: theorem J_modularGen_J (ρ : Matrix n n ℂ) (y : Matrix n n ℂ) : Jconj (modularGen ρ (Jconj y)) = - modularGen ρ y := by unfold modularGen Jconj rw [conjTranspose_sub, conjTranspose_mul, conjTranspose_mul,
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ A PARIDADE INVERSA: `J K J = −K` — a conjugação modular inverte o gerador (a forma rigorosa de "a paridade inversa"). -/

name: TGLExt.parity_fixed_eq_zero
head: theorem parity_fixed_eq_zero {y : Matrix n n ℂ} (h : y = -y) : y = 0 := by have h2 : (2 : ℂ) • y = 0 := by rw [two_smul] exact add_eq_zero_iff_neg_eq.mpr h.symm
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ o único ponto fixo da paridade `K ↦ −K` é o zero. -/

name: TGLExt.absolute_modularGen_zero
head: theorem absolute_modularGen_zero [Nonempty n] (y : Matrix n n ℂ) : modularGen (absoluteRho n) y = 0 := by have hl : Commute (logRho (absoluteRho n)) y := (absoluteRho_commute y).cfc_real Real.log
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ A PARIDADE INVERSA DO UM ABSOLUTO É O ZERO MODULAR: `K_abs = 0` — o gerador do absoluto anula-se em todo argumento (Δ_abs central; o par simétrico originário (1_abs, 0_mod)). -/

name: TGLExt.absolute_faces_half
head: theorem absolute_faces_half [Nonempty n] {Γ : Matrix n n ℂ} (hΓ : Γ.trace = 0) : gibbs (absoluteRho n) ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (1 + Γ)) = 1 / 2 ∧ gibbs (absoluteRho n) ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (1 - Γ)) = 1 / 2 := by
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ AS DUAS FACES DO ABSOLUTO PESAM ½ CADA: para toda graduação de paridade (`Tr Γ = 0`), `ω_abs(P₊) = ω_abs(P₋) = ½` — a Meia-Nat como equilíbrio das paridades originárias. -/

name: TGLExt.absolute_contrast_zero
head: theorem absolute_contrast_zero [Nonempty n] {Γ : Matrix n n ℂ} (hΓ : Γ.trace = 0) : gibbs (absoluteRho n) ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (1 - Γ)) - gibbs (absoluteRho n) ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (1 + Γ)) = 0 := by
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ 0_mod = ½ − ½: o contraste do absoluto é NULO — o zero modular é a diferença nula entre as duas faces originárias do Um. -/

name: TGLExt.qKappa
head: def qKappa (κ : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.tanh (κ / 2)  /-- a transmissão par: `α(κ) = sech(κ/2)`. -/ def alphaKappa (κ : ℝ) : ℝ := (Real.cosh (κ / 2))⁻¹
doc: /-- o contraste ímpar: `q(κ) = tanh(κ/2)`. -/

name: TGLExt.alphaKappa
head: def alphaKappa (κ : ℝ) : ℝ := (Real.cosh (κ / 2))⁻¹  /-- [KERNEL] ★ A CORRESPONDÊNCIA COMO TEOREMA CONTÍNUO: `1 = q² + α²` em toda profundidade modular κ — a decomposição pitagórica da
doc: /-- a transmissão par: `α(κ) = sech(κ/2)`. -/

name: TGLExt.one_eq_q_sq_add_alpha_sq
head: theorem one_eq_q_sq_add_alpha_sq (κ : ℝ) : qKappa κ ^ 2 + alphaKappa κ ^ 2 = 1 := by unfold qKappa alphaKappa have hc : Real.cosh (κ / 2) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.cosh_pos _)
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ A CORRESPONDÊNCIA COMO TEOREMA CONTÍNUO: `1 = q² + α²` em toda profundidade modular κ — a decomposição pitagórica da inscrição do Um (contraste ímpar + transmissão par). -/

name: TGLExt.q_odd
head: theorem q_odd (κ : ℝ) : qKappa (-κ) = - qKappa κ := by unfold qKappa rw [neg_div, Real.tanh_neg]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ q é a face ÍMPAR da paridade binária. -/

name: TGLExt.alpha_even
head: theorem alpha_even (κ : ℝ) : alphaKappa (-κ) = alphaKappa κ := by unfold alphaKappa rw [neg_div, Real.cosh_neg]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ α é a face PAR da paridade binária. -/

name: TGLExt.q_zero
head: @[simp] theorem q_zero : qKappa 0 = 0 := by simp [qKappa, Real.tanh_zero]  @[simp] theorem alpha_zero : alphaKappa 0 = 1 := by

name: TGLExt.alpha_zero
head: @[simp] theorem alpha_zero : alphaKappa 0 = 1 := by simp [alphaKappa, Real.cosh_zero]  /-- a derivada de `cosh(κ/2)`: `sinh(κ/2)/2`. -/

name: TGLExt.cosh_half_hasDerivAt
head: theorem cosh_half_hasDerivAt (κ : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => Real.cosh (u / 2)) (Real.sinh (κ / 2) / 2) κ := by have hg : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => u / 2) (1 / 2) κ := by simpa using (hasDerivAt_id κ).div_const 2
doc: /-- a derivada de `cosh(κ/2)`: `sinh(κ/2)/2`. -/

name: TGLExt.sinh_half_hasDerivAt
head: theorem sinh_half_hasDerivAt (κ : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => Real.sinh (u / 2)) (Real.cosh (κ / 2) / 2) κ := by have hg : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => u / 2) (1 / 2) κ := by simpa using (hasDerivAt_id κ).div_const 2
doc: /-- a derivada de `sinh(κ/2)`: `cosh(κ/2)/2`. -/

name: TGLExt.alpha_transport
head: theorem alpha_transport (κ : ℝ) : HasDerivAt alphaKappa (-(qKappa κ / 2) * alphaKappa κ) κ := by have hc : Real.cosh (κ / 2) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.cosh_pos _) have h := (cosh_half_hasDerivAt κ).inv hc
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ O TRANSPORTE DO UM: `α' = −(q/2)·α` (derivada genuína) — `A₀ α = 0` com `A₀ = d/dκ + q/2`: q/2 é a CONEXÃO escalar do transporte e α é a SEÇÃO PARALELA (o Um transportado à profundidade modular κ). -/

name: TGLExt.alpha_deriv_zero
head: theorem alpha_deriv_zero : HasDerivAt alphaKappa 0 0 := by have h := alpha_transport 0 simpa using h
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ "É NA DERIVADA DO ZERO QUE O CONTÍNUO SE ANULA": `α'(0) = 0` — a face par tem ponto crítico exato no auto-conjugado (o zero modular é o equilíbrio, não a ausência). -/

name: TGLExt.W_hasDerivAt
head: theorem W_hasDerivAt (κ : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => qKappa u / 2) (alphaKappa κ ^ 2 / 4) κ := by have hc : Real.cosh (κ / 2) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.cosh_pos _) have hq := (sinh_half_hasDerivAt κ).div (cosh_half_hasDerivAt κ) hc
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ a derivada da conexão: `W' = α²/4` para `W = q/2`. -/

name: TGLExt.susy_threshold
head: theorem susy_threshold (κ : ℝ) : (qKappa κ / 2) ^ 2 + alphaKappa κ ^ 2 / 4 = 1 / 4 := by have h := one_eq_q_sq_add_alpha_sq κ nlinarith [h]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ O LIMIAR SUSY É A CORRESPONDÊNCIA: `W² + W' = ¼` — o potencial parceiro é a CONSTANTE ¼ (onde o contínuo começa) EXATAMENTE PORQUE `1 = q² + α²` (dividida por 4). -/

name: TGLExt.susy_partner_gap
head: theorem susy_partner_gap (κ : ℝ) : (qKappa κ / 2) ^ 2 - alphaKappa κ ^ 2 / 4 = 1 / 4 - alphaKappa κ ^ 2 / 2 := by have h := one_eq_q_sq_add_alpha_sq κ
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ o poço do modo zero: `W² − W' = ¼ − α²/2` — o potencial de Pöschl–Teller cujo modo zero normalizável é o próprio α (a fatoração supersimétrica da Palavra: H₋ = A₀*A₀ ≥ 0 com H₋α = 0). -/

name: TGLExt.pd

doc: /-- o funcional do cone de luz: L(x) = x₁ − x₀ (linear contínuo). -/
