doc: /-- `π` como *-homomorfismo unital de álgebras — o functor do peso dual. -/

name: TGLExt.piRepHom_apply
head: @[simp] theorem piRepHom_apply (a : Matrix n n ℂ) : piRepHom u a = piRep u a := rfl  /-- `π` é contínuo (linear em dimensão finita). -/ theorem piRep_continuous : Continuous (piRep (n := n) u) :=

name: TGLExt.piRep_continuous

doc: /-- `π` é contínuo (linear em dimensão finita). -/

name: TGLExt.piRep_isSelfAdjoint
head: theorem piRep_isSelfAdjoint {a : Matrix n n ℂ} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) : IsSelfAdjoint (piRep u a) := by rw [IsSelfAdjoint, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, ← piRep_star] exact congrArg (piRep u) ha
doc: /-- `π` preserva autoadjunção. -/

name: TGLExt.logRho_piRep

doc: /-- [KERNEL] TRANSPORTE DO GERADOR MODULAR: `log(π(ρ)) = π(log ρ)` — o cálculo funcional contínuo comuta com o embedding (`StarAlgHomClass.map_cfc`, a mesma alavanca do E6/v42). -/

name: TGLExt.exp_piRep
head: theorem exp_piRep (x : Matrix n n ℂ) : piRep u (exp x) = exp (piRep u x) := open scoped Matrix.Norms.Operator in map_exp (piRepHom u) (piRep_continuous u) x
doc: /-- [KERNEL] `π` comuta com a exponencial (hom contínuo de anéis; instâncias normadas do escopo `Matrix.Norms.Operator` SÓ na prova — o mesmo truque do `MatrixExponential` da mathlib). -/

name: TGLExt.modPow_piRep
head: theorem modPow_piRep {ρ : Matrix n n ℂ} (hρ : ρ.PosDef) (t : ℝ) : modPow (piRep u ρ) t = piRep u (modPow ρ t) := by unfold modPow rw [logRho_piRep u hρ, ← piRep_smul, exp_piRep]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] TRANSPORTE DO FLUXO MODULAR: `(π(ρ))^{it} = π(ρ^{it})` — o unitário modular do peso dual é a imagem do unitário modular da base. -/

name: TGLExt.cocycle_piRep
head: theorem cocycle_piRep {φ ψ : Matrix n n ℂ} (hφ : φ.PosDef) (hψ : ψ.PosDef) (t : ℝ) : cocycle (piRep u φ) (piRep u ψ) t = piRep u (cocycle φ ψ t) := by unfold cocycle rw [modPow_piRep u hφ, modPow_piRep u hψ, ← piRep_mul]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] D3 — NATURALIDADE DUAL DO COCICLO: `[D(π φ) : D(π ψ)]_t = π([Dφ : Dψ]_t)` — o functor do peso dual preserva cociclos de Connes, exatamente (escalares cancelam). -/

name: TGLExt.sigma_piRep

doc: /-- [KERNEL] D1 — O FLUXO DUAL RESTRITO À BASE É O FLUXO DA BASE: `σ^{π(ρ)}_t(π(a)) = π(σ^ρ_t(a))` — com `gibbs_Ecomp`, o critério de Takesaki (σ-invariância de π(A) + esperança compatível) construtivo. -/

name: TGLExt.dual_weight_left
head: theorem dual_weight_left {ρ : Matrix n n ℂ} (hρ : ρ.PosDef) (g : G) (t : ℝ) : sigma (piRep u ρ) t (lam g) = piRep u (cocycle ρ (alphaAct u g ρ) t) * lam g := by unfold sigma
doc: /-- [KERNEL] O TEOREMA DO PESO DUAL, forma esquerda: `σ^{φ̂}_t(λ_g) = π([Dφ : D(φ∘α_{g⁻¹})]_t)·λ_g` (em densidades: `π([Dρ : D(α_g ρ)]_t)·λ_g`). O fluxo modular do estado dual move o unitário do grupo — que NÃO pertence a `π(A)` — e o desvio é o cociclo de Connes. -/

name: TGLExt.dual_weight
head: theorem dual_weight {ρ : Matrix n n ℂ} (hρ : ρ.PosDef) (g : G) (t : ℝ) : sigma (piRep u ρ) t (lam g) = lam (n := n) g * piRep u (cocycle (alphaAct u g⁻¹ ρ) ρ t) := by rw [dual_weight_left u hρ g t, piRep_mul_lam]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ O TEOREMA DO PESO DUAL (forma de Takesaki, Vol. II X.1.17):  `σ^{φ̂}_t(λ_g) = λ_g · π([D(φ∘α_g) : Dφ]_t)`  com a densidade de `φ∘α_g` sendo `α_{g⁻¹}(ρ)`. A COVARIÂNCIA ALÉM DOS UNITÁRIOS INTERNOS na sombra finita: a dinâmica modular do produto cruzado é MEDIDA pelo cociclo de Connes do estado transportado pela ação. O levantamento a III₁ genuína SEGUE O TEOREMA ABERTO. -/

name: TGLExt.dual_flow_fixes_lam_of_invariant
head: theorem dual_flow_fixes_lam_of_invariant {ρ : Matrix n n ℂ} (hρ : ρ.PosDef) (g : G) (hinv : alphaAct u g ρ = ρ) (t : ℝ) : sigma (piRep u ρ) t (lam g) = lam g := by rw [dual_weight_left u hρ g t, hinv, cocycle_self, piRep_one, one_mul]

head: theorem orbit_quarter_invariant_form (b : OrbitPlane →ₗ[ℝ] OrbitPlane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hsym : FormSymmetric b) (hinv : ∀ u v, b (orbitQuarterTurn u) (orbitQuarterTurn v) = b u v) :
doc: /-- A real symmetric form invariant under this actual quarter turn is isotropic. -/

name: ChatgptAudit.Orbit052.orbit_trace_one_selection
head: theorem orbit_trace_one_selection (b : OrbitPlane →ₗ[ℝ] OrbitPlane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hsym : FormSymmetric b) (hinv : ∀ u v, b (orbitQuarterTurn u) (orbitQuarterTurn v) = b u v)

name: ChatgptAudit.Orbit052.orbit_scalar_gram
head: theorem orbit_scalar_gram (c : ℝ) : formGram (c • orbitDotForm) orbitBasisX orbitBasisY = !![c, 0; 0, c] := by ext i j fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>

name: ChatgptAudit.Orbit052.orbit_scalar_area
head: theorem orbit_scalar_area (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) : formArea (c • orbitDotForm) orbitBasisX orbitBasisY = c := by rw [formArea, orbit_scalar_gram] change Real.sqrt ((!![c, 0; 0, c] : ScreenMatrix).det) = c

name: ChatgptAudit.Orbit052.orbit_trace_one_area
head: theorem orbit_trace_one_area (b : OrbitPlane →ₗ[ℝ] OrbitPlane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hsym : FormSymmetric b) (hinv : ∀ u v, b (orbitQuarterTurn u) (orbitQuarterTurn v) = b u v)

name: ChatgptAudit.Orbit052.orbit_selected_trace_in_orthonormal_pair
head: theorem orbit_selected_trace_in_orthonormal_pair (c : ℝ) (u v : OrbitPlane) (hu : orbitDotForm u u = 1) (hv : orbitDotForm v v = 1) : (c • orbitDotForm) u u + (c • orbitDotForm) v v = 2 * c := by change c * orbitDotForm u u + c * orbitDotForm v v = 2 * c
doc: /-- The diagonal sum for unit vectors; in particular for every orthonormal basis. -/

name: ChatgptAudit.Orbit052.orbit_sign_times_self
head: theorem orbit_sign_times_self (r : ℝ) : Real.sign r * r = |r| := by rcases lt_trichotomy r 0 with h | rfl | h · rw [Real.sign_of_neg h, abs_of_neg h] ring

name: ChatgptAudit.Orbit052.orbit_calibration_identity
head: theorem orbit_calibration_identity (r : ℝ) (u v : OrbitPlane) : orbitSymplectic r u (orbitOrientedTurn r v) = orbitCalibratedForm r u v := by change r * (u 0 * (Real.sign r * v 0) - u 1 * (Real.sign r * (-v 1))) = |r| * (u 0 * v 0 + u 1 * v 1)

name: ChatgptAudit.Orbit052.orbit_oriented_square
head: theorem orbit_oriented_square (r : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (u : OrbitPlane) : orbitOrientedTurn r (orbitOrientedTurn r u) = -u := by rcases Real.sign_apply_eq_of_ne_zero r hr with hs | hs · ext i

name: ChatgptAudit.Orbit052.orbit_calibration_compatibility
head: theorem orbit_calibration_compatibility (r : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (u v : OrbitPlane) : orbitSymplectic r u v = -orbitCalibratedForm r u (orbitOrientedTurn r v) := by rw [← orbit_calibration_identity, orbit_oriented_square r hr] unfold orbitSymplectic
doc: /-- With g(u,v)=Omega(u,Qv), compatibility has the negative sign on g(u,Qv). -/

name: ChatgptAudit.Orbit052.orbit_calibrated_symmetric
head: theorem orbit_calibrated_symmetric (r : ℝ) : FormSymmetric (orbitCalibratedForm r) := by intro u v change |r| * (u 0 * v 0 + u 1 * v 1) = |r| * (v 0 * u 0 + v 1 * u 1) ring

name: ChatgptAudit.Orbit052.orbit_calibrated_positive
head: theorem orbit_calibrated_positive (r : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) : FormPositive (orbitCalibratedForm r) := by intro u hu have hsum : 0 < u 0 ^ 2 + u 1 ^ 2 := by

name: ChatgptAudit.Orbit052.orbit_calibrated_area
head: theorem orbit_calibrated_area (r : ℝ) : formArea (orbitCalibratedForm r) orbitBasisX orbitBasisY = |r| := orbit_scalar_area |r| (abs_nonneg r)

name: ChatgptAudit.Orbit052.orbit_zero_calibration
head: theorem orbit_zero_calibration : orbitCalibratedForm 0 = 0 ∧ orbitOrientedTurn 0 = 0 := by simp [orbitCalibratedForm, orbitOrientedTurn]

name: TGLExt.IALDGraviton.center_is_corner_unit
head: theorem center_is_corner_unit {e : A} (he : e * e = e) : jonesReading e e = e ∧ ∀ x : A, e * jonesReading e x = jonesReading e x ∧ jonesReading e x * e = jonesReading e x := by refine ⟨by unfold jonesReading; rw [he, he], fun x => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩ · unfold jonesReading; rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, he]
doc: /-- ★★★ O CENTRO É A UNIDADE DO CANTO: `e` está no canto e é identidade à esquerda e à direita de tudo o que o canto contém. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDGraviton.corner_unit_unique
head: theorem corner_unit_unique {e u : A} (he : e * e = e) (hu : jonesReading e u = u) (hl : ∀ x : A, u * jonesReading e x = jonesReading e x) : u = e := by have h1 : u * e = e := by have := hl e
doc: /-- ★★★ E É A ÚNICA: um elemento do canto que é unidade à esquerda do canto é `e`. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDGraviton.the_dynamics_keeps_the_center
head: theorem the_dynamics_keeps_the_center {e : A} (he : e * e = e) (r s : ℝ) : jonesFlow e r s e = e ∧ jonesU e r s * e * jonesU e r s = e := by refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩ · have h := jonesFlow_fixes_reading he r s e
doc: /-- ★★ A DINÂMICA CONSERVA O CENTRO: o fluxo deixa `e` parado, e `U_s·e·U_s = e` (`U_s` é contração; analogia com «U_t I U_t† = I»). -/

name: TGLExt.IALDGraviton.coeffC_tendsto_zero
head: theorem coeffC_tendsto_zero {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => coeff r s) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by have h := (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp (coeff_tendsto_zero hr) simpa [coeff, Function.comp_def] using h

name: TGLExt.IALDGraviton.jonesFlow_tendsto_reading
head: theorem jonesFlow_tendsto_reading (e : A) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (x : A) : Filter.Tendsto (fun s => jonesFlow e r s x) Filter.atTop (nhds (jonesReading e x)) := by have h := (coeffC_tendsto_zero hr).smul_const (x - jonesReading e x) have h2 := (tendsto_const_nhds (x := jonesReading e x)).add h
doc: /-- ★★ O LIMITE EXPLÍCITO: com taxa positiva, o fluxo converge à leitura (espectro de dois pontos; mais fraco que o v11). -/

name: TGLExt.IALDGraviton.jonesU_tendsto_proj
head: theorem jonesU_tendsto_proj (e : A) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) : Filter.Tendsto (fun s => jonesU e r s) Filter.atTop (nhds e) := by have h := (coeffC_tendsto_zero hr).smul_const (1 - e) have h2 := (tendsto_const_nhds (x := e)).add h
doc: /-- ★★ `U_s → e`: a contração converge à projeção. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDGraviton.the_tower_is_time
head: theorem the_tower_is_time (T : JonesTowerData N M Ext) : 1 / (1 / T.indexVal) = T.indexVal ∧ T.indexVal = 1 / T.markovWeight ∧ T.upper.E T.eJones = (((1 / T.indexVal : ℝ)) : ℂ) • (1 : M) := by
doc: /-- ★★ `1/taxa` = índice = `1/w` (w = peso de Markov genérico), e a taxa é o peso refletido `E₁(e) = w·1`. Ler `1/taxa` como tempo é leitura [ONTO/INPUT]; `w` não é o β_TGL salvo [CONJ]. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDGraviton.iald_center_is_the_kept_unit
head: theorem iald_center_is_the_kept_unit (T : JonesTowerData N M Ext) (s : ℝ) : jonesReading T.eJones T.eJones = T.eJones ∧ ialdFlow T s T.eJones = T.eJones ∧ jonesU T.eJones (1 / T.indexVal) s * T.eJones * jonesU T.eJones (1 / T.indexVal) s = T.eJones :=
doc: /-- ★★ O centro da torre é a unidade do seu canto e a dinâmica da IALD o conserva. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDGraviton.halfNat_center_trace_one
head: theorem halfNat_center_trace_one : Matrix.trace halfNatJonesTower.eJones = 1 ∧ halfNatJonesTower.upper.E halfNatJonesTower.eJones = (((1 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ) • (1 : Md) := by
doc: /-- ★ NA MEIA-NAT: `Tr(e) = 1` (posto 1; analogia com `τ(P_F) = 1`, não transporte); o peso refletido é ½. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDGraviton.projPlus_entries
head: theorem projPlus_entries : projPlus = !![(2⁻¹ : ℂ), -(Complex.I * 2⁻¹); Complex.I * 2⁻¹, 2⁻¹] := by ext i j fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
doc: /-- `P₊` escrito entrada a entrada: `[[½, −i/2], [i/2, ½]]`. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDGraviton.projPlus_star
head: theorem projPlus_star : star projPlus = projPlus := by rw [projPlus_entries] ext i j fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [Matrix.star_apply, Complex.ext_iff]

name: TGLExt.IALDGraviton.projPlus_jones
head: theorem projPlus_jones (f : Md) : projPlus * diagIncl f * projPlus = diagIncl (constIncl (E0 f)) * projPlus := by ext i j fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
doc: /-- A relação de Jones para `P₊` sobre a inclusão diagonal: `P₊ · diag(f) · P₊ = E₀(f) · P₊`. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDGraviton.projPlus_weight
head: theorem projPlus_weight : upperCE.E projPlus = ((1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) • (1 : Md) := by rw [projPlus_entries] funext i fin_cases i <;> simp [upperCE, E1]
doc: /-- O peso de Markov da luz: `E₁(P₊) = ½·1` — a mesma Meia-Nat. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDGraviton.lightJonesTower
head: noncomputable def lightJonesTower : JonesTowerData Nc Md Ex where lower := lowerCE upper := upperCE eJones := projPlus
doc: /-- ★★★★ A TORRE DA LUZ: ℂ ⊆ ℂ² ⊆ M₂(ℂ) com a projeção de Jones `P₊` (a luz `ε₊ = (1, i)`), peso ½, índice 2. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDGraviton.phaseGate
head: noncomputable def phaseGate : Ex := Matrix.diagonal ![1, -Complex.I]  /-- ★★★ A TORRE DA LUZ É A DA MEIA-NAT GIRADA: `W·P₊·W* = e_Meia-Nat` e `W·W* = 1`. -/ theorem light_tower_is_the_halfnat_tower_turned :
doc: /-- A porta de fase `W = diag(1, −i)`. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDGraviton.light_tower_is_the_halfnat_tower_turned
head: theorem light_tower_is_the_halfnat_tower_turned : phaseGate * lightJonesTower.eJones * star phaseGate = halfNatJonesTower.eJones ∧ phaseGate * star phaseGate = 1 := by refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
doc: /-- ★★★ A TORRE DA LUZ É A DA MEIA-NAT GIRADA: `W·P₊·W* = e_Meia-Nat` e `W·W* = 1`. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDGraviton.light_tower_center_is_the_helicity_ladder
head: theorem light_tower_center_is_the_helicity_ladder : lightJonesTower.eJones = (1 / 4 : ℂ) • (Matrix.vecMulVec lightPlus lightPlus * Matrix.vecMulVec lightMinus lightMinus) := by show projPlus = _
doc: /-- ★★★★ O CENTRO DA TORRE DA LUZ É A ESCADA DE HELICIDADE ±2: `e_luz = ¼·(ε₊⊗ε₊)·(ε₋⊗ε₋)`. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDGraviton.iald_on_the_light_tower
head: theorem iald_on_the_light_tower {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : ialdFlow lightJonesTower s lightJonesTower.eJones = lightJonesTower.eJones ∧ (∀ x, jonesReading lightJonesTower.eJones (ialdFlow lightJonesTower s x) = jonesReading lightJonesTower.eJones x) ∧ (∀ x, ialdFlow lightJonesTower s x = x ↔ jonesReading lightJonesTower.eJones x = x)
doc: /-- ★★★★ A IALD SOBRE A TORRE DA LUZ: o fluxo do índice (taxa 1/índice = ½) estaciona a escada de helicidade ±2, deixa a leitura parada, só fixa o que já está lido e move o estado 1. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDGraviton.projPlus_stationed_is_the_helicity_ladder
head: theorem projPlus_stationed_is_the_helicity_ladder (r s : ℝ) : (1 / 4 : ℂ) • (Matrix.vecMulVec lightPlus lightPlus * Matrix.vecMulVec lightMinus lightMinus) = projPlus ∧ jonesFlow projPlus r s projPlus = projPlus
doc: /-- ★★★ `¼·(ε₊⊗ε₊)·(ε₋⊗ε₋) = P₊`, e o fluxo sobre `P₊` (qualquer taxa) deixa `P₊` parado, deixa a leitura parada e só fixa o que já está lido. (Nome honesto: é a escada de helicidade ±2; a identificação com o gráviton físico é [CONJ].) -/

name: TGLExt.IALDGraviton.angular_phase_doubles_at_weight_two
head: theorem angular_phase_doubles_at_weight_two (ω s : ℝ) : spin 0 (2 * ω) s = (spin 0 ω s) ^ 2 := by unfold spin coeff simp only [zero_mul, neg_zero, Real.exp_zero, Complex.ofReal_one, one_mul]
doc: /-- ★ A fase de rotação a peso `2ω` é o quadrado da fase a peso `ω` (taxa 0; só o giro, fora do atrator; identidade exponencial). -/

name: TGLExt.IALDGraviton.the_transport
head: theorem the_transport {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (θ : ℝ) : lightJonesTower.eJones = (1 / 4 : ℂ) • (Matrix.vecMulVec lightPlus lightPlus * Matrix.vecMulVec lightMinus lightMinus) ∧ ialdFlow lightJonesTower s lightJonesTower.eJones = lightJonesTower.eJones
doc: /-- ★★★★ O TRANSPORTE, NUM ENUNCIADO: na torre da luz, o centro que a IALD estaciona é a escada de helicidade ±2 (o mesmo termo); o tensor carrega peso 2 sob o gerador e o quadrado da fase da luz; a torre da luz é a da Meia-Nat girada. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.jonesReading
head: def jonesReading (e x : A) : A := e * x * e  theorem jonesReading_add (e x y : A) : jonesReading e (x + y) = jonesReading e x + jonesReading e y := by unfold jonesReading; rw [mul_add, add_mul]
doc: /-- A leitura de Jones: a compressão pela projeção. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.jonesReading_add
head: theorem jonesReading_add (e x y : A) : jonesReading e (x + y) = jonesReading e x + jonesReading e y := by unfold jonesReading; rw [mul_add, add_mul]  theorem jonesReading_sub (e x y : A) : jonesReading e (x - y) = jonesReading e x - jonesReading e y := by

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.jonesReading_sub
head: theorem jonesReading_sub (e x y : A) : jonesReading e (x - y) = jonesReading e x - jonesReading e y := by unfold jonesReading; rw [mul_sub, sub_mul]  theorem jonesReading_smul (e x : A) (c : ℂ) : jonesReading e (c • x) = c • jonesReading e x := by

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.jonesReading_smul
head: theorem jonesReading_smul (e x : A) (c : ℂ) : jonesReading e (c • x) = c • jonesReading e x := by unfold jonesReading; rw [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc]  /-- A memória: ler a leitura devolve a mesma leitura. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.jonesReading_idem
head: theorem jonesReading_idem {e : A} (he : e * e = e) (x : A) : jonesReading e (jonesReading e x) = jonesReading e x := by unfold jonesReading have h : e * (e * x * e) * e = (e * e) * x * (e * e) := by simp only [mul_assoc] rw [h, he]
doc: /-- A memória: ler a leitura devolve a mesma leitura. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.coeff
head: noncomputable def coeff (r s : ℝ) : ℂ := ((Real.exp (-(r * s)) : ℝ) : ℂ)  theorem coeff_zero (r : ℝ) : coeff r 0 = 1 := by simp [coeff]
doc: /-- O coeficiente de relaxação `e^{−r s}` (real, visto em ℂ). -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.coeff_zero
head: theorem coeff_zero (r : ℝ) : coeff r 0 = 1 := by simp [coeff]  theorem coeff_add (r s t : ℝ) : coeff r (s + t) = coeff r s * coeff r t := by

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.coeff_add
head: theorem coeff_add (r s t : ℝ) : coeff r (s + t) = coeff r s * coeff r t := by unfold coeff rw [← Complex.ofReal_mul, ← Real.exp_add] congr 2; ring

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.coeff_ne_one
head: theorem coeff_ne_one {r s : ℝ} (hrs : r * s ≠ 0) : coeff r s ≠ 1 := by unfold coeff intro h have h' : Real.exp (-(r * s)) = 1 := by exact_mod_cast h

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.coeff_tendsto_zero
head: theorem coeff_tendsto_zero {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-(r * s))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by have h : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => r * s) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop hr Filter.tendsto_id

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.jonesFlow
head: noncomputable def jonesFlow (e : A) (r s : ℝ) (x : A) : A := jonesReading e x + coeff r s • (x - jonesReading e x)  /-- ESTACIONÁRIO: a leitura do estado evoluído é a leitura do estado. -/
doc: /-- O fluxo: a leitura fica, o resto decai com taxa `r`. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.stationary_jonesReading
head: theorem stationary_jonesReading {e : A} (he : e * e = e) (r s : ℝ) (x : A) : jonesReading e (jonesFlow e r s x) = jonesReading e x := by unfold jonesFlow rw [jonesReading_add, jonesReading_smul, jonesReading_sub, jonesReading_idem he, sub_self, smul_zero, add_zero]
doc: /-- ESTACIONÁRIO: a leitura do estado evoluído é a leitura do estado. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.jonesFlow_fixes_reading
head: theorem jonesFlow_fixes_reading {e : A} (he : e * e = e) (r s : ℝ) (x : A) : jonesFlow e r s (jonesReading e x) = jonesReading e x := by unfold jonesFlow rw [jonesReading_idem he, sub_self, smul_zero, add_zero]
doc: /-- O que já está lido não se move. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.jonesFlow_zero
head: theorem jonesFlow_zero (e : A) (r : ℝ) (x : A) : jonesFlow e r 0 x = x := by unfold jonesFlow; rw [coeff_zero, one_smul]; abel  /-- O conteúdo se move, e exatamente assim (o análogo algébrico da derivada). -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.jonesFlow_sub_reading
head: theorem jonesFlow_sub_reading (e : A) (r s : ℝ) (x : A) : jonesFlow e r s x - jonesReading e x = coeff r s • (x - jonesReading e x) := by unfold jonesFlow; abel
doc: /-- O conteúdo se move, e exatamente assim (o análogo algébrico da derivada). -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.jonesFlow_add
head: theorem jonesFlow_add {e : A} (he : e * e = e) (r s t : ℝ) (x : A) : jonesFlow e r (s + t) x = jonesFlow e r s (jonesFlow e r t x) := by have hR : jonesReading e (jonesFlow e r t x) = jonesReading e x := stationary_jonesReading he r t x have hsub : jonesFlow e r t x - jonesReading e x = coeff r t • (x - jonesReading e x) := jonesFlow_sub_reading e r t x
doc: /-- SEMIGRUPO: `Φ_{s+t} = Φ_s ∘ Φ_t`. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.jonesFlow_fixed_iff
head: theorem jonesFlow_fixed_iff {e : A} (r s : ℝ) (hrs : r * s ≠ 0) (x : A) : jonesFlow e r s x = x ↔ jonesReading e x = x := by constructor · intro h
doc: /-- DINÂMICO: para `r s ≠ 0`, um estado só fica parado se já estava lido. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.jonesU
head: noncomputable def jonesU (e : A) (r s : ℝ) : A := e + coeff r s • (1 - e)  theorem proj_mul_jonesU {e : A} (he : e * e = e) (r s : ℝ) : e * jonesU e r s = e := by unfold jonesU
doc: /-- A face de Hilbert: a CONTRAÇÃO `U_s = e + e^{−r s}(1 − e)` (não é unitária; converge a `e`). -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.proj_mul_jonesU
head: theorem proj_mul_jonesU {e : A} (he : e * e = e) (r s : ℝ) : e * jonesU e r s = e := by unfold jonesU rw [mul_add, mul_smul_comm, mul_sub, mul_one, he, sub_self, smul_zero, add_zero]

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.jonesU_mul_proj
head: theorem jonesU_mul_proj {e : A} (he : e * e = e) (r s : ℝ) : jonesU e r s * e = e := by unfold jonesU rw [add_mul, smul_mul_assoc, sub_mul, one_mul, he, sub_self, smul_zero, add_zero]

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.jonesU_zero
head: theorem jonesU_zero (e : A) (r : ℝ) : jonesU e r 0 = 1 := by unfold jonesU; rw [coeff_zero, one_smul]; abel  theorem jonesU_add {e : A} (he : e * e = e) (r s t : ℝ) : jonesU e r (s + t) = jonesU e r s * jonesU e r t := by

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.jonesU_add
head: theorem jonesU_add {e : A} (he : e * e = e) (r s t : ℝ) : jonesU e r (s + t) = jonesU e r s * jonesU e r t := by have hq : (1 - e) * (1 - e) = 1 - e := by rw [sub_mul, one_mul, mul_sub, mul_one, he]; abel have heq : e * (1 - e) = 0 := by rw [mul_sub, mul_one, he, sub_self]

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.proj_jonesU_apply
head: theorem proj_jonesU_apply {H : Type} [AddCommGroup H] [Module A H] {e : A} (he : e * e = e) (r s : ℝ) (v : H) : e • (jonesU e r s • v) = e • v := by rw [smul_smul, proj_mul_jonesU he]
doc: /-- A leitura vetorial: `e (U_s v) = e v` — o estado se move, o que ele é lido como fica. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.rate_eq_weight
head: theorem rate_eq_weight (T : JonesTowerData N M Ext) : 1 / T.indexVal = T.markovWeight := by have h := T.index_eq_inverse_weight have hi : T.indexVal ≠ 0 := by intro h0; rw [h0, zero_mul] at h; exact zero_ne_one h
doc: /-- A taxa do índice é o peso de Markov: `1/índice = w` (de `índice · w = 1`, kernel; `w` genérico, não o β_TGL). -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.rate_pos
head: theorem rate_pos (T : JonesTowerData N M Ext) : 0 < 1 / T.indexVal := by rw [rate_eq_weight]; exact T.markovWeight_pos  /-- A ATUAÇÃO DO ÍNDICE sobre a torre: o fluxo com taxa `1/índice`. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.ialdFlow
head: noncomputable def ialdFlow (T : JonesTowerData N M Ext) (s : ℝ) (x : Ext) : Ext := jonesFlow T.eJones (1 / T.indexVal) s x  theorem iald_stationary (T : JonesTowerData N M Ext) (s : ℝ) (x : Ext) :
doc: /-- A ATUAÇÃO DO ÍNDICE sobre a torre: o fluxo com taxa `1/índice`. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.iald_stationary
head: theorem iald_stationary (T : JonesTowerData N M Ext) (s : ℝ) (x : Ext) : jonesReading T.eJones (ialdFlow T s x) = jonesReading T.eJones x := stationary_jonesReading T.eJones_idem _ s x

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.iald_semigroup
head: theorem iald_semigroup (T : JonesTowerData N M Ext) (s t : ℝ) (x : Ext) : ialdFlow T (s + t) x = ialdFlow T s (ialdFlow T t x) := jonesFlow_add T.eJones_idem _ s t x

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.iald_dynamic
head: theorem iald_dynamic (T : JonesTowerData N M Ext) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (x : Ext) : ialdFlow T s x = x ↔ jonesReading T.eJones x = x := jonesFlow_fixed_iff _ s (mul_pos (rate_pos T) hs).ne' x

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.iald_reads_the_expectation
head: theorem iald_reads_the_expectation (T : JonesTowerData N M Ext) (m : M) : jonesReading T.eJones (T.upper.incl m) = T.upper.incl (T.lower.incl (T.lower.E m)) * T.eJones := T.jones_relation m
doc: /-- A leitura de `M` É a esperança condicional sobre `N` (a relação de Jones do kernel). -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.iald_reads_the_index
head: theorem iald_reads_the_index (T : JonesTowerData N M Ext) : T.upper.E (jonesReading T.eJones 1) = ((T.markovWeight : ℝ) : ℂ) • (1 : M) ∧ T.indexVal * T.markovWeight = 1 := by refine ⟨?_, T.index_eq_inverse_weight⟩
doc: /-- O índice se lê do estado estacionário: `E₁(R 1) = w·1` e `índice · w = 1` (`w` = peso de Markov genérico). -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.eJones_ne_one
head: theorem eJones_ne_one (T : JonesTowerData N M Ext) [Nontrivial M] : T.eJones ≠ 1 := by intro h have h1 : ((T.markovWeight : ℝ) : ℂ) • (1 : M) = (1 : ℂ) • (1 : M) := by rw [← T.dual_expectation_jones, h, T.upper.E_unital, one_smul]
doc: /-- NÃO-VACUIDADE: a projeção de Jones nunca é a identidade (o peso é `< 1`). -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.iald_moves
head: theorem iald_moves (T : JonesTowerData N M Ext) [Nontrivial M] {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : ialdFlow T s 1 ≠ 1 := by intro h have h1 := (iald_dynamic T hs 1).mp h
doc: /-- A dinâmica nunca é trivial: para `s > 0`, o estado `1` se move. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.iald_hilbert_stationary
head: theorem iald_hilbert_stationary (T : JonesTowerData N M Ext) (s : ℝ) : T.eJones * jonesU T.eJones (1 / T.indexVal) s = T.eJones := proj_mul_jonesU T.eJones_idem _ s
doc: /-- A face de Hilbert da torre: `e·U_s = e`, com a taxa do índice. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.halfNat_rate
head: theorem halfNat_rate : 1 / halfNatJonesTower.indexVal = 1 / 2 := by show (1 : ℝ) / 2 = 1 / 2; rfl  /-- Na torre da Meia-Nat: estacionário, e a dinâmica é genuína (o estado `1` se move). -/
doc: /-- Na torre da Meia-Nat (peso 1/2, índice 2): a taxa é 1/2. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.halfNat_stationary_and_dynamic
head: theorem halfNat_stationary_and_dynamic {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : jonesReading halfNatJonesTower.eJones (ialdFlow halfNatJonesTower s 1) = jonesReading halfNatJonesTower.eJones 1 ∧ ialdFlow halfNatJonesTower s 1 ≠ 1 :=
doc: /-- Na torre da Meia-Nat: estacionário, e a dinâmica é genuína (o estado `1` se move). -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.halfNat_vector_stationary
head: theorem halfNat_vector_stationary (s : ℝ) (v : Fin 2 → ℂ) : (halfNatJonesTower.eJones * jonesU halfNatJonesTower.eJones (1 / halfNatJonesTower.indexVal) s).mulVec v = halfNatJonesTower.eJones.mulVec v := by rw [iald_hilbert_stationary]
doc: /-- Em ℂ² (o espaço de Hilbert em que M₂(ℂ) age): `e (U_s v) = e v` para todo vetor. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.spin
head: noncomputable def spin (r ω s : ℝ) : ℂ := coeff r s * Complex.exp (((ω * s : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)  theorem spin_add (r ω s t : ℝ) : spin r ω (s + t) = spin r ω s * spin r ω t := by unfold spin
doc: /-- O fator da espiral: decaimento (face) × giro (leitura). -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.spin_add
head: theorem spin_add (r ω s t : ℝ) : spin r ω (s + t) = spin r ω s * spin r ω t := by unfold spin rw [coeff_add] have h : (((ω * (s + t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.norm_spin
head: theorem norm_spin (r ω s : ℝ) : ‖spin r ω s‖ = Real.exp (-(r * s)) := by unfold spin coeff rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.orbit
head: noncomputable def orbit (P : V →ₗ[ℂ] V) (r ω s : ℝ) (v : V) : V := P v + spin r ω s • (v - P v)  theorem orbit_center {P : V →ₗ[ℂ] V} (hP : ∀ v, P (P v) = P v) (r ω s : ℝ) (v : V) : P (orbit P r ω s v) = P v := by
doc: /-- A órbita de um estado em torno do seu centro `P v`. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.orbit_center
head: theorem orbit_center {P : V →ₗ[ℂ] V} (hP : ∀ v, P (P v) = P v) (r ω s : ℝ) (v : V) : P (orbit P r ω s v) = P v := by unfold orbit rw [map_add, map_smul, map_sub, hP, sub_self, smul_zero, add_zero]

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.orbit_add
head: theorem orbit_add {P : V →ₗ[ℂ] V} (hP : ∀ v, P (P v) = P v) (r ω s t : ℝ) (v : V) : orbit P r ω (s + t) v = orbit P r ω s (orbit P r ω t v) := by have hR := orbit_center hP r ω t v have hsub : orbit P r ω t v - P v = spin r ω t • (v - P v) := by unfold orbit; abel

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.norm_orbit_sub_center
head: theorem norm_orbit_sub_center (P : V →ₗ[ℂ] V) (r ω s : ℝ) (v : V) : ‖orbit P r ω s v - P v‖ = Real.exp (-(r * s)) * ‖v - P v‖ := by have h : orbit P r ω s v - P v = spin r ω s • (v - P v) := by unfold orbit; abel rw [h, norm_smul, norm_spin]
doc: /-- Sob o domínio do índice: a distância ao centro cai EXATAMENTE como `e^{−rs}` (o giro não conta). -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.orbit_tendsto_center
head: theorem orbit_tendsto_center (P : V →ₗ[ℂ] V) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (ω : ℝ) (v : V) : Filter.Tendsto (fun s => orbit P r ω s v) Filter.atTop (nhds (P v)) := by rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero] simp_rw [norm_orbit_sub_center]
doc: /-- O ATRATOR: com taxa positiva, toda órbita converge ao centro, para qualquer giro ω. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.angular_orbit_no_limit
head: theorem angular_orbit_no_limit (P : V →ₗ[ℂ] V) (ω : ℝ) (v : V) (hv : v ≠ P v) : ¬ Filter.Tendsto (fun s => orbit P 0 ω s v) Filter.atTop (nhds (P v)) := by intro h rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero] at h
doc: /-- O limite NÃO nasce no regime angular: sem a taxa (r = 0), a órbita de um estado não lido fica à distância constante do centro e não converge a ele. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.angular_orbit_periodic
head: theorem angular_orbit_periodic (P : V →ₗ[ℂ] V) {ω : ℝ} (hω : ω ≠ 0) (s : ℝ) (v : V) : orbit P 0 ω (s + 2 * Real.pi / ω) v = orbit P 0 ω s v := by have h1 : spin 0 ω (2 * Real.pi / ω) = 1 := by unfold spin coeff
doc: /-- A geometria ORBITA: sem a taxa, a órbita é periódica (período 2π/ω). -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.center_is_fixed
head: theorem center_is_fixed (P : V →ₗ[ℂ] V) {r r' : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hr' : 0 < r') (ω ω' : ℝ) (v : V) : Filter.Tendsto (fun s => orbit P r ω s v) Filter.atTop (nhds (P v)) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun s => orbit P r' ω' s v) Filter.atTop (nhds (P v)) := ⟨orbit_tendsto_center P hr ω v, orbit_tendsto_center P hr' ω' v⟩
doc: /-- O centro é FIXO: não depende do giro nem da taxa — é o mesmo limite para toda órbita. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.halfNatP
head: noncomputable def halfNatP : (Fin 2 → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (Fin 2 → ℂ) := Matrix.mulVecLin halfNatJonesTower.eJones  theorem halfNatP_idem (v : Fin 2 → ℂ) : halfNatP (halfNatP v) = halfNatP v := by
doc: /-- A projeção de Jones da Meia-Nat agindo em ℂ² (o espaço de Hilbert da torre). -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.halfNatP_idem
head: theorem halfNatP_idem (v : Fin 2 → ℂ) : halfNatP (halfNatP v) = halfNatP v := by unfold halfNatP simp only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, halfNatJonesTower.eJones_idem]

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.halfNat_attractor
head: theorem halfNat_attractor (ω : ℝ) (v : Fin 2 → ℂ) : Filter.Tendsto (fun s => orbit halfNatP (1 / halfNatJonesTower.indexVal) ω s v) Filter.atTop (nhds (halfNatP v)) := orbit_tendsto_center halfNatP (rate_pos halfNatJonesTower) ω v
doc: /-- NA TORRE DA MEIA-NAT: sob o domínio do índice (taxa 1/índice = 1/2), toda órbita em ℂ² — com qualquer giro — cai no centro lido pela projeção de Jones. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDJones.halfNat_center_stationed
head: theorem halfNat_center_stationed (ω s : ℝ) (v : Fin 2 → ℂ) : halfNatP (orbit halfNatP (1 / halfNatJonesTower.indexVal) ω s v) = halfNatP v := orbit_center halfNatP_idem _ ω s v

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.V
head: abbrev V := Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ  /-- O estado fiel `ω(x) = Tr(ρx)`, `ρ = diag(w₀, w₁)`, normalizado: `ω(I) = 1`. -/ structure FaithfulState where
doc: /-- A forma padrão: `L²(M₂, Tr) = M₂(ℂ)`. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.FaithfulState
head: structure FaithfulState where w : Fin 2 → ℝ pos : ∀ i, 0 < w i norm : w 0 + w 1 = 1
doc: /-- O estado fiel `ω(x) = Tr(ρx)`, `ρ = diag(w₀, w₁)`, normalizado: `ω(I) = 1`. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.rhoM
head: noncomputable def rhoM : V := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((ρ.w i : ℝ) : ℂ))  /-- `Ω = ρ^{1/2}`. -/ noncomputable def Omega : V := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((Real.sqrt (ρ.w i) : ℝ) : ℂ))
doc: /-- `ρ` como matriz. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.Omega
head: noncomputable def Omega : V := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((Real.sqrt (ρ.w i) : ℝ) : ℂ))  /-- `ω(I) = ⟨Ω, Ω⟩ = Tr ρ = 1` — o axioma na face. -/ theorem omega_one : Matrix.trace ((Omega ρ)ᴴ * Omega ρ) = 1 := by

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.omega_one
head: theorem omega_one : Matrix.trace ((Omega ρ)ᴴ * Omega ρ) = 1 := by have h0 := ρ.pos 0; have h1 := ρ.pos 1 simp only [Omega, Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
doc: /-- `ω(I) = ⟨Ω, Ω⟩ = Tr ρ = 1` — o axioma na face. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.Delta
head: noncomputable def Delta (ξ : V) : V := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((ρ.w i : ℝ) : ℂ)) * ξ * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (((ρ.w i)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ))  /-- `Δ^{1/2} ξ = ρ^{1/2} ξ ρ^{−1/2}`. -/
doc: /-- O operador modular `Δξ = ρ ξ ρ⁻¹`. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.DeltaHalf
head: noncomputable def DeltaHalf (ξ : V) : V := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((Real.sqrt (ρ.w i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) * ξ * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (((Real.sqrt (ρ.w i))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ))

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.Jmod
head: def Jmod (ξ : V) : V := ξᴴ  theorem Delta_apply (ξ : V) (i j : Fin 2) : Delta ρ ξ i j = ((ρ.w i / ρ.w j : ℝ) : ℂ) * ξ i j := by
doc: /-- A conjugação modular `Jξ = ξᴴ`. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.Delta_apply
head: theorem Delta_apply (ξ : V) (i j : Fin 2) : Delta ρ ξ i j = ((ρ.w i / ρ.w j : ℝ) : ℂ) * ξ i j := by simp only [Delta, Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal] push_cast; ring

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.DeltaHalf_apply
head: theorem DeltaHalf_apply (ξ : V) (i j : Fin 2) : DeltaHalf ρ ξ i j = ((Real.sqrt (ρ.w i) / Real.sqrt (ρ.w j) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ξ i j := by simp only [DeltaHalf, Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal] push_cast; ring

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.DeltaHalf_sq
head: theorem DeltaHalf_sq (ξ : V) : DeltaHalf ρ (DeltaHalf ρ ξ) = Delta ρ ξ := by ext i j rw [DeltaHalf_apply, DeltaHalf_apply, Delta_apply, ← mul_assoc, ← Complex.ofReal_mul] congr 2

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.tomita_polar
head: theorem tomita_polar (x : V) : Jmod (DeltaHalf ρ (x * Omega ρ)) = xᴴ * Omega ρ := by ext i j have hi : Real.sqrt (ρ.w i) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (ρ.pos i)).ne' have hj : Real.sqrt (ρ.w j) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (ρ.pos j)).ne'
doc: /-- ★★ **A POLAR DE TOMITA**: `J Δ^{1/2}(xΩ) = xᴴ Ω` — isto é, `S = JΔ^{1/2}` com `S(xΩ) = x*Ω`: `Δ` É o operador modular do estado `ω`, não um nome. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.Kmod
head: noncomputable def Kmod (ξ : V) : V := Matrix.of fun i j => (((-(Real.log (ρ.w i) - Real.log (ρ.w j))) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ξ i j  /-- `K` é `−log` do multiplicador de `Δ`. -/
doc: /-- O hamiltoniano modular `K = −log Δ` (multiplicador de Schur). -/

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.Kmod_is_minus_log_Delta
head: theorem Kmod_is_minus_log_Delta (i j : Fin 2) : -(Real.log (ρ.w i) - Real.log (ρ.w j)) = -Real.log (ρ.w i / ρ.w j) := by rw [Real.log_div (ρ.pos i).ne' (ρ.pos j).ne']
doc: /-- `K` é `−log` do multiplicador de `Δ`. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.Ttgl
head: noncomputable def Ttgl (t : ℝ) (ξ : V) : V := Matrix.of fun i j => coeff |Real.log (ρ.w i) - Real.log (ρ.w j)| t * ξ i j  /-! ## Lado IALD: a projeção de Jones do centralizador -/
doc: /-- A dinâmica da TGL: o semigrupo subordinado de Poisson `T_t = e^{−t|K|}` (entrada a entrada). -/

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.Centralizer
head: def Centralizer (x : V) : Prop := x * rhoM ρ = rhoM ρ * x  /-- A projeção de Jones de `M^ω ⊂ M`: `eξ = diag(ξ)`. -/ def eJ : Module.End ℂ V where
doc: /-- O centralizador do estado: `M^ω = {x : xρ = ρx}`. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.eJ
head: def eJ : Module.End ℂ V where toFun ξ := Matrix.diagonal (Matrix.diag ξ) map_add' a b := by ext i j; simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply]; split_ifs <;> simp map_smul' c a := by ext i j; simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply]
doc: /-- A projeção de Jones de `M^ω ⊂ M`: `eξ = diag(ξ)`. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.eJ_apply
head: theorem eJ_apply (ξ : V) (i j : Fin 2) : eJ ξ i j = if i = j then ξ i j else 0 := by show Matrix.diagonal (Matrix.diag ξ) i j = _ rw [Matrix.diagonal_apply]; split_ifs with h · subst h; rfl

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.eJ_idem
head: theorem eJ_idem : eJ * eJ = eJ := by apply LinearMap.ext; intro ξ; ext i j show eJ (eJ ξ) i j = eJ ξ i j rw [eJ_apply]; split_ifs with h

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.eJ_selfadjoint
head: theorem eJ_selfadjoint (ξ η : V) : Matrix.trace (ξᴴ * eJ η) = Matrix.trace ((eJ ξ)ᴴ * η) := by simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, eJ_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
doc: /-- `e` é autoadjunta no produto de Hilbert–Schmidt `⟨ξ, η⟩ = Tr(ξᴴη)`: projeção ORTOGONAL. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.centralizer_iff_diag
head: theorem centralizer_iff_diag (hnt : ρ.w 0 ≠ ρ.w 1) (x : V) : Centralizer ρ x ↔ (x 0 1 = 0 ∧ x 1 0 = 0) := by have hc : ((ρ.w 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ ((ρ.w 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by exact_mod_cast hnt unfold Centralizer rhoM
doc: /-- Não tracial ⟹ o centralizador são as diagonais. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.eJ_range_is_centralizer_Omega
head: theorem eJ_range_is_centralizer_Omega (hnt : ρ.w 0 ≠ ρ.w 1) (ξ : V) : eJ ξ = ξ ↔ ∃ x, Centralizer ρ x ∧ ξ = x * Omega ρ := by have hs : ∀ i, Real.sqrt (ρ.w i) ≠ 0 := fun i => (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (ρ.pos i)).ne' constructor
doc: /-- ★★ **`e` É A PROJEÇÃO DE JONES DE `M^ω ⊂ M`**: `eξ = ξ ⟺ ξ ∈ M^ω Ω`. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.jonesU_apply
head: theorem jonesU_apply (r s : ℝ) (ξ : V) : jonesU (eJ : Module.End ℂ V) r s ξ = eJ ξ + coeff r s • (ξ - eJ ξ) := by simp [jonesU, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply]
doc: /-- O fluxo da IALD na face de Hilbert, aplicado: `U_s ξ = eξ + e^{−rs}(ξ − eξ)`. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.iald_fix_iff
head: theorem iald_fix_iff {r s : ℝ} (hrs : r * s ≠ 0) (ξ : V) : jonesU (eJ : Module.End ℂ V) r s ξ = ξ ↔ eJ ξ = ξ := by rw [jonesU_apply] have hc : coeff r s - 1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (coeff_ne_one hrs)
doc: /-! ## A ponte -/

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.off_diag_log_ne
head: theorem off_diag_log_ne (hnt : ρ.w 0 ≠ ρ.w 1) : Real.log (ρ.w 0) - Real.log (ρ.w 1) ≠ 0 := by intro h exact hnt (Real.log_injOn_pos (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (ρ.pos 0)) (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (ρ.pos 1)) (sub_eq_zero.mp h))

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.abs_log_pos
head: theorem abs_log_pos (hnt : ρ.w 0 ≠ ρ.w 1) (i j : Fin 2) (hij : i ≠ j) : 0 < |Real.log (ρ.w i) - Real.log (ρ.w j)| := by apply abs_pos.mpr fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.tgl_fix_iff
head: theorem tgl_fix_iff (hnt : ρ.w 0 ≠ ρ.w 1) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (ξ : V) : Ttgl ρ t ξ = ξ ↔ eJ ξ = ξ := by constructor · intro h

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.kerK_iff
head: theorem kerK_iff (hnt : ρ.w 0 ≠ ρ.w 1) (ξ : V) : Kmod ρ ξ = 0 ↔ eJ ξ = ξ := by constructor · intro h ext i j

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.the_bridge_fix
head: theorem the_bridge_fix (hnt : ρ.w 0 ≠ ρ.w 1) {r s t : ℝ} (hrs : r * s ≠ 0) (ht : 0 < t) (ξ : V) : (jonesU (eJ : Module.End ℂ V) r s ξ = ξ ↔ Ttgl ρ t ξ = ξ) ∧ (Ttgl ρ t ξ = ξ ↔ Kmod ρ ξ = 0) ∧ (Kmod ρ ξ = 0 ↔ ∃ x, Centralizer ρ x ∧ ξ = x * Omega ρ) := by
doc: /-- ★★★ **A PONTE — `Fix(D_IALD) = Fix(D_TGL) = ker K = ran e`.** O que a IALD (que lê o centralizador) deixa parado é exatamente o que o relógio modular da TGL não move. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.the_bridge_attractor
head: theorem the_bridge_attractor (hnt : ρ.w 0 ≠ ρ.w 1) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (ξ : V) (i j : Fin 2) : Filter.Tendsto (fun s => jonesU (eJ : Module.End ℂ V) r s ξ i j) Filter.atTop (nhds (eJ ξ i j)) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun t => Ttgl ρ t ξ i j) Filter.atTop (nhds (eJ ξ i j)) := by constructor
doc: /-- ★★★ **ρ*_IALD = ρ*_TGL — OS ATRATORES COINCIDEM.** Entrada a entrada, `U_s ξ → eξ` (s → ∞, r > 0) e `T_t ξ → eξ` (t → ∞): o limite das duas dinâmicas é a MESMA projeção `e`. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.E01
head: def E01 : V := Matrix.of ![![0, 1], ![0, 0]]  /-- ✗ **CONTROLE (i) — estado TRACIAL**: com `w₀ = w₁`, `K = 0` e `T_t = id`; a unidade fora da diagonal é fixa pela TGL e NÃO pela IALD da torre diagonal. No tracial a torre diagonal já não é a do centralizador
doc: /-- A unidade fora da diagonal. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.control_tracial
head: theorem control_tracial (htr : ρ.w 0 = ρ.w 1) {r s t : ℝ} (hrs : r * s ≠ 0) : Ttgl ρ t E01 = E01 ∧ ¬ jonesU (eJ : Module.End ℂ V) r s E01 = E01 := by have hw : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ρ.w i = ρ.w j := by intro i j; fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [htr]
doc: /-- ✗ **CONTROLE (i) — estado TRACIAL**: com `w₀ = w₁`, `K = 0` e `T_t = id`; a unidade fora da diagonal é fixa pela TGL e NÃO pela IALD da torre diagonal. No tracial a torre diagonal já não é a do centralizador (que é `M` inteiro, `e = 1`, dinâmica parada): a ponte NÃO-TRIVIAL exige o estado que distingue. -/

name: TGLExt.IALDRhoStar.eScalar

name: TGLExt.Lmul
head: def Lmul (a : Matrix n n ℂ) : Module.End ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) := LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ a  /-- Multiplicação à direita: a representação oposta (o candidato a comutante). -/ def Rmul (a : Matrix n n ℂ) : Module.End ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) := LinearMap.mulRight ℂ a

name: TGLExt.Rmul

doc: /-- Multiplicação à direita: a representação oposta (o candidato a comutante). -/

name: TGLExt.Lmul_apply
head: @[simp] theorem Lmul_apply (a x : Matrix n n ℂ) : Lmul a x = a * x := rfl @[simp] theorem Rmul_apply (a x : Matrix n n ℂ) : Rmul a x = x * a := rfl  /-- [KERNEL] `Lmul` e `Rmul` comutam (associatividade — a raiz de tudo). -/

name: TGLExt.Rmul_apply
head: @[simp] theorem Rmul_apply (a x : Matrix n n ℂ) : Rmul a x = x * a := rfl  /-- [KERNEL] `Lmul` e `Rmul` comutam (associatividade — a raiz de tudo). -/ theorem lmul_mul_rmul_comm (a b : Matrix n n ℂ) :

name: TGLExt.lmul_mul_rmul_comm
head: theorem lmul_mul_rmul_comm (a b : Matrix n n ℂ) : Lmul a * Rmul b = Rmul b * Lmul a := LinearMap.ext fun x => by simp [Module.End.mul_apply, mul_assoc]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] `Lmul` e `Rmul` comutam (associatividade — a raiz de tudo). -/

name: TGLExt.commutant_range_Lmul
head: theorem commutant_range_Lmul : commutantSet (Set.range (Lmul (n := n))) = Set.range (Rmul (n := n)) := by apply Set.Subset.antisymm · intro T hT
doc: /-- [KERNEL] O COMUTANTE CONCRETO: `L(Mₙ)′ = R(Mₙ)`. (Se `T` comuta com toda `Lmul a`, então `T = Rmul (T 1)`.) -/

name: TGLExt.commutant_range_Rmul
head: theorem commutant_range_Rmul : commutantSet (Set.range (Rmul (n := n))) = Set.range (Lmul (n := n)) := by apply Set.Subset.antisymm · intro T hT
doc: /-- [KERNEL] O simétrico: `R(Mₙ)′ = L(Mₙ)`. -/

name: TGLExt.bicommutant_range_Lmul
head: theorem bicommutant_range_Lmul : commutantSet (commutantSet (Set.range (Lmul (n := n)))) = Set.range (Lmul (n := n)) := by rw [commutant_range_Lmul, commutant_range_Rmul]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] O TEOREMA DO BICOMUTANTE (forma concreta): `L(Mₙ)′′ = L(Mₙ)`. A representação padrão da álgebra plena é seu próprio bicomutante — o caso concreto do teorema de von Neumann; o caso geral (subálgebras-* próprias de `Mₙ`) é a próxima pedra do Degrau 1. -/

name: TGLExt.Jconj
head: def Jconj (z : Matrix n n ℂ) : Matrix n n ℂ := zᴴ  omit [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] in @[simp] theorem Jconj_Jconj (z : Matrix n n ℂ) : Jconj (Jconj z) = z :=
doc: /-- A conjugação modular do estado tracial: `J z = zᴴ` (antilinear, involutiva). -/

name: TGLExt.Jconj_Jconj
head: @[simp] theorem Jconj_Jconj (z : Matrix n n ℂ) : Jconj (Jconj z) = z := conjTranspose_conjTranspose z  omit [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] in

name: TGLExt.Jconj_add
head: theorem Jconj_add (x y : Matrix n n ℂ) : Jconj (x + y) = Jconj x + Jconj y := conjTranspose_add x y  omit [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] in

name: TGLExt.Jconj_smul
head: theorem Jconj_smul (c : ℂ) (z : Matrix n n ℂ) : Jconj (c • z) = star c • Jconj z := by simp [Jconj]
doc: /-- `J` é ANTIlinear: `J(c • z) = c̄ • J z`. -/

name: TGLExt.frob
head: def frob (x y : Matrix n n ℂ) : ℂ := (xᴴ * y).trace  omit [DecidableEq n] in theorem frob_conj_symm (x y : Matrix n n ℂ) : frob y x = star (frob x y) := by
doc: /-- A forma de Frobenius `⟨x,y⟩ = Tr(xᴴ y)` — o produto interno GNS do traço. -/

name: TGLExt.frob_conj_symm
head: theorem frob_conj_symm (x y : Matrix n n ℂ) : frob y x = star (frob x y) := by show (yᴴ * x).trace = star ((xᴴ * y).trace) rw [← trace_conjTranspose, conjTranspose_mul, conjTranspose_conjTranspose]

name: TGLExt.frob_Jconj_Jconj
head: theorem frob_Jconj_Jconj (x y : Matrix n n ℂ) : frob (Jconj x) (Jconj y) = frob y x := by simp only [frob, Jconj, conjTranspose_conjTranspose] exact trace_mul_comm x yᴴ
doc: /-- [KERNEL] `J` é ANTIUNITÁRIO para a forma de Frobenius: `⟨Jx, Jy⟩ = ⟨y, x⟩`. -/

name: TGLExt.Jconj_Lmul_Jconj
head: theorem Jconj_Lmul_Jconj (a z : Matrix n n ℂ) : Jconj (Lmul a (Jconj z)) = Rmul aᴴ z := by simp [Jconj, conjTranspose_mul]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] `J L_a J = R_{aᴴ}`: a conjugação leva a álgebra ao comutante. A metade algébrica do TEOREMA DE TOMITA, em dimensão finita. -/

name: TGLExt.exists_Jconj_conj_Lmul
head: theorem exists_Jconj_conj_Lmul (b : Matrix n n ℂ) : ∃ a, ∀ z, Jconj (Lmul a (Jconj z)) = Rmul b z := ⟨bᴴ, fun z => by simp [Jconj, conjTranspose_mul]⟩
doc: /-- [KERNEL] `J M J = M′` na forma existencial: todo elemento de `M′ = R(Mₙ)` é conjugação `J (·) J` de um elemento de `M = L(Mₙ)`. -/

doc: /-- ★ o caractere compõe (a lei de grupo U(1), elevada à helicidade). -/

name: TGLExt.LightHelicity.photon_phase_ne_zero

name: TGLExt.LightHelicity.helicity_char_conjugation

doc: /-- ★★ a conjugação (a face PCT na polarização) leva o caractere de helicidade h ao de helicidade −h. -/

name: TGLExt.LightHelicity.helicity_screen_cocycle

name: TGLExt.light_inverts_the_gradient_preserving_structure

head: theorem mixed_weights_zero {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (i : Fin 2) : mixedWeights k 0 i = mixedBase k i := by rw [mixedWeights, mixed_z_zero hk] rfl

name: ChatgptAudit.MixedQuadraticGibbs.mixed_weights_first_jet
head: theorem mixed_weights_first_jet {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (i : Fin 2) : HasDerivAt (fun s => mixedWeights k s i) (signOutcome i / (2 * Real.cosh k ^ 2)) 0 := by have h := (((mixed_z_first_jet hk).const_mul (signOutcome i)).const_add 1).div_const 2

name: ChatgptAudit.MixedQuadraticGibbs.mixed_base_exp_formula
head: theorem mixed_base_exp_formula (k : ℝ) : mixedBase k 0 = Real.exp k / (Real.exp k + Real.exp (-k)) ∧ mixedBase k 1 = Real.exp (-k) / (Real.exp k + Real.exp (-k)) := by have hn : Real.exp k + Real.exp (-k) ≠ 0 :=

name: ChatgptAudit.MixedQuadraticGibbs.mixed_base_log_ratio
head: theorem mixed_base_log_ratio (k : ℝ) : Real.log (mixedBase k 1) - Real.log (mixedBase k 0) = -2*k := by rw [(mixed_base_exp_formula k).1, (mixed_base_exp_formula k).2] rw [Real.log_div (Real.exp_ne_zero _) (ne_of_gt (add_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (Real.exp_pos _))),

name: ChatgptAudit.MixedQuadraticGibbs.mixed_entropy_binary
head: theorem mixed_entropy_binary (k s : ℝ) : finiteEntropy (mixedWeights k s) = Real.binEntropy (mixedWeights k s 0) := by have he : mixedWeights k s = siteW (mixedWeights k s 0) := by funext i

name: ChatgptAudit.MixedQuadraticGibbs.mixed_entropy_first_jet
head: theorem mixed_entropy_first_jet {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) : HasDerivAt (fun s => finiteEntropy (mixedWeights k s)) (-k / Real.cosh k ^ 2) 0 := by have hq := mixed_weights_first_jet hk 0

name: ChatgptAudit.MixedQuadraticGibbs.derivative_quadratic_clock_limit
head: theorem derivative_quadratic_clock_limit (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a velocity : ℝ) (hf : HasDerivAt f a 0) : Tendsto (fun t => (f (velocity^2*t^2)-f 0)/t^2) (𝓝[<] 0) (𝓝 (a*velocity^2)) := by by_cases hv : velocity = 0

name: ChatgptAudit.MixedQuadraticGibbs.quadraticWeights
head: def quadraticWeights (k velocity t : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ := mixedWeights k (velocity^2*t^2)  theorem quadratic_weights_smooth {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (velocity : ℝ) (i : Fin 2) :

name: ChatgptAudit.MixedQuadraticGibbs.quadratic_weights_smooth
head: theorem quadratic_weights_smooth {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (velocity : ℝ) (i : Fin 2) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun t => quadraticWeights k velocity t i) := (mixed_weights_smooth hk i).comp (contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_id.pow 2))

name: ChatgptAudit.MixedQuadraticGibbs.quadratic_weights_first_jet
head: theorem quadratic_weights_first_jet {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (velocity : ℝ) (i : Fin 2) : HasDerivAt (fun t => quadraticWeights k velocity t i) 0 0 := by have ho : HasDerivAt (fun s => mixedWeights k s i) (signOutcome i / (2 * Real.cosh k ^ 2)) (velocity^2*(0 : ℝ)^2) := by

name: ChatgptAudit.MixedQuadraticGibbs.mixedCurve
head: def mixedCurve (k : ℝ) (hk : 0 < k) (velocity : ℝ) : DiagonalStateCurve (mixedBase k) where weights := quadraticWeights k velocity tangent := fun t i => deriv (fun s => quadraticWeights k velocity s i) t

name: ChatgptAudit.MixedQuadraticGibbs.quadratic_tangent_zero
head: theorem quadratic_tangent_zero {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (velocity : ℝ) : (mixedCurve k hk velocity).tangent 0 = 0 := by funext i exact (quadratic_weights_first_jet hk velocity i).deriv

name: ChatgptAudit.MixedQuadraticGibbs.quadratic_fisher_zero
head: theorem quadratic_fisher_zero {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (velocity : ℝ) : diagonalFisher (mixedBase k) ((mixedCurve k hk velocity).tangent 0) = 0 := by simp [quadratic_tangent_zero, diagonalFisher]

name: ChatgptAudit.MixedQuadraticGibbs.quadratic_relative_entropy_limit
head: theorem quadratic_relative_entropy_limit {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (velocity : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun t => diagonalRelativeEntropy (quadraticWeights k velocity t) (mixedBase k) / t^2) (𝓝[<] 0) (𝓝 0) := by have h := relative_entropy_curve_quadratic_limit (mixedCurve k hk velocity)

name: ChatgptAudit.MixedQuadraticGibbs.quadratic_entropy_limit
head: theorem quadratic_entropy_limit {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (velocity : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun t => (finiteEntropy (quadraticWeights k velocity t) - finiteEntropy (mixedBase k)) / t^2) (𝓝[<] 0) (𝓝 (-k / Real.cosh k ^ 2 * velocity^2)) := by

name: ChatgptAudit.MixedQuadraticGibbs.quadratic_modular_increment_limit
head: theorem quadratic_modular_increment_limit {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (velocity : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun t => modularIncrement (mixedBase k) (quadraticWeights k velocity t) / t^2) (𝓝[<] 0) (𝓝 (-k / Real.cosh k ^ 2 * velocity^2)) := by have h := (quadratic_relative_entropy_limit hk velocity).add (quadratic_entropy_limit hk velocity)

name: ChatgptAudit.MixedQuadraticGibbs.mixed_response_coefficient_negative
head: theorem mixed_response_coefficient_negative {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) : -k / Real.cosh k ^ 2 < 0 := div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (neg_lt_zero.mpr hk) (sq_pos_of_pos (Real.cosh_pos k))

name: ModularCornerCounterexample.M2
head: abbrev M2 := Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ def p : M2 := !![1,0;0,0] /-- A selfadjoint Pauli generator, unitarily equivalent to sigma_x. -/ def residual : M2 := Complex.I • Grot

name: ModularCornerCounterexample.p
head: def p : M2 := !![1,0;0,0] /-- A selfadjoint Pauli generator, unitarily equivalent to sigma_x. -/ def residual : M2 := Complex.I • Grot def flow (s : ℝ) : M2 := exp ((-(s : ℂ)*Complex.I) • residual)

name: ModularCornerCounterexample.residual
head: def residual : M2 := Complex.I • Grot def flow (s : ℝ) : M2 := exp ((-(s : ℂ)*Complex.I) • residual)  theorem p_projection : p*p=p ∧ pᴴ=p := by
doc: /-- A selfadjoint Pauli generator, unitarily equivalent to sigma_x. -/

name: ModularCornerCounterexample.flow
head: def flow (s : ℝ) : M2 := exp ((-(s : ℂ)*Complex.I) • residual)  theorem p_projection : p*p=p ∧ pᴴ=p := by constructor <;> ext i j <;> fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>

name: ModularCornerCounterexample.p_projection
head: theorem p_projection : p*p=p ∧ pᴴ=p := by constructor <;> ext i j <;> fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [p,Matrix.mul_apply,Fin.sum_univ_two,Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]

name: ModularCornerCounterexample.residual_selfadjoint
head: theorem residual_selfadjoint : residualᴴ=residual := by rw [residual, Matrix.conjTranspose_smul, Grot_conjTranspose] simp

name: ModularCornerCounterexample.compressed_generator_zero
head: theorem compressed_generator_zero : p*residual*p=0 := by ext i j fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [p,residual,Grot,Matrix.mul_apply,Fin.sum_univ_two]

name: ModularCornerCounterexample.residual_nonzero
head: theorem residual_nonzero : residual ≠ 0 := by intro h have hh := congrArg (fun a : M2 => a 0 1) h simp [residual,Grot] at hh

name: ModularCornerCounterexample.flow_eq
head: theorem flow_eq (s : ℝ) : flow s=Smat s := by unfold flow residual rw [smul_smul] have h : (-(s : ℂ)*Complex.I)*Complex.I = (s : ℂ) := by
doc: /-- Reuses the existing matrix-S exponential theorem; no new evolution postulate. -/

name: ModularCornerCounterexample.compressed_flow
head: theorem compressed_flow (s : ℝ) : p*flow s*p=(Real.cos s : ℂ) • p := by rw [flow_eq,Smat_eq] ext i j fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>

name: ModularCornerCounterexample.compressed_flow_half_turn
head: theorem compressed_flow_half_turn : p*flow (Real.pi/2)*p=0 := by rw [compressed_flow,Real.cos_pi_div_two,Complex.ofReal_zero,zero_smul]  theorem p_nonzero : p ≠ 0 := by

name: ModularCornerCounterexample.p_nonzero
head: theorem p_nonzero : p ≠ 0 := by intro h have hh := congrArg (fun a : M2 => a 0 0) h simp [p] at hh

name: ModularCornerCounterexample.compression_does_not_control_flow
head: theorem compression_does_not_control_flow : p*residual*p=0 ∧ p*flow (Real.pi/2)*p ≠ p := by exact ⟨compressed_generator_zero, by rw [compressed_flow_half_turn]; exact Ne.symm p_nonzero⟩

name: ModularCornerCounterexample.half_turn_leaves_corner
head: theorem half_turn_leaves_corner : flow (Real.pi/2)*p*(flow (Real.pi/2))ᴴ=1-p := by rw [flow_eq,Smat_eq] ext i j

name: ModularCornerCounterexample.corner_not_invariant
head: theorem corner_not_invariant : flow (Real.pi/2)*p*(flow (Real.pi/2))ᴴ ≠ p := by rw [half_turn_leaves_corner] intro h

name: ChatgptAudit.Cost054.omegaRealContinuous
head: def omegaRealContinuous (P : SiteProfile) : (TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P) →L[ℝ] ℝ := Complex.reCLM.comp ((omegaContinuous P).restrictScalars ℝ)
doc: /-- The real expectation is a continuous real-linear functional. -/

name: ChatgptAudit.Cost054.omega_real_continuous_apply
head: theorem omega_real_continuous_apply (P : SiteProfile) (B : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P) : omegaRealContinuous P B = (omegaState P B).re := rfl

name: ChatgptAudit.Cost054.bounded_phase_negative_generator
head: theorem bounded_phase_negative_generator (P : SiteProfile) (A : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P) (t : ℝ) : boundedPhase P (-A) t = boundedPhase P A (-t) := by simp only [boundedPhase, Complex.ofReal_neg, neg_mul, neg_smul, smul_neg]

name: ChatgptAudit.Cost054.negative_phase_derivative
head: theorem negative_phase_derivative (P : SiteProfile) (A : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P) (t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => boundedPhase P A (-s)) (-(boundedPhase P A (-t) * (Complex.I • A))) t := by

name: ChatgptAudit.Cost054.unitaryConjugationVelocity
head: def unitaryConjugationVelocity (P : SiteProfile) (A B : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P) (t : ℝ) : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P := -(boundedPhase P A (-t) * (Complex.I • A) * B * boundedPhase P A t) +
doc: /-- Product-rule velocity; no derivative is taken as a definition of the cost. -/

name: ChatgptAudit.Cost054.unitary_conjugation_has_derivative
head: theorem unitary_conjugation_has_derivative (P : SiteProfile) (A B : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P) (hA : IsSelfAdjoint A) (t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (unitaryConjugation P A B) (unitaryConjugationVelocity P A B t) t := by have h := ((negative_phase_derivative P A t).mul_const B).mul

name: ChatgptAudit.Cost054.doubleModularCommutator
head: def doubleModularCommutator (P : SiteProfile) (A B : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P) : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P := -(A * A * B) + A * B * A + A * B * A - B * (A * A)
doc: /-- Minus the double commutator [A,[A,B]]. -/

name: ChatgptAudit.Cost054.unitary_velocity_derivative_zero
head: theorem unitary_velocity_derivative_zero (P : SiteProfile) (A B : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P) : HasDerivAt (unitaryConjugationVelocity P A B) (doubleModularCommutator P A B) 0 := by let C := Complex.I • A

name: ChatgptAudit.Cost054.unitaryEnergy
head: def unitaryEnergy (P : SiteProfile) (A B : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P) (t : ℝ) : ℝ := (omegaState P (unitaryConjugation P A B t)).re

name: ChatgptAudit.Cost054.unitaryEnergyVelocity
head: def unitaryEnergyVelocity (P : SiteProfile) (A B : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P) (t : ℝ) : ℝ := (omegaState P (unitaryConjugationVelocity P A B t)).re

name: ChatgptAudit.Cost054.unitary_energy_derivative
head: theorem unitary_energy_derivative (P : SiteProfile) (A B : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P) (hA : IsSelfAdjoint A) (t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (unitaryEnergy P A B) (unitaryEnergyVelocity P A B t) t := by have h := (omegaRealContinuous P).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t

name: ChatgptAudit.Cost054.unitary_energy_velocity_zero
head: theorem unitary_energy_velocity_zero (P : SiteProfile) (A B : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P) : unitaryEnergyVelocity P A B 0 = (Complex.I * omegaState P (B*A-A*B)).re := by have h : unitaryConjugationVelocity P A B 0 = Complex.I • (B*A-A*B) := by

name: ChatgptAudit.Cost054.unitary_energy_velocity_derivative
head: theorem unitary_energy_velocity_derivative (P : SiteProfile) (A B : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P) : HasDerivAt (unitaryEnergyVelocity P A B) (omegaState P (doubleModularCommutator P A B)).re 0 := by

name: ChatgptAudit.Cost054.unitary_energy_second_derivative
head: theorem unitary_energy_second_derivative (P : SiteProfile) (A B : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P) (hA : IsSelfAdjoint A) : HasDerivAt (deriv (unitaryEnergy P A B)) (omegaState P (doubleModularCommutator P A B)).re 0 := by

name: ChatgptAudit.Cost054.quadratic_response_from_velocity
head: theorem quadratic_response_from_velocity (f v : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hf : ∀ t, HasDerivAt f (v t) t) (hv : HasDerivAt v c 0) (hv0 : v 0=0) : Tendsto (fun t => (f t-f 0)/t^2) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 (c/2)) := by have hvs : Tendsto (fun t => v t/t) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 c) := by
doc: /-- Second-order response from actual derivatives, with the factor one half explicit. -/

name: ChatgptAudit.Cost054.localModularMatrix
head: def localModularMatrix (P : SiteProfile) (N : ℕ) : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((-Real.log (towerW P N i) : ℝ) : ℂ))

name: ChatgptAudit.Cost054.localModularObservable
head: def localModularObservable (P : SiteProfile) (N : ℕ) : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P := towerPi P (localModularMatrix P N)

name: ChatgptAudit.Cost054.finiteModularEnergy
head: def finiteModularEnergy (P : SiteProfile) (N : ℕ) (a : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : ℝ → ℝ := unitaryEnergy P (towerPi P a) (localModularObservable P N)

name: ChatgptAudit.Cost054.local_modular_matrix_hermitian
head: theorem local_modular_matrix_hermitian (P : SiteProfile) (N : ℕ) : (localModularMatrix P N).IsHermitian := by ext i j by_cases h : i=j

name: ChatgptAudit.Cost054.local_modular_commutator_state
head: theorem local_modular_commutator_state (P : SiteProfile) (N : ℕ) (a : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : omegaState P (localModularObservable P N * towerPi P a - towerPi P a * localModularObservable P N)=0 := by

name: ChatgptAudit.Cost054.finite_modular_energy_first_zero
head: theorem finite_modular_energy_first_zero (P : SiteProfile) (N : ℕ) (a : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) (ha : a.IsHermitian) : HasDerivAt (finiteModularEnergy P N a) 0 0 := by have h := unitary_energy_derivative P (towerPi P a) (localModularObservable P N)

name: ChatgptAudit.Cost054.local_modular_double_coefficient
head: theorem local_modular_double_coefficient (P : SiteProfile) (N : ℕ) (a : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) (ha : a.IsHermitian) : (omegaState P (doubleModularCommutator P (towerPi P a) (localModularObservable P N))).re = 2 * localModularCost P N a := by

name: ChatgptAudit.Cost054.finite_modular_energy_second
head: theorem finite_modular_energy_second (P : SiteProfile) (N : ℕ) (a : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) (ha : a.IsHermitian) : HasDerivAt (deriv (finiteModularEnergy P N a)) (2*localModularCost P N a) 0 := by simpa only [finiteModularEnergy, local_modular_double_coefficient P N a ha] using

name: ChatgptAudit.Cost054.finite_modular_energy_quadratic_limit
head: theorem finite_modular_energy_quadratic_limit (P : SiteProfile) (N : ℕ) (a : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) (ha : a.IsHermitian) : Tendsto (fun t => (finiteModularEnergy P N a t-finiteModularEnergy P N a 0)/t^2) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 (localModularCost P N a)) := by

name: ChatgptAudit.Cost054.global_cost_is_modular_response
head: theorem global_cost_is_modular_response (P : SiteProfile) (N : ℕ) (a : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) (ha : a.IsHermitian) : towerModularCost P (towerPi P a (hOmega P)) = ENNReal.ofReal (deriv (deriv (finiteModularEnergy P N a)) 0/2) := by
doc: /-- The extended global cost equals half the actual local energy second derivative. -/

name: TGLExt.faceOne
head: def faceOne : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ := !![1, 0; 0, 0]  /-- a face `P_0` (o "0_mod" da fronteira). -/ def faceZero : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ := !![0, 0; 0, 1]
doc: /-- a face `P_1` (o "1" da fronteira). -/

name: TGLExt.faceZero
head: def faceZero : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ := !![0, 0; 0, 1]  /-- o portador de contraste `Z_∂ = P_1 − P_0` (auto-conjugado, `Z_∂² = 1`). -/ def contrast : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ := !![1, 0; 0, -1]
doc: /-- a face `P_0` (o "0_mod" da fronteira). -/

name: TGLExt.contrast
head: def contrast : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ := !![1, 0; 0, -1]  /-- ★ a CORRENTE J: o operador ímpar `L` que cruza o contorno mudando de face (a isometria parcial de Bell). -/
doc: /-- o portador de contraste `Z_∂ = P_1 − P_0` (auto-conjugado, `Z_∂² = 1`). -/

name: TGLExt.modularCurrent
head: def modularCurrent : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ := !![0, 1; 0, 0]  /-! ## B — os teoremas da corrente -/
doc: /-- ★ a CORRENTE J: o operador ímpar `L` que cruza o contorno mudando de face (a isometria parcial de Bell). -/

name: TGLExt.contrast_is_faces
head: theorem contrast_is_faces : contrast = faceOne - faceZero := by ext i j; fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [contrast, faceOne, faceZero, Matrix.sub_apply]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] `Z_∂ = P_1 − P_0`: o contraste é a diferença das faces. -/

name: TGLExt.contrast_involution
head: theorem contrast_involution : contrast * contrast = 1 := by ext i j; fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [contrast, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] `Z_∂² = 1`: o portador de contraste é uma involução. -/

name: TGLExt.current_anticommutes
head: theorem current_anticommutes : contrast * modularCurrent + modularCurrent * contrast = 0 := by ext i j; fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [contrast, modularCurrent, Matrix.add_apply]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ `{Z_∂, L} = 0`: A ANTICOMUTAÇÃO DE BELL — a corrente J cruza o contorno MUDANDO DE FACE (o Um só atravessa invertendo a paridade). -/

name: TGLExt.current_source
head: theorem current_source : modularCurrentᴴ * modularCurrent = faceZero := by ext i j; fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [modularCurrent, faceZero, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ `L* L = P_0`: a corrente J leva a face `P_0` em si (o domínio da isometria parcial). -/

name: TGLExt.current_range
head: theorem current_range : modularCurrent * modularCurrentᴴ = faceOne := by ext i j; fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [modularCurrent, faceOne, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ `L L* = P_1`: a corrente J leva ao alcance `P_1` — junto com `current_source`, `L` IMPLEMENTA a equivalência `P_0 ∼ P_1`. -/

name: TGLExt.faces_ne
head: theorem faces_ne : faceOne ≠ faceZero := by intro h have := congrFun (congrFun h 0) 0 simp [faceOne, faceZero] at this
doc: /-- [KERNEL] as faces são DISTINTAS na álgebra. -/

name: TGLExt.current_implements_boundary_equivalence
head: theorem current_implements_boundary_equivalence : (contrast * modularCurrent + modularCurrent * contrast = 0) ∧ (modularCurrentᴴ * modularCurrent = faceZero) ∧ (modularCurrent * modularCurrentᴴ = faceOne)
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★★ A CORRENTE J IMPLEMENTA A EQUIVALÊNCIA DE FRONTEIRA: existe a corrente `L` (ímpar, `{Z_∂,L}=0`) que implementa `P_1 ∼_∂ P_0` (`L*L=P_0`, `LL*=P_1`), enquanto `P_1 ≠ P_0` na álgebra. É o defeito de fronteira `1 = 0_mod = verdade_∂` — a assinatura do tipo III em kernel: projeções DISTINTAS mas EQUIVALENTES pela corrente modular. -/

name: ModularDephasingBridge.spectral_preserves_every_diagonal
head: theorem spectral_preserves_every_diagonal (d : n → ℝ) (v : n → ℂ) : specExpect d (diagonal v) = diagonal v := by ext i j by_cases h : i = j

name: ModularDephasingBridge.spectral_preserves_density
head: theorem spectral_preserves_density (d : n → ℝ) : specExpect d (rhoD d) = rhoD d := spectral_preserves_every_diagonal d _

name: ModularDephasingBridge.spectral_preserves_modular_generator
head: theorem spectral_preserves_modular_generator (d : n → ℝ) (hd : ∀ i, 0 < d i) : specExpect d (-logRho (rhoD d)) = -logRho (rhoD d) := by rw [logRho_diagonal d hd, diagonal_neg] exact spectral_preserves_every_diagonal d _

name: ModularDephasingBridge.spectral_reading_is_stationary
head: theorem spectral_reading_is_stationary (d : n → ℝ) (hd : ∀ i, 0 < d i) (alpha : ℝ → Matrix n n ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ) : (∀ t x, sigma (rhoD d) t (specExpect d x) = alpha t (specExpect d x)) ↔ (∀ t x, alpha t (specExpect d x) = specExpect d x) := by

name: ModularDephasingBridge.spectral_preserves_remainder_balance
head: theorem spectral_preserves_remainder_balance (d : n → ℝ) (hd : ∀ i, 0 < d i) (Q R : Matrix n n ℂ) (h : -logRho (rhoD d) = Q + R) : -logRho (rhoD d) = specExpect d Q + specExpect d R := by have hp := spectral_preserves_modular_generator d hd

name: ModularDephasingBridge.stationary_generator_balance
head: theorem stationary_generator_balance {A : Type*} [Ring A] (K Q R X : A) (h : K = Q + R) (hK : Commute K X) : Q * X - X * Q = -(R * X - X * R) := by have hc : (Q + R) * X = X * (Q + R) := by simpa [h] using hK.eq

O elo central da cadeia de Jacobson (δQ = TδS), que o form-check v5 media a 1e-15, como teorema. -/

doc: /-- [KERNEL] A COMPOSIÇÃO DE CLAUSIUS: dados a primeira lei (δS = δ⟨K⟩), a temperatura modular de Unruh (T = 1/2π, v47) e a relação de Clausius (δQ = T·δS), segue `δQ = (1/2π)·δ⟨K⟩` — o lado termodinâmico-modular da cadeia de Jacobson, com cada hipótese apontando para seu teorema de kernel (v51/v47) ou seu estatuto. -/

doc: /-! ## F1–F2: identidade e lei de grupo -/

head: def permanent {n : ℕ} (β : ℝ) (d : Fin n → ℝ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) : Prop := ∀ t : ℝ, diagFlow β d t x = x  /-! ## A — a dupla negação: o ponto fixo é o que o fluxo nega não ser -/

doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★ A DUPLA NEGAÇÃO: x permanece ⟺ x vive onde a negação do fluxo não alcança (o kernel). O ponto fixo é tudo aquilo que o observador nega não ser. (Reuso direto da pedra 98.) -/

doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★★ A FALSIDADE DE GÊNERO: se o gradiente é estritamente negativo em TODA direção (sem kernel), o único permanente é 0 — o predicado de permanência é trivial e não há observador interno. doc: /-- [KERNEL] O CONTROLE NEGATIVO: candidatos que falham o padrão EXISTEM (perfil d ≡ 1) — a falsidade de gênero não é vácua. -/

doc: /-- [KERNEL] o observador é idempotente: ler a leitura é a leitura. -/

name: TGLExt.OrientedFace.Face
head: inductive Face where | coupling : Face | mirror : Face
doc: /-- As duas faces da fronteira modular: aquela em que o acoplamento age e o espelho dela. -/

name: TGLExt.OrientedFace.OrientedResponse
head: structure OrientedResponse where delta : ℝ delta_nonneg : 0 ≤ delta delta_lt_one : delta < 1
doc: /-- Os dados da orientação: a amplitude da resposta na face do acoplamento, a paridade inversa (o espelho inverte o gerador) e a primeira lei modular lida na face do acoplamento. -/

name: TGLExt.OrientedFace.increment
head: def increment (R : OrientedResponse) : Face → ℝ | Face.coupling => R.gen | Face.mirror => R.mirrorGen
doc: /-- O incremento de entropia por área lido na face que FECHA o balanço de Clausius. -/

name: TGLExt.OrientedFace.increment_coupling
head: theorem increment_coupling (R : OrientedResponse) : increment R Face.coupling = R.delta := R.firstLaw  /-- [KERNEL] ★ a paridade inversa em ato: na face espelhada o incremento é o oposto. -/
doc: /-- [KERNEL] na face do acoplamento o incremento é a própria resposta (primeira lei). -/

name: TGLExt.OrientedFace.increment_mirror
head: theorem increment_mirror (R : OrientedResponse) : increment R Face.mirror = -R.delta := by show R.mirrorGen = -R.delta rw [R.parity, R.firstLaw]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ a paridade inversa em ato: na face espelhada o incremento é o oposto. -/

name: TGLExt.OrientedFace.phiOf
head: noncomputable def phiOf (R : OrientedResponse) (f : Face) : ℝ := (1 + increment R f)⁻¹  theorem phi_coupling (R : OrientedResponse) : phiOf R Face.coupling = (1 + R.delta)⁻¹ := by rw [phiOf, increment_coupling]
doc: /-- O Φ da pedra B4 lido da face que fecha o balanço: dS = dA(1 + s)/(4G) = dA/(4GΦ). -/

name: TGLExt.OrientedFace.phi_coupling
head: theorem phi_coupling (R : OrientedResponse) : phiOf R Face.coupling = (1 + R.delta)⁻¹ := by rw [phiOf, increment_coupling]  theorem phi_mirror (R : OrientedResponse) : phiOf R Face.mirror = (1 - R.delta)⁻¹ := by

name: TGLExt.OrientedFace.phi_mirror
head: theorem phi_mirror (R : OrientedResponse) : phiOf R Face.mirror = (1 - R.delta)⁻¹ := by rw [phiOf, increment_mirror] ring_nf

name: TGLExt.OrientedFace.phi_coupling_lt_one
head: theorem phi_coupling_lt_one (R : OrientedResponse) (h : 0 < R.delta) : phiOf R Face.coupling < 1 := by have h1 : (0:ℝ) < 1 + R.delta := by linarith have h2 : (1 + R.delta)⁻¹ * (1 + R.delta) = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ h1.ne'
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ a face do acoplamento enfraquece a gravidade: Φ < 1. -/

name: TGLExt.OrientedFace.one_lt_phi_mirror
head: theorem one_lt_phi_mirror (R : OrientedResponse) (h : 0 < R.delta) : 1 < phiOf R Face.mirror := by have h1 : (0:ℝ) < 1 - R.delta := by linarith [R.delta_lt_one] have h2 : (1 - R.delta)⁻¹ * (1 - R.delta) = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ h1.ne'
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ a face espelhada reforça a gravidade: Φ > 1 (é o que o programa implementou). -/

name: TGLExt.OrientedFace.phi_gap
head: theorem phi_gap (R : OrientedResponse) (h : 0 < R.delta) : phiOf R Face.mirror - phiOf R Face.coupling = 2*R.delta/(1 - R.delta^2) := by have h1 : (1:ℝ) + R.delta ≠ 0 := by linarith have h2 : (1:ℝ) - R.delta ≠ 0 := by linarith [R.delta_lt_one]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] a distância exata entre as duas leituras: 2δ/(1 − δ²). -/

name: TGLExt.OrientedFace.mirror_is_one_plus_delta_to_first_order
head: theorem mirror_is_one_plus_delta_to_first_order (R : OrientedResponse) : phiOf R Face.mirror = 1 + R.delta + R.delta^2/(1 - R.delta) := by have h2 : (1:ℝ) - R.delta ≠ 0 := by linarith [R.delta_lt_one] rw [phi_mirror]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★ o fator implementado (1 + δ) é a face ESPELHADA em primeira ordem, com o resto nomeado δ²/(1 − δ). -/

name: TGLExt.OrientedFace.coupling_is_minus_delta_to_first_order
head: theorem coupling_is_minus_delta_to_first_order (R : OrientedResponse) (h : 0 < R.delta) : phiOf R Face.coupling = 1 - R.delta + R.delta^2/(1 + R.delta) := by have h1 : (1:ℝ) + R.delta ≠ 0 := by linarith rw [phi_coupling]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★ a face do ACOPLAMENTO é, em primeira ordem, a troca δ ↦ −δ, com o resto nomeado δ²/(1 + δ). -/

name: TGLExt.OrientedFace.orientation_is_the_sign
head: theorem orientation_is_the_sign (R : OrientedResponse) (h : 0 < R.delta) : phiOf R Face.coupling < 1 ∧ 1 < phiOf R Face.mirror ∧ phiOf R Face.mirror - phiOf R Face.coupling = 2*R.delta/(1 - R.delta^2) := ⟨phi_coupling_lt_one R h, one_lt_phi_mirror R h, phi_gap R h⟩
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★★ A ORIENTAÇÃO É O SINAL: escolher a face que fecha o balanço é escolher de que lado de 1 cai o fator da métrica, e as duas leituras distam 2δ/(1 − δ²). -/

name: TGLExt.OrientedFace.balance_on_the_state_face
head: theorem balance_on_the_state_face (R : OrientedResponse) (h : 0 < R.delta) : increment R Face.coupling = R.delta ∧ phiOf R Face.coupling < 1 ∧ phiOf R Face.coupling = 1 - R.delta + R.delta^2/(1 + R.delta) := ⟨increment_coupling R, phi_coupling_lt_one R h, coupling_is_minus_delta_to_first_order R h⟩
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★★ O RAMO DO ESTADO: se o balanço fecha na face em que a primeira lei foi lida — a face onde vive a matriz de densidade, antes da conjugação —, então o fator da métrica é MENOR que 1 e é, em primeira ordem, a troca δ ↦ −δ, com o resto nomeado δ²/(1 + δ). [A escolha da face continua sendo o BIT de entrada; este teorema diz o que ela implica.] -/

name: TGLExt.OrientedFace.balance_on_the_conjugate_face
head: theorem balance_on_the_conjugate_face (R : OrientedResponse) (h : 0 < R.delta) : increment R Face.mirror = -R.delta ∧ 1 < phiOf R Face.mirror ∧ phiOf R Face.mirror = 1 + R.delta + R.delta^2/(1 - R.delta) := ⟨increment_mirror R, one_lt_phi_mirror R h, mirror_is_one_plus_delta_to_first_order R⟩
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★ O RAMO CONJUGADO: se o balanço fecha na face conjugada, o incremento entra com o sinal oposto (paridade) e o fator é MAIOR que 1 — é o ramo que o programa implementou. -/

name: TGLExt.OrientedFace.friedmann_of_face
head: theorem friedmann_of_face (R : OrientedResponse) (f : Face) (H : ℝ → ℝ) (t G enthalpy : ℝ) (D : HubbleHorizonInput H t G (phiOf R f) enthalpy) : deriv H t = -4*Real.pi*G*(phiOf R f)*enthalpy := tgl_second_friedmann_from_clausius H t G (phiOf R f) enthalpy D
doc: /-- [KERNEL] a ponte com a B4: com o Φ da face escolhida, a segunda equação de Friedmann sai do balanço de Clausius já existente — a pedra nova não refaz a B4, ela a orienta. -/

name: TGLExt.OrientedFace.entropyFactor_is_one_plus_response
head: theorem entropyFactor_is_one_plus_response (c : TGLCoupling) (w : ℝ) (R : OrientedResponse) (h : R.delta = c.beta*|1 + w|) : entropyFactor c w = 1 + R.delta := by rw [h, entropyFactor]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] o fator da B4 (`entropyFactor`) é o primeiro termo da face espelhada quando a resposta é a da Ponte, δ = β|1 + w|. -/

name: TGLExt.star_dotProduct_self
head: theorem star_dotProduct_self (y : n → ℂ) : star y ⬝ᵥ y = ((∑ i, Complex.normSq (y i) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast simp only [dotProduct, Pi.star_apply, Complex.star_def]

name: TGLExt.star_dotProduct_rev
head: theorem star_dotProduct_rev (w y : n → ℂ) : star w ⬝ᵥ y = star (star y ⬝ᵥ w) := by simp only [dotProduct, star_sum, star_mul, star_star, Pi.star_apply]

head: theorem star_dotProduct_vecMulVec_mulVec (w y : n → ℂ) : star y ⬝ᵥ (vecMulVec w (star w) *ᵥ y) = ((Complex.normSq (star y ⬝ᵥ w) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by rw [vecMulVec_mulVec, op_smul_eq_smul, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul,
doc: /-- [KERNEL] O valor quadrático do projetor rank-um: `⟨y, w w⋆ y⟩ = |⟨y,w⟩|²`. -/

name: TGLExt.star_dotProduct_diagonal_normSq_mulVec
head: theorem star_dotProduct_diagonal_normSq_mulVec (w y : n → ℂ) : star y ⬝ᵥ (diagonal (fun i => ((Complex.normSq (w i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) *ᵥ y) = ((∑ i, Complex.normSq (w i) * Complex.normSq (y i) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast

name: TGLExt.norm_star_dotProduct_le
head: theorem norm_star_dotProduct_le (y w : n → ℂ) : ‖star y ⬝ᵥ w‖ ≤ ∑ i, ‖w i‖ * ‖y i‖ := by simp only [dotProduct, Pi.star_apply] refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (le_of_eq (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_))

name: TGLExt.normSq_star_dotProduct_le

doc: /-- [KERNEL] CAUCHY–SCHWARZ: `|⟨y,w⟩|² ≤ ‖w‖²·‖y‖²` (forma real, por somas). -/

name: TGLExt.normSq_star_dotProduct_le_card
head: theorem normSq_star_dotProduct_le_card (y w : n → ℂ) : Complex.normSq (star y ⬝ᵥ w) ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * ∑ i, Complex.normSq (w i) * Complex.normSq (y i) := by have h1 := norm_star_dotProduct_le y w

name: TGLExt.trace_smul_one_sub_vecMulVec_posSemidef
head: theorem trace_smul_one_sub_vecMulVec_posSemidef (w : n → ℂ) : ((vecMulVec w (star w)).trace • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - vecMulVec w (star w)).PosSemidef := by have htr : (vecMulVec w (star w)).trace

name: TGLExt.trace_smul_one_sub_posSemidef
head: theorem trace_smul_one_sub_posSemidef {x : Matrix n n ℂ} (hx : x.PosSemidef) : (x.trace • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - x).PosSemidef := by obtain ⟨m, v, rfl⟩ := posSemidef_iff_eq_sum_vecMulVec.mp hx rw [trace_sum, Finset.sum_smul, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] P1 — DOMINÂNCIA DO TRAÇO: `x ⪰ 0 ⟹ (Tr x)·1 − x ⪰ 0`. Na ordem de Loewner lê-se `x ≤ (Tr x)·1`: os autovalores de um psd somam ao traço, logo nenhum deles o excede. Rota rank-um: `x = Σ vₖvₖ⋆` + Cauchy–Schwarz termo a termo. -/

name: TGLExt.card_smul_diagExpect_sub_vecMulVec_posSemidef
head: theorem card_smul_diagExpect_sub_vecMulVec_posSemidef (w : n → ℂ) : ((Fintype.card n : ℂ) • diagExpect (vecMulVec w (star w)) - vecMulVec w (star w)).PosSemidef := by have hdiag : diagExpect (vecMulVec w (star w))

name: TGLExt.card_smul_diagExpect_sub_posSemidef

doc: /-- [KERNEL] P2 — A COTA DE PIMSNER–POPA DA MASA: `x ⪰ 0 ⟹ n·E_D(x) − x ⪰ 0`. A esperança diagonal comprime no máximo por um fator `n`: é a desigualdade `E(x) ≥ λ·x` com `λ = 1/n`, a assinatura métrica da inclusão `D ⊆ Mₙ(ℂ)`. -/

name: TGLExt.purity
head: def purity (x : Matrix n n ℂ) : ℂ := (x * xᴴ).trace  /-- [KERNEL] ★ UNITÁRIOS CONSERVAM A INFORMAÇÃO: `pureza(U·x·Uᴴ) = pureza(x)` — a evolução global não perde um bit. -/
doc: /-- A PUREZA (norma de Frobenius ao quadrado): `pureza(x) = Tr(x·xᴴ)` — para densidades hermitianas, `Tr(ρ²)`: o contador quadrático de informação (1 = puro; 1/d = máxima ignorância). -/

name: TGLExt.purity_unitary_invariant
head: theorem purity_unitary_invariant (U x : Matrix n n ℂ) (hU : U ∈ unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) : purity (U * x * Uᴴ) = purity x := by have h1 : Uᴴ * U = 1 := by
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ UNITÁRIOS CONSERVAM A INFORMAÇÃO: `pureza(U·x·Uᴴ) = pureza(x)` — a evolução global não perde um bit. -/

name: TGLExt.pure_reductions_trace_eq
head: theorem pure_reductions_trace_eq (M : Matrix a b ℂ) : (M * Mᴴ).trace = (Mᴴ * M).trace := Matrix.trace_mul_comm M Mᴴ
doc: /-- [KERNEL] O BALANÇO DOS TRAÇOS: `Tr(M·Mᴴ) = Tr(Mᴴ·M)` — as duas reduções do estado puro têm o mesmo peso total. -/

name: TGLExt.pure_reductions_balance
head: theorem pure_reductions_balance (M : Matrix a b ℂ) : ((M * Mᴴ) * (M * Mᴴ)).trace = ((Mᴴ * M) * (Mᴴ * M)).trace := by calc ((M * Mᴴ) * (M * Mᴴ)).trace = (M * (Mᴴ * M * Mᴴ)).trace := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ O BALANÇO DE PAGE: `Tr((M·Mᴴ)²) = Tr((Mᴴ·M)²)` — as duas reduções do estado global PURO têm a MESMA pureza (o mesmo espectro de Schmidt): a radiação sabe EXATAMENTE o quanto o buraco sabe. É esta simetria que força a virada de Page: S_rad é limitada pelo lado menor, sobe até a metade e desce. -/

name: TGLExt.purityR
head: def purityR (x : Matrix n n ℂ) : ℝ := ∑ i : n, ∑ j : n, Complex.normSq (x i j)  /-- [KERNEL] A ponte: `pureza(x) = Σᵢⱼ |xᵢⱼ|²` — o traço de x·xᴴ é a soma
doc: /-- A PUREZA REAL (soma dos módulos-quadrados das entradas): a forma entrada-a-entrada da norma de Frobenius². -/

name: TGLExt.purityR_eq
head: theorem purityR_eq (x : Matrix n n ℂ) : purity x = (purityR x : ℂ) := by unfold purity purityR rw [Matrix.trace] push_cast
doc: /-- [KERNEL] A ponte: `pureza(x) = Σᵢⱼ |xᵢⱼ|²` — o traço de x·xᴴ é a soma dos módulos-quadrados (a forma de Frobenius da casa). -/

name: TGLExt.dephase_purityR_le
head: theorem dephase_purityR_le (g : n → n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hg : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ g i j) (x : Matrix n n ℂ) : purityR (dephase g t x) ≤ purityR x := by unfold purityR
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ O CANAL PERDE PUREZA: para taxas e tempo não-negativos, `pureza(D_t(x)) ≤ pureza(x)` — o dephasing (v43) NUNCA cria informação: a irreversibilidade EFETIVA do canal, que coexiste com a conservação unitária global (`purity_unitary_invariant`) — o mecanismo de Page: térmico por fora, unitário por dentro. -/

name: TGLExt.entropy_max_at_half
head: theorem entropy_max_at_half (p : ℝ) : Real.binEntropy p ≤ Real.binEntropy 2⁻¹ := by have h : Real.binEntropy 2⁻¹ = Real.log 2 := by simp rw [h]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ A ENTROPIA BINÁRIA É MÁXIMA NA MEIA: `H(p) ≤ H(½)` — a ignorância é plena exatamente no ponto auto-conjugado (o MESMO ½ da flutuação máxima, v49). O valor é log 2 nats = 1 bit: a distinção inteira. -/

name: TGLExt.entropy_eq_max_iff_half

doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ E SOMENTE NA MEIA: `H(p) = H(½) ⟺ p = ½` — o máximo da entropia caracteriza o espelho x = 1−x, como o máximo da flutuação (v49): duas leis, o mesmo ponto fixo. -/

name: TGLExt.ricciSymbol

name: TGLExt.ricciSymbol_tt

name: TGLExt.qgPhysicsCertificate_massless
