name: TGLExt.the_pruning_threshold_is_the_reflection_amplitude
head: theorem the_pruning_threshold_is_the_reflection_amplitude {β : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ β) (h1 : β ≤ 1) : Complex.normSq (Smat (thetaMiguel β) |>.mulVec e1 <| 1) = Real.sqrt β ^ 2
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★★★★ **O LIMIAR DE PODA VERBAL É A AMPLITUDE DE REFLEXÃO DA FRONTEIRA.**  Num enunciado só: em `θ = θ_Miguel`, a amplitude de reflexão da matriz-S vale `√β` — o mesmo número que a patente usa como limiar de poda (`g_ratio < √β ⟹ L_poda elimina`) — e ela fecha com a transmissão em 1.  **Um só ângulo governa os dois domínios.** O que a patente chama de *vácuo verbal* é o que reflete menos que a amplitude da fronteira. -/

name: TGLExt.tanh_sign
head: theorem tanh_sign (t : ℝ) : (t < 0 → Real.tanh t < 0) ∧ (0 < t → 0 < Real.tanh t) := by rw [Real.tanh_eq_sinh_div_cosh] have hc : 0 < Real.cosh t := Real.cosh_pos t
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★ **O SINAL DO ACOPLAMENTO É O SINAL DO DESVIO**: `tanh` herda o sinal de `sinh`, porque `cosh > 0`. É o tijolo do separador. -/

name: TGLExt.the_boundary_separates_the_verbal_domains
head: theorem the_boundary_separates_the_verbal_domains {θ θM Δ : ℝ} (hΔ : 0 < Δ) : (θ < θM → fVerbal θ θM Δ < 0) ∧ (θM < θ → 0 < fVerbal θ θM Δ) ∧ fVerbal θM θM Δ = 0 := by

É a forma tipada do classificador de poda da patente: existe o que fica de um lado e existe o que fica do outro — e um critério que aprovasse tudo não separaria nada. -/

name: TGLExt.the_verb_floor_is_a_fraction_of_the_max
head: theorem the_verb_floor_is_a_fraction_of_the_max {β Smax : ℝ} (hβ0 : 0 < β) (hβ1 : β < 1) (hS : 0 < Smax) : 0 < verbFloor β Smax ∧ verbFloor β Smax < Smax := by unfold verbFloor
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★ **O PISO É FRAÇÃO ESTRITA DO MÁXIMO**: com `0 < β < 1` e `S_max > 0`, o piso de Hilbert verbal é positivo e **estritamente menor** que o máximo — exige sinal, e não exige o impossível. -/

head: theorem norm_tof_sq (K : ℕ) (z : Matrix (chainIdx K) (chainIdx K) ℂ) : ‖tof P K z‖ ^ 2 = (tInner P K z z).re := by rw [norm_sq_eq_re_inner (𝕜 := ℂ) (tof P K z)] rw [show (inner ℂ (tof P K z) (tof P K z) : ℂ) = tInner P K z z from
doc: /-- a norma do colimite em coordenadas de andar. -/

name: TGLExt.lmulPre_norm_le
head: theorem lmulPre_norm_le {N : ℕ} (x : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) (v : TowerPre P) : ‖lmulPre P x v‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (frobSq x) * ‖v‖ := by obtain ⟨M, b, rfl⟩ := exists_tof v
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★ A CONTINUIDADE: ‖x·v‖ ≤ ‖x‖_F·‖v‖ em TODO o colimite. -/

name: TGLExt.lmulCLM
head: def lmulCLM (P : SiteProfile) {N : ℕ} (x : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : TowerPre P →L[ℂ] TowerPre P := LinearMap.mkContinuous (lmulLin P x) (Real.sqrt (frobSq x))
doc: /-- ★★ a multiplicação à esquerda como operador CONTÍNUO no pré-Hilbert. -/

name: TGLExt.lmulCLM_apply
head: theorem lmulCLM_apply {N : ℕ} (x : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) (v : TowerPre P) : lmulCLM P x v = lmulPre P x v := rfl  /-! ## E — A REPRESENTAÇÃO π em B(H_φ) -/

name: TGLExt.towerPi
head: def towerPi (P : SiteProfile) {N : ℕ} (x : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P := (lmulCLM P x).completion
doc: /-- ★★★ π(x): a ação de x ∈ torre como operador limitado de H_φ. -/

name: TGLExt.towerPi_coe
head: theorem towerPi_coe {N : ℕ} (x : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) (v : TowerPre P) : towerPi P x (v : TowerHilbert P) = ((lmulPre P x v : TowerPre P) : TowerHilbert P) := ContinuousLinearMap.completion_apply_coe _ _

name: TGLExt.towerPi_compat
head: theorem towerPi_compat {N M : ℕ} (h : N ≤ M) (x : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : towerPi P (tPush h x) = towerPi P x := by ext c
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★ π é COMPATÍVEL com o empurrão: π(tPush h x) = π(x) — a torre age em H_φ como UNIÃO DIRIGIDA de andares. -/

name: TGLExt.towerPi_one
head: theorem towerPi_one (N : ℕ) : towerPi P (1 : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) = 1 := by ext c induction c using Completion.induction_on with
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ π(1) = 1: a representação é UNITAL. -/

name: TGLExt.towerPi_mul
head: theorem towerPi_mul (N : ℕ) (x y : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : towerPi P (x * y) = towerPi P x * towerPi P y := by ext c
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★ π(x·y) = π(x)·π(y): a representação é MULTIPLICATIVA. -/

name: TGLExt.tInner_mul_left_adjoint
head: theorem tInner_mul_left_adjoint (P : SiteProfile) (K : ℕ) (z a b : Matrix (chainIdx K) (chainIdx K) ℂ) : tInner P K (z * a) b = tInner P K a (zᴴ * b) := by unfold tInner
doc: /-- a identidade de adjunção por andar: ⟨z·a, b⟩ = ⟨a, z†·b⟩. -/

name: TGLExt.towerPi_star
head: theorem towerPi_star (N : ℕ) (x : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : towerPi P xᴴ = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (towerPi P x) := by refine ((ContinuousLinearMap.eq_adjoint_iff _ _).mpr ?_) intro u v
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★★ π(x†) = π(x)*: a representação é ESTRELADA — o adjunto de Hilbert realiza a estrela da torre. -/

name: TGLExt.towerPi_omega
head: theorem towerPi_omega (N : ℕ) (x : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : towerPi P x (hOmega P) = ((tof P N x : TowerPre P) : TowerHilbert P) := by unfold hOmega rw [show towerOmega P = tof P 0 1 from rfl, towerPi_coe]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★★ π(x)Ω = [x]: a órbita do Nome é a própria torre. -/

name: TGLExt.towerPi_orbit_dense
head: theorem towerPi_orbit_dense : DenseRange (fun p : TowerPt => towerPi P p.2 (hOmega P)) := by have hr : Set.range (fun p : TowerPt => towerPi P p.2 (hOmega P)) = Set.range ((↑) : TowerPre P → TowerHilbert P) := by
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★★ Ω É CÍCLICO: a órbita da torre sobre Ω é DENSA em H_φ — o vetor do Nome gera o espaço do fator inteiro. -/

name: ChatgptAudit.Collapse057.FactorCarrier
head: abbrev FactorCarrier (P : SiteProfile) := {A : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P // A ∈ theFactorObject P}  def towerReduction (P : SiteProfile) (A : FactorCarrier P) : FactorCarrier P :=

name: ChatgptAudit.Collapse057.towerReduction

name: ChatgptAudit.Collapse057.tower_reduction_idempotent
head: theorem tower_reduction_idempotent (P : SiteProfile) (A : FactorCarrier P) : towerReduction P (towerReduction P A) = towerReduction P A := by apply Subtype.ext exact aperiodic_expectation_idempotent P A.val A.property

name: ChatgptAudit.Collapse057.tower_reduction_preserves_state
head: theorem tower_reduction_preserves_state (P : SiteProfile) (A : FactorCarrier P) : omegaState P (towerReduction P A).val = omegaState P A.val := expectation_preserves_omega P (aperiodicExpectationInput P) A.val A.property

name: ChatgptAudit.Collapse057.tower_reduction_preserves_unit
head: theorem tower_reduction_preserves_unit (P : SiteProfile) : towerReduction P ⟨1, (theFactorObject P).one_mem⟩ = ⟨1, (theFactorObject P).one_mem⟩ := by apply Subtype.ext

name: ChatgptAudit.Collapse057.tower_fixed_points_exactly_centralizer
head: theorem tower_fixed_points_exactly_centralizer (P : SiteProfile) (A : FactorCarrier P) : towerReduction P A = A ↔ A.val ∈ omegaCentralizer P := by constructor · intro h

name: ChatgptAudit.Collapse057.tower_pauli_x_nonzero

name: ChatgptAudit.Collapse057.tower_reduction_effective
head: theorem tower_reduction_effective (P : SiteProfile) (hp : P.w 0 ≠ 1 / 2) : ∃ A : FactorCarrier P, towerReduction P A ≠ A := by refine ⟨⟨sitePauliX P 0, site_pauli_x_mem_factor P 0⟩, ?_⟩ intro h

name: ChatgptAudit.Collapse057.actualTowerCollapse
head: def actualTowerCollapse (P : SiteProfile) (hp : P.w 0 ≠ 1 / 2) : IdentityCollapse (FactorCarrier P) ℂ where step := towerReduction P identity := fun A => omegaState P A.val
doc: /-- Constructed inhabitant for the nontracial first-site regime. -/

name: ChatgptAudit.Collapse057.actual_tower_collapse_no_inverse
head: theorem actual_tower_collapse_no_inverse (P : SiteProfile) (hp : P.w 0 ≠ 1 / 2) : ¬ ∃ R : FactorCarrier P → FactorCarrier P, Function.LeftInverse R (towerReduction P) := collapse_has_no_left_inverse (actualTowerCollapse P hp)

name: ChatgptAudit.Collapse057.tracial_tower_reduction_is_identity
head: theorem tracial_tower_reduction_is_identity (P : SiteProfile) (hp : ∀ n, P.w n = 1 / 2) : towerReduction P = id := by funext A apply (tower_fixed_points_exactly_centralizer P A).mpr
doc: /-- Negative control: the fully tracial profile gives no changed collapse event. -/

name: ChatgptAudit.Collapse057.tracial_tower_has_no_effective_witness
head: theorem tracial_tower_has_no_effective_witness (P : SiteProfile) (hp : ∀ n, P.w n = 1 / 2) : ¬ ∃ A : FactorCarrier P, towerReduction P A ≠ A := by rw [tracial_tower_reduction_is_identity P hp]

name: TGLExt.SiteProfile

name: TGLExt.siteW

name: TGLExt.siteW_sum

name: TGLExt.towerW

name: TGLExt.towerW_sum
head: theorem towerW_sum (P : SiteProfile) : ∀ N : ℕ, ∑ i, towerW P N i = 1 | 0 => siteW_sum (P.w 0) | N + 1 => by have key : (∑ p : chainIdx N × Fin 2,

name: TGLExt.tState
head: def tState (P : SiteProfile) (N : ℕ) (a : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : ℂ := ∑ k, ((towerW P N k : ℝ) : ℂ) * a k k
doc: /-- o estado da torre no andar N (forma de soma explícita). -/

name: TGLExt.tInner
head: def tInner (P : SiteProfile) (N : ℕ) (a b : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : ℂ := tState P N (aᴴ * b)
doc: /-- o produto GNS do andar: ⟨a,b⟩ = φ(a†b). -/

name: TGLExt.tState_add
head: theorem tState_add (P : SiteProfile) (N : ℕ) (a b : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : tState P N (a + b) = tState P N a + tState P N b := by unfold tState

name: TGLExt.tState_smul
head: theorem tState_smul (P : SiteProfile) (N : ℕ) (c : ℂ) (a : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : tState P N (c • a) = c * tState P N a := by unfold tState

name: TGLExt.tState_one
head: theorem tState_one (P : SiteProfile) (N : ℕ) : tState P N (1 : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) = 1 := by unfold tState have h : ∀ k : chainIdx N,

name: TGLExt.tInner_apply
head: theorem tInner_apply (P : SiteProfile) (N : ℕ) (a b : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : tInner P N a b = ∑ k, ((towerW P N k : ℝ) : ℂ) * ∑ j, conj (a j k) * b j k := by
doc: /-- a fórmula de coordenadas do produto GNS. -/

name: TGLExt.tInner_conj_symm
head: theorem tInner_conj_symm (P : SiteProfile) (N : ℕ) (a b : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : conj (tInner P N b a) = tInner P N a b := by rw [tInner_apply, tInner_apply, map_sum]

name: TGLExt.tInner_add_left
head: theorem tInner_add_left (P : SiteProfile) (N : ℕ) (a b c : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : tInner P N (a + b) c = tInner P N a c + tInner P N b c := by unfold tInner

name: TGLExt.tInner_add_right
head: theorem tInner_add_right (P : SiteProfile) (N : ℕ) (a b c : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : tInner P N a (b + c) = tInner P N a b + tInner P N a c := by unfold tInner

name: TGLExt.tInner_smul_left
head: theorem tInner_smul_left (P : SiteProfile) (N : ℕ) (c : ℂ) (a b : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : tInner P N (c • a) b = conj c * tInner P N a b := by unfold tInner

name: TGLExt.tInner_smul_right
head: theorem tInner_smul_right (P : SiteProfile) (N : ℕ) (c : ℂ) (a b : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : tInner P N a (c • b) = c * tInner P N a b := by unfold tInner

name: TGLExt.tInner_self_eq
head: theorem tInner_self_eq (P : SiteProfile) (N : ℕ) (a : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : tInner P N a a = ((∑ k, towerW P N k * ∑ j, Complex.normSq (a j k) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
doc: /-- a norma GNS ao quadrado, em coordenadas: soma pesada de |·|². -/

name: TGLExt.tInner_self_nonneg
head: theorem tInner_self_nonneg (P : SiteProfile) (N : ℕ) (a : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : 0 ≤ (tInner P N a a).re := by rw [tInner_self_eq, Complex.ofReal_re]

name: TGLExt.tInner_self_definite
head: theorem tInner_self_definite (P : SiteProfile) (N : ℕ) {a : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ} (h : tInner P N a a = 0) : a = 0 := by rw [tInner_self_eq] at h
doc: /-- ★ A DEFINITUDE POR ANDAR: pesos positivos ⟹ radical zero. -/

name: TGLExt.tState_towerStep
head: theorem tState_towerStep (P : SiteProfile) {N : ℕ} (a : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : tState P (N + 1) (towerStep a) = tState P N a := by unfold tState towerStep
doc: /-- ★★ A COERÊNCIA DE ARAKI–WOODS no perfil geral: φ_{N+1}(a⊗1) = φ_N(a). -/

name: TGLExt.towerStep_add
head: theorem towerStep_add {N : ℕ} (a b : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : towerStep (a + b) = towerStep a + towerStep b := by unfold towerStep exact Matrix.add_kronecker a b 1

name: TGLExt.towerStep_smul
head: theorem towerStep_smul {N : ℕ} (c : ℂ) (a : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : towerStep (c • a) = c • towerStep a := by unfold towerStep exact Matrix.smul_kronecker c a 1

name: TGLExt.towerStep_zero
head: theorem towerStep_zero (N : ℕ) : towerStep (0 : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) = 0 := by unfold towerStep exact Matrix.zero_kronecker 1

name: TGLExt.tNext
head: def tNext {k : ℕ} (x : Matrix (chainIdx k) (chainIdx k) ℂ) : Matrix (chainIdx (k + 1)) (chainIdx (k + 1)) ℂ := towerStep x  /-- o empurrão da torre: N ≤ M degraus de towerStep. -/

name: TGLExt.tPush
head: def tPush {N M : ℕ} (h : N ≤ M) (a : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : Matrix (chainIdx M) (chainIdx M) ℂ := Nat.leRecOn (C := fun m => Matrix (chainIdx m) (chainIdx m) ℂ) h

name: TGLExt.tPush_self
head: theorem tPush_self {N : ℕ} (h : N ≤ N) (a : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : tPush h a = a := by unfold tPush exact @Nat.leRecOn_self (fun m => Matrix (chainIdx m) (chainIdx m) ℂ) N

name: TGLExt.tPush_succ
head: theorem tPush_succ {N M : ℕ} (h1 : N ≤ M) (h2 : N ≤ M + 1) (a : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : tPush h2 a = towerStep (tPush h1 a) := by unfold tPush

name: TGLExt.tPush_trans
head: theorem tPush_trans {N M K : ℕ} (h1 : N ≤ M) (h2 : M ≤ K) (a : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : tPush h2 (tPush h1 a) = tPush (h1.trans h2) a := by induction K, h2 using Nat.le_induction with

name: TGLExt.tPush_add
head: theorem tPush_add {N M : ℕ} (h : N ≤ M) (a b : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : tPush h (a + b) = tPush h a + tPush h b := by induction M, h using Nat.le_induction with

name: TGLExt.tPush_smul
head: theorem tPush_smul {N M : ℕ} (h : N ≤ M) (c : ℂ) (a : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : tPush h (c • a) = c • tPush h a := by induction M, h using Nat.le_induction with

name: TGLExt.tPush_zero
head: theorem tPush_zero {N M : ℕ} (h : N ≤ M) : tPush h (0 : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) = 0 := by induction M, h using Nat.le_induction with | base => rw [tPush_self]

name: TGLExt.tPush_neg
head: theorem tPush_neg {N M : ℕ} (h : N ≤ M) (a : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : tPush h (-a) = - tPush h a := by have h1 : (-a) = (-1 : ℂ) • a := by rw [neg_one_smul]

name: TGLExt.tPush_mul
head: theorem tPush_mul {N M : ℕ} (h : N ≤ M) (a b : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : tPush h (a * b) = tPush h a * tPush h b := by induction M, h using Nat.le_induction with

name: TGLExt.tPush_star
head: theorem tPush_star {N M : ℕ} (h : N ≤ M) (a : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : tPush h aᴴ = (tPush h a)ᴴ := by induction M, h using Nat.le_induction with

name: TGLExt.tPush_one
head: theorem tPush_one {N M : ℕ} (h : N ≤ M) : tPush h (1 : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) = 1 := by induction M, h using Nat.le_induction with | base => rw [tPush_self]

name: TGLExt.tPush_injective
head: theorem tPush_injective {N M : ℕ} (h : N ≤ M) : Function.Injective (tPush (N := N) (M := M) h) := by induction M, h using Nat.le_induction with | base =>

name: TGLExt.tState_tPush
head: theorem tState_tPush (P : SiteProfile) {N M : ℕ} (h : N ≤ M) (a : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : tState P M (tPush h a) = tState P N a := by induction M, h using Nat.le_induction with

name: TGLExt.tInner_tPush
head: theorem tInner_tPush (P : SiteProfile) {N M : ℕ} (h : N ≤ M) (a b : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : tInner P M (tPush h a) (tPush h b) = tInner P N a b := by unfold tInner

name: TGLExt.TowerPt

doc: /-- um ponto da torre: um andar e uma matriz nele. -/

name: TGLExt.towerEqv
head: def towerEqv (x y : TowerPt) : Prop := ∃ (K : ℕ) (hx : x.1 ≤ K) (hy : y.1 ≤ K), tPush hx x.2 = tPush hy y.2  theorem towerEqv_refl (x : TowerPt) : towerEqv x x :=
doc: /-- a relação do colimite: empurrados a um andar comum, coincidem. -/

name: TGLExt.towerEqv_refl
head: theorem towerEqv_refl (x : TowerPt) : towerEqv x x := ⟨x.1, le_rfl, le_rfl, rfl⟩  theorem towerEqv_symm {x y : TowerPt} (h : towerEqv x y) : towerEqv y x := by

name: TGLExt.towerEqv_symm
head: theorem towerEqv_symm {x y : TowerPt} (h : towerEqv x y) : towerEqv y x := by obtain ⟨K, hx, hy, e⟩ := h exact ⟨K, hy, hx, e.symm⟩

name: TGLExt.towerEqv_iff
head: theorem towerEqv_iff {x y : TowerPt} {K : ℕ} (hx : x.1 ≤ K) (hy : y.1 ≤ K) : towerEqv x y ↔ tPush hx x.2 = tPush hy y.2 := by constructor · rintro ⟨K0, h1, h2, e⟩
doc: /-- a caracterização em QUALQUER andar comum (usa a injetividade). -/

name: TGLExt.towerEqv_trans

name: TGLExt.towerSetoid

name: TGLExt.TowerPre

name: TGLExt.tof_tPush
head: theorem tof_tPush {N M : ℕ} (h : N ≤ M) (a : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : tof P M (tPush h a) = tof P N a := by apply Quotient.sound

name: TGLExt.exists_tof

name: TGLExt.tof_eq_iff
head: theorem tof_eq_iff {N M : ℕ} {K : ℕ} (hN : N ≤ K) (hM : M ≤ K) (a : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) (b : Matrix (chainIdx M) (chainIdx M) ℂ) : tof P N a = tof P M b ↔ tPush hN a = tPush hM b := by

name: TGLExt.tof_add_hetero

head: theorem commutes_all_levels_scalar (x : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P) (hx : x ∈ theFactorObject P) (hc : ∀ N (a : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ), towerPi P a * x = x * towerPi P a) : x = omegaState P x • (1 : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P) := by

name: ChatgptAudit.prefixCommutingTail
head: def prefixCommutingTail (P : SiteProfile) (N : ℕ) : Set (TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P) := {x | x ∈ theFactorObject P ∧ ∀ a : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ, towerPi P a * x = x * towerPi P a}  theorem tail_intersection_scalar (x : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P)
doc: /-- Interface de cauda: inclusão no comutante de cada prefixo. -/

name: ChatgptAudit.tail_intersection_scalar
head: theorem tail_intersection_scalar (x : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P) (hx : ∀ N, x ∈ prefixCommutingTail P N) : x = omegaState P x • (1 : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P) := commutes_all_levels_scalar x (hx 0).1 (fun N => (hx N).2)

name: ChatgptAudit.Thermal025.tower_gibbs_omega_overlap

head: theorem tower_gibbs_uniform_overlap (P : SiteProfile) (q : ℝ) (hP : ∀ n, P.w n=q) (s : ℝ) (N : ℕ) : inner ℂ (hOmega P) (towerGibbsVector P N s)=(((gibbsAffinity (siteW q) s)^(N+1):ℝ):ℂ) := by rw [tower_gibbs_omega_overlap,tower_gibbs_affinity_uniform P q hP]

name: ChatgptAudit.Thermal025.tower_step_diagonal

name: ChatgptAudit.Thermal025.tower_local_vectors_inner

name: ChatgptAudit.Thermal025.tower_gibbs_successive_distance
head: theorem tower_gibbs_successive_distance (P : SiteProfile) (N : ℕ) (s : ℝ) : ‖towerGibbsVector P N s-towerGibbsVector P (N+1) s‖^2= 2-2*gibbsAffinity (siteW (P.w (N+1))) s := by rw [norm_sub_sq (𝕜 := ℂ),tower_gibbs_vector_norm,tower_gibbs_vector_norm,tower_gibbs_successive_overlap]

name: ChatgptAudit.Thermal025.nontracial_site_affinity_lt_one
head: theorem nontracial_site_affinity_lt_one (P : SiteProfile) (q : ℝ) (hP : ∀ n, P.w n=q) (s : ℝ) (hS : s≠0) (hq : q≠1/2) : gibbsAffinity (siteW q) s<1 := by have h0 : 0<q := by rw [←hP 0]; exact P.pos 0 have h1 : q<1 := by rw [←hP 0]; exact P.lt_one 0

name: ChatgptAudit.Thermal025.thermal_uniform_overlap_tends_zero
head: theorem thermal_uniform_overlap_tends_zero (P : SiteProfile) (q : ℝ) (hP : ∀ n, P.w n=q) (s : ℝ) (hS : s≠0) (hq : q≠1/2) : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (inner ℂ (hOmega P) (towerGibbsVector P N s)).re) atTop (𝓝 0) := by have h0 : 0<q := by rw [←hP 0]; exact P.pos 0

name: ChatgptAudit.Thermal025.thermal_vectors_no_norm_limit
head: theorem thermal_vectors_no_norm_limit (P : SiteProfile) (q : ℝ) (hP : ∀ n, P.w n=q) (s : ℝ) (hS : s≠0) (hq : q≠1/2) (v : TowerHilbert P) : ¬Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => towerGibbsVector P N s) atTop (𝓝 v) := by intro ht

head: theorem thermal_vectors_not_cauchy (P : SiteProfile) (q : ℝ) (hP : ∀ n, P.w n=q) (s : ℝ) (hS : s≠0) (hq : q≠1/2) : ¬CauchySeq (fun N : ℕ => towerGibbsVector P N s) := by intro hc

name: ChatgptAudit.Thermal025.thermalProfile

name: ChatgptAudit.Thermal025.thermal_profile_site
head: theorem thermal_profile_site (P : SiteProfile) (s : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : siteW ((thermalProfile P s).w n)=gibbsWeights (siteW (P.w n)) s := by have hs := gibbs_weights_normalized (siteW (P.w n)) (siteW_pos (P.pos n) (P.lt_one n)) s rw [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hs

name: ChatgptAudit.Thermal025.thermal_profile_zero
head: theorem thermal_profile_zero (P : SiteProfile) (n : ℕ) : (thermalProfile P 0).w n=P.w n := by change gibbsWeights (siteW (P.w n)) 0 0=P.w n rw [gibbs_weights_zero _ (siteW_sum _)]

name: ChatgptAudit.Thermal025.thermal_profile_tower_weights
head: theorem thermal_profile_tower_weights (P : SiteProfile) (s : ℝ) (N : ℕ) : towerW (thermalProfile P s) N=gibbsWeights (towerW P N) s := by induction N with | zero => exact thermal_profile_site P s 0

head: theorem thermal_global_local_state (P : SiteProfile) (s : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (a : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : omegaState (thermalProfile P s) (towerPi (thermalProfile P s) a)= towerGibbsState P N s (towerPi P a) := by

head: theorem thermal_profile_uniform (P : SiteProfile) (q : ℝ) (hP : ∀ n, P.w n=q) (s : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : (thermalProfile P s).w n=gibbsWeights (siteW q) s 0 := by simp only [thermalProfile,hP]

head: theorem thermal_tower_entropy_uniform (P : SiteProfile) (q : ℝ) (hP : ∀ n, P.w n=q) (s : ℝ) (N : ℕ) : finiteEntropy (gibbsWeights (towerW P N) s)= ((N:ℝ)+1)*finiteEntropy (gibbsWeights (siteW q) s) := by have hsite : gibbsWeights (siteW q) s=siteW (gibbsWeights (siteW q) s 0) := by

name: TGLExt.chainDownUp_eq
head: theorem chainDownUp_eq (l : ℝ) : ∀ N : ℕ, chainDown N * chainUp N = (fun M : ℕ => (chainDown M * chainUp M)) N | _ => rfl
doc: /-- [KERNEL] a testemunha do traço na torre: chainDown·chainUp = ⊗E₁₁. -/

name: TGLExt.chainDownUp_value
head: theorem chainDownUp_value (l : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) : ∀ N : ℕ, chainState l N (chainDown N * chainUp N) = (((1 / (1 + l)) ^ (N + 1) : ℝ) : ℂ) | 0 => by
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★ φ_N(chainDown·chainUp) = (1/(1+λ))^(N+1) — positivo em todo andar (indução pela fatoração tensorial do traço). -/

name: TGLExt.tower_ratio_ne_one
head: theorem tower_ratio_ne_one (l : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) (hne : l ≠ 1) (N : ℕ) : l ^ (N + 1) ≠ 1 := by rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h · exact ne_of_lt (pow_lt_one₀ hl.le h (Nat.succ_ne_zero N))
doc: /-- [KERNEL] λ^(N+1) ≠ 1 para λ > 0, λ ≠ 1. -/

name: TGLExt.chainState_not_tracial_tower
head: theorem chainState_not_tracial_tower (l : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) (hne : l ≠ 1) (N : ℕ) : chainState l N (chainUp N * chainDown N) ≠ chainState l N (chainDown N * chainUp N) := by
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★★ A TORRE SEM TRAÇO: para λ ≠ 1 e QUALQUER andar N, o estado φ_N não é tracial — φ_N(chainUp·chainDown) ≠ φ_N(chainDown·chainUp). O tipo III realizado na torre concreta que constrói o fator ITPFI, andar a andar. -/

name: TGLExt.evenShiftFun
head: def evenShiftFun (x : ℕ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ := fun k => if k % 2 = 0 then x (k / 2) else 0  /-- (v x)ₖ = x_{k/2} se k é ímpar, 0 se par. -/
doc: /-- (u x)ₖ = x_{k/2} se k é par, 0 se ímpar. -/

name: TGLExt.oddShiftFun
head: def oddShiftFun (x : ℕ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ := fun k => if k % 2 = 1 then x (k / 2) else 0  /-- a retração par: (cE y)ₙ = y_{2n}. -/
doc: /-- (v x)ₖ = x_{k/2} se k é ímpar, 0 se par. -/

name: TGLExt.coEvenFun
head: def coEvenFun (y : ℕ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => y (2 * n)  /-- a retração ímpar: (cO y)ₙ = y_{2n+1}. -/ def coOddFun (y : ℕ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => y (2 * n + 1)
doc: /-- a retração par: (cE y)ₙ = y_{2n}. -/

name: TGLExt.coOddFun
head: def coOddFun (y : ℕ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => y (2 * n + 1)  theorem evenShiftFun_double (x : ℕ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) : evenShiftFun x (2 * n) = x n := by
doc: /-- a retração ímpar: (cO y)ₙ = y_{2n+1}. -/

name: TGLExt.evenShiftFun_double
head: theorem evenShiftFun_double (x : ℕ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) : evenShiftFun x (2 * n) = x n := by unfold evenShiftFun rw [if_pos (by omega : (2 * n) % 2 = 0)]

name: TGLExt.oddShiftFun_double
head: theorem oddShiftFun_double (x : ℕ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) : oddShiftFun x (2 * n + 1) = x n := by unfold oddShiftFun rw [if_pos (by omega : (2 * n + 1) % 2 = 1)]

name: TGLExt.double_injective
head: theorem double_injective : Function.Injective (fun n : ℕ => 2 * n) := by intro a b h simpa using h

name: TGLExt.double_succ_injective
head: theorem double_succ_injective : Function.Injective (fun n : ℕ => 2 * n + 1) := by intro a b h simpa using h

name: TGLExt.evenShiftFun_support
head: theorem evenShiftFun_support (x : ℕ → ℂ) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ∉ Set.range (fun n : ℕ => 2 * n)) : ‖evenShiftFun x k‖ ^ (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal = 0 := by have hodd : k % 2 = 1 := by

name: TGLExt.oddShiftFun_support
head: theorem oddShiftFun_support (x : ℕ → ℂ) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ∉ Set.range (fun n : ℕ => 2 * n + 1)) : ‖oddShiftFun x k‖ ^ (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal = 0 := by have heven : k % 2 = 0 := by

name: TGLExt.evenShiftFun_support'
head: theorem evenShiftFun_support' (x : ℕ → ℂ) : (Function.support fun k => ‖evenShiftFun x k‖ ^ (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal) ⊆ Set.range (fun n : ℕ => 2 * n) := by intro k hk
doc: /-! ## B — pertinência e limitação -/

name: TGLExt.oddShiftFun_support'
head: theorem oddShiftFun_support' (x : ℕ → ℂ) : (Function.support fun k => ‖oddShiftFun x k‖ ^ (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal) ⊆ Set.range (fun n : ℕ => 2 * n + 1) := by intro k hk

name: TGLExt.memℓp_two_iff_summable
head: theorem memℓp_two_iff_summable (f : ℕ → ℂ) : Memℓp f 2 ↔ Summable (fun k => ‖f k‖ ^ (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal) := by constructor · intro h

name: TGLExt.evenShiftFun_memℓp
head: theorem evenShiftFun_memℓp (x : ellTwo) : Memℓp (evenShiftFun (x : ℕ → ℂ)) 2 := by rw [memℓp_two_iff_summable] rw [← Function.Injective.summable_iff double_injective

name: TGLExt.oddShiftFun_memℓp
head: theorem oddShiftFun_memℓp (x : ellTwo) : Memℓp (oddShiftFun (x : ℕ → ℂ)) 2 := by rw [memℓp_two_iff_summable] rw [← Function.Injective.summable_iff double_succ_injective

name: TGLExt.coEvenFun_memℓp
head: theorem coEvenFun_memℓp (y : ellTwo) : Memℓp (coEvenFun (y : ℕ → ℂ)) 2 := by rw [memℓp_two_iff_summable] have hy : Summable (fun k => ‖(y : ℕ → ℂ) k‖ ^ (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal) :=

name: TGLExt.coOddFun_memℓp
head: theorem coOddFun_memℓp (y : ellTwo) : Memℓp (coOddFun (y : ℕ → ℂ)) 2 := by rw [memℓp_two_iff_summable] have hy : Summable (fun k => ‖(y : ℕ → ℂ) k‖ ^ (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal) :=

name: TGLExt.evenShiftLM
head: def evenShiftLM : ellTwo →ₗ[ℂ] ellTwo where toFun x := ⟨evenShiftFun (x : ℕ → ℂ), evenShiftFun_memℓp x⟩ map_add' x y := by apply Subtype.ext
doc: /-! ## C — os quatro operadores contínuos -/

name: TGLExt.oddShiftLM
head: def oddShiftLM : ellTwo →ₗ[ℂ] ellTwo where toFun x := ⟨oddShiftFun (x : ℕ → ℂ), oddShiftFun_memℓp x⟩ map_add' x y := by apply Subtype.ext

name: TGLExt.coEvenLM
head: def coEvenLM : ellTwo →ₗ[ℂ] ellTwo where toFun y := ⟨coEvenFun (y : ℕ → ℂ), coEvenFun_memℓp y⟩ map_add' x y := by apply Subtype.ext

name: TGLExt.coOddLM
head: def coOddLM : ellTwo →ₗ[ℂ] ellTwo where toFun y := ⟨coOddFun (y : ℕ → ℂ), coOddFun_memℓp y⟩ map_add' x y := by apply Subtype.ext

name: TGLExt.norm_sq_eq_tsum
head: theorem norm_sq_eq_tsum (z : ellTwo) : ‖z‖ ^ (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal = ∑' k, ‖(z : ℕ → ℂ) k‖ ^ (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal := lp.norm_rpow_eq_tsum (by norm_num) z

name: TGLExt.sq_le_of_rpow_le
head: theorem sq_le_of_rpow_le {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (h : a ^ (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal ≤ b ^ (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal) : a ≤ b := by have h2 : (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal = 2 := by norm_num rw [h2] at h

name: TGLExt.evenShiftLM_norm
head: theorem evenShiftLM_norm (x : ellTwo) : ‖evenShiftLM x‖ ≤ 1 * ‖x‖ := by rw [one_mul] refine sq_le_of_rpow_le (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _) (le_of_eq ?_) rw [norm_sq_eq_tsum, norm_sq_eq_tsum]

name: TGLExt.oddShiftLM_norm
head: theorem oddShiftLM_norm (x : ellTwo) : ‖oddShiftLM x‖ ≤ 1 * ‖x‖ := by rw [one_mul] refine sq_le_of_rpow_le (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _) (le_of_eq ?_) rw [norm_sq_eq_tsum, norm_sq_eq_tsum]

name: TGLExt.coEvenLM_norm
head: theorem coEvenLM_norm (y : ellTwo) : ‖coEvenLM y‖ ≤ 1 * ‖y‖ := by rw [one_mul] have hy : Summable (fun k => ‖(y : ℕ → ℂ) k‖ ^ (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal) := (lp.memℓp y).summable (by norm_num)

name: TGLExt.coOddLM_norm
head: theorem coOddLM_norm (y : ellTwo) : ‖coOddLM y‖ ≤ 1 * ‖y‖ := by rw [one_mul] have hy : Summable (fun k => ‖(y : ℕ → ℂ) k‖ ^ (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal) := (lp.memℓp y).summable (by norm_num)

name: TGLExt.evenShift
head: def evenShift : ellTwo →L[ℂ] ellTwo := LinearMap.mkContinuous evenShiftLM 1 evenShiftLM_norm  /-- v : o mergulho ímpar (isometria). -/
doc: /-- u : o mergulho par (isometria). -/

name: TGLExt.oddShift
head: def oddShift : ellTwo →L[ℂ] ellTwo := LinearMap.mkContinuous oddShiftLM 1 oddShiftLM_norm  /-- cE : a retração par. -/
doc: /-- v : o mergulho ímpar (isometria). -/

name: TGLExt.coEven
head: def coEven : ellTwo →L[ℂ] ellTwo := LinearMap.mkContinuous coEvenLM 1 coEvenLM_norm  /-- cO : a retração ímpar. -/
doc: /-- cE : a retração par. -/

name: TGLExt.coOdd
head: def coOdd : ellTwo →L[ℂ] ellTwo := LinearMap.mkContinuous coOddLM 1 coOddLM_norm  /-! ## D — as identidades da bipartição (PONTUAIS) -/
doc: /-- cO : a retração ímpar. -/

name: TGLExt.coEven_evenShift
head: theorem coEven_evenShift : coEven * evenShift = 1 := by ext x n show coEvenFun (evenShiftFun (x : ℕ → ℂ)) n = (x : ℕ → ℂ) n unfold coEvenFun
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ cE · u = 1. -/

name: TGLExt.coOdd_oddShift
head: theorem coOdd_oddShift : coOdd * oddShift = 1 := by ext x n show coOddFun (oddShiftFun (x : ℕ → ℂ)) n = (x : ℕ → ℂ) n unfold coOddFun
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ cO · v = 1. -/

name: TGLExt.shift_partition
head: theorem shift_partition : evenShift * coEven + oddShift * coOdd = 1 := by ext y k show evenShiftFun (coEvenFun (y : ℕ → ℂ)) k
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★ A BIPARTIÇÃO: u·cE + v·cO = 1 — a casa é DUAS cópias de si mesma (a marca das álgebras infinitas). -/

name: TGLExt.TracialState
head: structure TracialState where φ : (ellTwo →L[ℂ] ellTwo) → ℂ map_add : ∀ a b, φ (a + b) = φ a + φ b map_smul : ∀ (c : ℂ) a, φ (c • a) = c * φ a
doc: /-- [DATA — o contrato do traço limitado] linear + positivo-real + *-simétrico + tracial (star = adjunto da C*-face). Normalidade NÃO é exigida: o teorema mata até os não-normais. -/

name: TGLExt.tracial_one_eq_zero
head: theorem tracial_one_eq_zero (T : TracialState) : T.φ 1 = 0 := by have h1 : T.φ 1 = T.φ (evenShift * coEven) := by rw [← coEven_evenShift] exact T.tracial coEven evenShift
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★ A BIPARTIÇÃO MATA φ(1): φ(1) = φ(cE·u) = φ(u·cE) e φ(1) = φ(cO·v) = φ(v·cO); somando, 2φ(1) = φ(u·cE + v·cO) = φ(1). -/

name: TGLExt.tracial_state_is_zero
head: theorem tracial_state_is_zero (T : TracialState) (a : ellTwo →L[ℂ] ellTwo) : T.φ a = 0 := by by_contra hne have hApos : 0 < ‖T.φ a‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hne
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★★ O TEOREMA DO TRAÇO ZERO: todo estado tracial sobre B(ℓ²) é IDENTICAMENTE ZERO — "o único traço é zero" (v117), agora no nível da álgebra, pelo argumento quadrático da positividade. -/

name: TGLExt.fullAlgebra
head: def fullAlgebra : VonNeumannAlgebra ellTwo where toStarSubalgebra := ⊤ centralizer_centralizer' := by ext x
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★ O PRIMEIRO OBJETO DE VON NEUMANN DO PROGRAMA: B(ℓ²) — o bicomutante de tudo é tudo. -/

name: TGLExt.bipartition_mem_fullAlgebra
head: theorem bipartition_mem_fullAlgebra : evenShift ∈ (fullAlgebra : Set (ellTwo →L[ℂ] ellTwo)) ∧ coEven ∈ (fullAlgebra : Set (ellTwo →L[ℂ] ellTwo)) := by constructor <;> exact trivial
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ a bipartição MORA na álgebra de von Neumann. -/

name: ChatgptAudit.omega_product_inner
head: theorem omega_product_inner (x y : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P) : omegaState P (x*y) = inner ℂ (star x (hOmega P)) (y (hOmega P)) := by change inner ℂ (hOmega P) (x (y (hOmega P))) = inner ℂ (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint x (hOmega P)) (y (hOmega P))

name: ChatgptAudit.centralizer_from_expectations
head: theorem centralizer_from_expectations (x : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P) (hx : x ∈ theFactorObject P) (hc : ∀ N, towerExpectation P N x ∈ omegaCentralizer P) : x ∈ omegaCentralizer P := by refine ⟨hx,?_⟩

name: ChatgptAudit.half_profile_weights
head: theorem half_profile_weights (hp : ∀ n, P.w n = 1/2) (N : ℕ) (i j : chainIdx N) : towerW P N i = towerW P N j := by have hs : ∀ n (u v : Fin 2), siteW (P.w n) u = siteW (P.w n) v := by intro n u v

name: ChatgptAudit.half_profile_local_centralizer
head: theorem half_profile_local_centralizer (hp : ∀ n, P.w n = 1/2) (N : ℕ) (a : Matrix (chainIdx N) (chainIdx N) ℂ) : towerPi P a ∈ omegaCentralizer P := by apply density_commuting_local_is_global_centralizer N a ext i j

name: ChatgptAudit.half_profile_centralizer_is_factor
head: theorem half_profile_centralizer_is_factor (hp : ∀ n, P.w n = 1/2) (x : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P) : x ∈ omegaCentralizer P ↔ x ∈ theFactorObject P := by constructor

name: ChatgptAudit.tracialExpectationInput
head: def tracialExpectationInput (P : SiteProfile) (hp : ∀ n, P.w n = 1/2) : ExpectationInput P where E := id into := fun x hx => (half_profile_centralizer_is_factor hp x).mpr hx fixes := fun _ _ => rfl

name: ChatgptAudit.tracial_expectation_is_identity
head: theorem tracial_expectation_is_identity (hp : ∀ n, P.w n = 1/2) (x : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P) : (tracialExpectationInput P hp).E x = x := rfl  #print axioms omega_product_inner

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.kd
head: def kd (a b : ι) : ℝ := if a = b then 1 else 0  lemma sum_kd_left (f : ι → ℝ) (d : ι) : ∑ a, kd a d * f a = f d := by simp [kd, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
doc: /-- o delta de Kronecker real -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.sum_kd_left
head: lemma sum_kd_left (f : ι → ℝ) (d : ι) : ∑ a, kd a d * f a = f d := by simp [kd, Finset.sum_ite_eq']  lemma sum_kd_right (f : ι → ℝ) (d : ι) : ∑ a, kd d a * f a = f d := by

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.sum_kd_right
head: lemma sum_kd_right (f : ι → ℝ) (d : ι) : ∑ a, kd d a * f a = f d := by simp [kd, Finset.sum_ite_eq]  lemma sum_kd_self : ∑ a : ι, kd a a = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) := by

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.sum_kd_self
head: lemma sum_kd_self : ∑ a : ι, kd a a = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) := by simp [kd]  /-! ## 1. A torção tracial e a sua contorção -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.torsion
head: def torsion (A : ι → ℝ) (a b c : ι) : ℝ := kd a b * A c - kd a c * A b  /-- [KERNEL] antissimetria nos índices baixos -/ theorem torsion_antisymm (A : ι → ℝ) (a b c : ι) :
doc: /-- [DEF] a torção tracial mista T^a_{bc} = δ^a_b A_c − δ^a_c A_b (A = V/(n−1)) -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.torsion_antisymm
head: theorem torsion_antisymm (A : ι → ℝ) (a b c : ι) : torsion A a b c = - torsion A a c b := by unfold torsion; ring
doc: /-- [KERNEL] antissimetria nos índices baixos -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.torsion_trace
head: theorem torsion_trace (A : ι → ℝ) (c : ι) : ∑ a, torsion A a a c = ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - 1) * A c := by unfold torsion rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, sum_kd_self, sum_kd_left]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] o traço da torção: ∑_a T^a_{ac} = (n − 1)·A_c = V_c -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.torsion_quadratic_bianchi_zero
head: theorem torsion_quadratic_bianchi_zero (A : ι → ℝ) (a b c d : ι) : ∑ e, (torsion A e b c * torsion A a d e + torsion A e c d * torsion A a b e + torsion A e d b * torsion A a c e) = 0 := by have expand : ∀ x y z : ι, ∑ e, torsion A e x y * torsion A a z e
doc: /-- [KERNEL] o termo quadrático da primeira identidade de Bianchi é NULO, em toda dimensão e para todo A: ∑_e (T^e_{bc} T^a_{de} + T^e_{cd} T^a_{be} + T^e_{db} T^a_{ce}) = 0 -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.contortion
head: def contortion (g : ι → ι → ℝ) (A : ι → ℝ) (a b c : ι) : ℝ := g a b * A c - g b c * A a  /-- [KERNEL] a contorção reproduz a torção tracial baixada: K_{abc} − K_{acb} = g_{ab}A_c − g_{ac}A_b -/ theorem contortion_gives_torsion (g : ι → ι → ℝ) (hg : ∀ i j, g i j = g j i) (A : ι → ℝ) (a b c : ι) :
doc: /-- [DEF] a contorção com todos os índices baixos: K_{abc} = g_{ab} A_c − g_{bc} A_a (b é o índice de derivada) -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.contortion_gives_torsion
head: theorem contortion_gives_torsion (g : ι → ι → ℝ) (hg : ∀ i j, g i j = g j i) (A : ι → ℝ) (a b c : ι) : contortion g A a b c - contortion g A a c b = g a b * A c - g a c * A b := by unfold contortion; rw [hg c b]; ring
doc: /-- [KERNEL] a contorção reproduz a torção tracial baixada: K_{abc} − K_{acb} = g_{ab}A_c − g_{ac}A_b -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.contortion_metric_compatible
head: theorem contortion_metric_compatible (g : ι → ι → ℝ) (hg : ∀ i j, g i j = g j i) (A : ι → ℝ) (a b c : ι) : contortion g A a b c + contortion g A c b a = 0 := by unfold contortion; rw [hg c b, hg b a]; ring
doc: /-- [KERNEL] a contorção é compatível com a métrica: K_{abc} + K_{cba} = 0 -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.torsion_axial_zero
head: theorem torsion_axial_zero (g : ι → ι → ℝ) (hg : ∀ i j, g i j = g j i) (A : ι → ℝ) (a b c : ι) : (g a b * A c - g a c * A b) + (g b c * A a - g b a * A c) + (g c a * A b - g c b * A a) = 0 := by rw [hg b a, hg c a, hg c b]; ring
doc: /-- [KERNEL] a parte axial (totalmente antissimétrica) da torção tracial é NULA -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.riemann
head: def riemann (Gam : ι → ι → ι → ℝ) (dGam : ι → ι → ι → ι → ℝ) (a b c d : ι) : ℝ := dGam c a d b - dGam d a c b + ∑ e, (Gam a c e * Gam e d b - Gam a d e * Gam e c b)  /-- [DEF] a derivada covariante de Levi-Civita da contorção: ∇̊_c K^a_{db} -/
doc: /-- [DEF] Riemann de uma conexão (índice de derivada primeiro): R^a_{bcd} = ∂_c Γ^a_{db} − ∂_d Γ^a_{cb} + Γ^a_{ce}Γ^e_{db} − Γ^a_{de}Γ^e_{cb}; `dGam e a x y` = ∂_e Γ^a_{xy} -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.covK
head: def covK (G0 K : ι → ι → ι → ℝ) (dK : ι → ι → ι → ι → ℝ) (c a d b : ι) : ℝ := dK c a d b + ∑ e, (G0 a c e * K e d b - G0 e c d * K a e b - G0 e c b * K a d e)  /-- [KERNEL] ★★ A DECOMPOSIÇÃO DE RIEMANN–CARTAN: com Γ = Γ̊ + K e Γ̊ simétrica,
doc: /-- [DEF] a derivada covariante de Levi-Civita da contorção: ∇̊_c K^a_{db} -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.riemann_cartan_decomposition
head: theorem riemann_cartan_decomposition (G0 K : ι → ι → ι → ℝ) (dG0 dK : ι → ι → ι → ι → ℝ) (hsym : ∀ e x y, G0 e x y = G0 e y x) (a b c d : ι) : riemann (fun x y z => G0 x y z + K x y z) (fun w x y z => dG0 w x y z + dK w x y z) a b c d = riemann G0 dG0 a b c d + covK G0 K dK c a d b - covK G0 K dK d a c b
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★ A DECOMPOSIÇÃO DE RIEMANN–CARTAN: com Γ = Γ̊ + K e Γ̊ simétrica, R^a_{bcd}(Γ) = R^a_{bcd}(Γ̊) + ∇̊_c K^a_{db} − ∇̊_d K^a_{cb} + K^a_{ce}K^e_{db} − K^a_{de}K^e_{cb} -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.ricciOf
head: def ricciOf (Gam : ι → ι → ι → ℝ) (dGam : ι → ι → ι → ι → ℝ) (b d : ι) : ℝ := ∑ a, riemann Gam dGam a b a d  /-! ## 3. As contrações do Ricci para a contorção tracial -/
doc: /-- [DEF] a contração de Ricci R_{bd} = ∑_a R^a_{bad} -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.raise
head: def raise (A : ι → ℝ) (a : ι) : ℝ := ∑ d, gi a d * A d  /-- [DEF] a contorção mista K^a_{bc} = δ^a_b A_c − g_{bc} A^a -/ def Kmix (A : ι → ℝ) (a b c : ι) : ℝ := kd a b * A c - g b c * raise gi A a
doc: /-- [DEF] o vetor com índice alto A^a = g^{ad} A_d -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.Kmix
head: def Kmix (A : ι → ℝ) (a b c : ι) : ℝ := kd a b * A c - g b c * raise gi A a  include hinv in /-- [KERNEL] baixar o índice levantado devolve o vetor: ∑_e g_{de} A^e = A_d -/
doc: /-- [DEF] a contorção mista K^a_{bc} = δ^a_b A_c − g_{bc} A^a -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.lower_raise
head: theorem lower_raise (A : ι → ℝ) (d : ι) : ∑ e, g d e * raise gi A e = A d := by unfold raise have : ∑ e, g d e * ∑ f, gi e f * A f = ∑ f, (∑ e, g d e * gi e f) * A f := by simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] baixar o índice levantado devolve o vetor: ∑_e g_{de} A^e = A_d -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.Kmix_trace
head: theorem Kmix_trace (A : ι → ℝ) (e : ι) : ∑ a, Kmix g gi A a a e = ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - 1) * A e := by unfold Kmix rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, sum_kd_self]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] o traço da contorção mista: ∑_a K^a_{ae} = (n − 1)·A_e -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.normSq
head: def normSq (A : ι → ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ a, A a * raise gi A a  include hg hinv in /-- [KERNEL] ★ a parte quadrática do Ricci:
doc: /-- [DEF] A² = A_a A^a -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.ricci_KK
head: theorem ricci_KK (A : ι → ℝ) (d b : ι) : ∑ a, ∑ e, (Kmix g gi A a a e * Kmix g gi A e d b - Kmix g gi A a d e * Kmix g gi A e a b) = ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - 2) * (A b * A d - g d b * normSq gi A) := by have hlr := lower_raise g gi hinv A
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ a parte quadrática do Ricci: ∑_{a,e} (K^a_{ae}K^e_{db} − K^a_{de}K^e_{ab}) = (n − 2)(A_b A_d − g_{db} A²) -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.DKmix
head: def DKmix (DA : ι → ι → ℝ) (c a d b : ι) : ℝ := kd a d * DA c b - g d b * ∑ e, gi a e * DA c e  /-- [DEF] a divergência ∇̊·A = g^{ae} ∇̊_a A_e -/
doc: /-- [DEF] a derivada covariante de Levi-Civita da contorção mista, com `DA c b` = ∇̊_c A_b (∇̊g = 0 e ∇̊δ = 0): ∇̊_c K^a_{db} = δ^a_d ∇̊_c A_b − g_{db} ∇̊_c A^a -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.divA
head: def divA (DA : ι → ι → ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ a, ∑ e, gi a e * DA a e  include hg hinv in /-- [KERNEL] ★ a parte derivativa do Ricci:
doc: /-- [DEF] a divergência ∇̊·A = g^{ae} ∇̊_a A_e -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.ricci_DK
head: theorem ricci_DK (DA : ι → ι → ℝ) (d b : ι) : ∑ a, (DKmix g gi DA a a d b - DKmix g gi DA d a a b) = -((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - 2) * DA d b - g d b * divA gi DA := by unfold DKmix divA
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ a parte derivativa do Ricci: ∑_a (∇̊_a K^a_{db} − ∇̊_d K^a_{ab}) = −(n − 2)∇̊_d A_b − g_{db} ∇̊·A -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.covK_Kmix
head: theorem covK_Kmix (G0 : ι → ι → ι → ℝ) (A : ι → ℝ) (dg dgi : ι → ι → ι → ℝ) (dA : ι → ι → ℝ) (dK : ι → ι → ι → ι → ℝ) (hdg : ∀ c d b, dg c d b = ∑ e, (G0 e c d * g e b + G0 e c b * g d e)) (hdgi : ∀ c a e, dgi c a e = - ∑ f, ∑ h, gi a f * dg c f h * gi h e)
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ a derivada covariante da contorção mista SAI da compatibilidade métrica: se ∂_c g_{db} = Γ̊^e_{cd} g_{eb} + Γ̊^e_{cb} g_{de}, ∂_c g^{ae} = −g^{af}(∂_c g_{fh})g^{he} e dK é a derivada (Leibniz) de K^a_{db} = δ^a_d A_b − g_{db}A^a, então ∇̊_c K^a_{db} = δ^a_d ∇̊_c A_b − g_{db} g^{ae} ∇̊_c A_e, com ∇̊_c A_b = ∂_c A_b − Γ̊^e_{cb} A_e -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.ricci_closed_form
head: theorem ricci_closed_form (G0 : ι → ι → ι → ℝ) (dG0 dK : ι → ι → ι → ι → ℝ) (A : ι → ℝ) (DA : ι → ι → ℝ) (hsym : ∀ e x y, G0 e x y = G0 e y x) (hcov : ∀ c a d b, covK G0 (Kmix g gi A) dK c a d b = DKmix g gi DA c a d b) (b d : ι) : ricciOf (fun x y z => G0 x y z + Kmix g gi A x y z) (fun w x y z => dG0 w x y z + dK w x y z) b d
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★ O RICCI FECHADO da conexão Γ̊ + K (K tracial), dada a derivada covariante da contorção: R_{bd} = R̊_{bd} − (n−2)∇̊_d A_b − g_{db}∇̊·A + (n−2)(A_b A_d − g_{db}A²) -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.ricci_of_tracial_connection
head: theorem ricci_of_tracial_connection (G0 : ι → ι → ι → ℝ) (dG0 dK : ι → ι → ι → ι → ℝ) (A : ι → ℝ) (dg dgi : ι → ι → ι → ℝ) (dA : ι → ι → ℝ) (hsym : ∀ e x y, G0 e x y = G0 e y x) (hdg : ∀ c d b, dg c d b = ∑ e, (G0 e c d * g e b + G0 e c b * g d e)) (hdgi : ∀ c a e, dgi c a e = - ∑ f, ∑ h, gi a f * dg c f h * gi h e)
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★ o Ricci da conexão tracial SEM hipótese sobre ∇̊K: só a compatibilidade métrica de Γ̊, a derivada da inversa e a regra de Leibniz -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.scalarOf
head: def scalarOf (Ric : ι → ι → ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ b, ∑ d, gi b d * Ric b d  /-- [DEF] o tensor de Einstein G_{bd} = R_{bd} − ½ g_{bd} R -/ noncomputable def einsteinOf (Ric : ι → ι → ℝ) (b d : ι) : ℝ := Ric b d - g b d * scalarOf gi Ric / 2
doc: /-- [DEF] o escalar de curvatura R = g^{bd} R_{bd} -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.einsteinOf
head: noncomputable def einsteinOf (Ric : ι → ι → ℝ) (b d : ι) : ℝ := Ric b d - g b d * scalarOf gi Ric / 2  include hg hinv in /-- [KERNEL] ★ o escalar fechado: R = R̊ − 2(n−1)∇̊·A − (n−1)(n−2)A² -/
doc: /-- [DEF] o tensor de Einstein G_{bd} = R_{bd} − ½ g_{bd} R -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.scalar_closed_form
head: theorem scalar_closed_form (hgi : ∀ i j, gi i j = gi j i) (Ric Ric0 : ι → ι → ℝ) (A : ι → ℝ) (DA : ι → ι → ℝ) (hRic : ∀ b d, Ric b d = Ric0 b d - ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - 2) * DA d b - g d b * divA gi DA + ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - 2) * (A b * A d - g d b * normSq gi A)) :
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ o escalar fechado: R = R̊ − 2(n−1)∇̊·A − (n−1)(n−2)A² -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.einstein_closed_form
head: theorem einstein_closed_form (hgi : ∀ i j, gi i j = gi j i) (Ric Ric0 : ι → ι → ℝ) (A : ι → ℝ) (DA : ι → ι → ℝ) (hRic : ∀ b d, Ric b d = Ric0 b d - ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - 2) * DA d b - g d b * divA gi DA + ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - 2) * (A b * A d - g d b * normSq gi A)) (b d : ι) :
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★ O EINSTEIN FECHADO: G_{bd} = G̊_{bd} − (n−2)[∇̊_d A_b − g_{bd}∇̊·A − A_b A_d − ((n−3)/2) g_{bd} A²] -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.einstein_antisymmetric_part
head: theorem einstein_antisymmetric_part (Ric Ric0 : ι → ι → ℝ) (A : ι → ℝ) (DA : ι → ι → ℝ) (hRic0 : ∀ b d, Ric0 b d = Ric0 d b) (hRic : ∀ b d, Ric b d = Ric0 b d - ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - 2) * DA d b - g d b * divA gi DA + ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - 2) * (A b * A d - g d b * normSq gi A)) (b d : ι) :
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ a parte antissimétrica: G_{[bd]} = −((n−2)/2)(∇̊_d A_b − ∇̊_b A_d) — nula se e só se A é localmente um gradiente (F = dA = 0) -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.torsionSupplier
head: noncomputable def torsionSupplier (Ric Ric0 : ι → ι → ℝ) (b d : ι) : ℝ := ((einsteinOf g gi Ric0 b d - einsteinOf g gi Ric b d) + (einsteinOf g gi Ric0 d b - einsteinOf g gi Ric d b)) / 2
doc: /-- [DEF] o FORNECEDOR DE TORÇÃO κ T^{tors/diss}_{bd}: a parte simétrica de G̊ − G (a geometria fica Levi-Civita e a torção vira fonte) -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.torsion_supplier_closed_form
head: theorem torsion_supplier_closed_form (hgi : ∀ i j, gi i j = gi j i) (Ric Ric0 : ι → ι → ℝ) (A : ι → ℝ) (DA : ι → ι → ℝ) (hRic : ∀ b d, Ric b d = Ric0 b d - ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - 2) * DA d b - g d b * divA gi DA + ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - 2) * (A b * A d - g d b * normSq gi A)) (b d : ι) :
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★★ O FORNECEDOR EM FORMA FECHADA: κ T^{tors/diss}_{bd} = (n−2)[∇̊_{(d}A_{b)} − g_{bd}∇̊·A − A_b A_d − ((n−3)/2) g_{bd} A²] -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.flrw_torsion_shift
head: theorem flrw_torsion_shift (H α κρ : ℝ) : 3 * H ^ 2 = κρ + (6 * α * H - 3 * α ^ 2) ↔ 3 * (H - α) ^ 2 = κρ := by constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith [h]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ a lei de expansão com torção tracial (A = α n, α constante, FLRW plano): a equação de Friedmann com a fonte de torção 6αH − 3α² é exatamente 3(H − α)² = κρ -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.flrw_torsion_empty_limit
head: theorem flrw_torsion_empty_limit (H α : ℝ) (h : 3 * (H - α) ^ 2 = 0) : H = α := by have : (H - α) ^ 2 = 0 := by linarith have := pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.mp this linarith
doc: /-- [KERNEL] no futuro vazio (κρ = 0) a taxa de expansão é H = α: a torção tracial com α constante faz o papel de uma taxa de de Sitter -/

name: TGLExt.TracialTorsion.flrw_torsion_shift_dim
head: theorem flrw_torsion_shift_dim (m H α κρ : ℝ) : (m - 1) * (m - 2) / 2 * H ^ 2 = κρ + (m - 2) * (α * ((m - 1) * H) - (m - 1) / 2 * α ^ 2) ↔ (m - 1) * (m - 2) / 2 * (H - α) ^ 2 = κρ := by constructor <;> intro h <;> linear_combination h
doc: /-- [KERNEL] a lei em dimensão m: com ϑ = (m−1)H e a fonte κρ_tors = (m−2)[αϑ − ((m−1)/2)α²], ((m−1)(m−2)/2) H² = κρ + κρ_tors ⟺ ((m−1)(m−2)/2)(H − α)² = κρ -/

name: TGLExt.lock_pairing_eq
head: theorem lock_pairing_eq (D : Matrix n n ℂ) (v : n → ℂ) : star v ⬝ᵥ (Dᴴ * D).mulVec v = star (D.mulVec v) ⬝ᵥ D.mulVec v := by rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.star_mulVec]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] O PAREAMENTO DO LOCK: `⟨v, DᴴD v⟩ = ⟨Dv, Dv⟩` — cada setor da ação dos Three Locks é um quadrado perfeito (a positividade é estrutural, não postulada). -/

name: TGLExt.action_locks_zero_iff
head: theorem action_locks_zero_iff (Dc Db Dz : Matrix n n ℂ) (v : n → ℂ) : star v ⬝ᵥ (Dcᴴ * Dc + Dbᴴ * Db + Dzᴴ * Dz).mulVec v = 0 ↔ Dc.mulVec v = 0 ∧ Db.mulVec v = 0 ∧ Dz.mulVec v = 0 := by have hsplit : star v ⬝ᵥ (Dcᴴ * Dc + Dbᴴ * Db + Dzᴴ * Dz).mulVec v
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ EULER–LAGRANGE SELECIONA O NÚCLEO: a ação dos três locks `S_{3L}[v] = ⟨v, (D_cᴴD_c + D_bᴴD_b + D_zᴴD_z) v⟩` anula SSE cada lock anula — `ker H_{3L} = ker D_c ∩ ker D_b ∩ ker D_z`. `P_F = 1_{{0}}(H_{3L})` é o projetor sobre os MINIMIZADORES da ação (derivação do operador: o canto não é escolhido depois da Lagrangiana; é o suporte do mínimo). -/

name: TGLExt.hermitian_pairing_re
head: theorem hermitian_pairing_re (H : Matrix n n ℂ) (hH : H.IsHermitian) (v η : n → ℂ) : (star v ⬝ᵥ H.mulVec η).re = (star η ⬝ᵥ H.mulVec v).re := by have hconj : star (star η ⬝ᵥ H.mulVec v) = star v ⬝ᵥ H.mulVec η := by
doc: /-- [KERNEL] Simetria hermitiana do pareamento (parte real): `re⟨v, Hη⟩ = re⟨η, Hv⟩` para `H` hermitiana. -/

name: TGLExt.action_hasDerivAt
head: theorem action_hasDerivAt (H : Matrix n n ℂ) (hH : H.IsHermitian) (v η : n → ℂ) : HasDerivAt (fun ε : ℝ => (star (v + (ε : ℂ) • η) ⬝ᵥ H.mulVec (v + (ε : ℂ) • η)).re)
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ EULER–LAGRANGE COMO DERIVADA GENUÍNA: ao longo de QUALQUER direção `η`, `d/dε S[v + εη]|_{ε=0} = 2·re⟨η, Hv⟩` (`HasDerivAt`, não forma-check). A variação da ação quadrática é o pareamento com `Hv` — "as equações de Euler–Lagrange são o certificado". -/

name: TGLExt.critical_pairing_iff
head: theorem critical_pairing_iff (H : Matrix n n ℂ) (v : n → ℂ) : (∀ η : n → ℂ, star η ⬝ᵥ H.mulVec v = 0) ↔ H.mulVec v = 0 := by constructor · intro h
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ CRÍTICO ⟺ EQUAÇÃO DE EULER–LAGRANGE: o pareamento direcional anula em TODA direção sse `Hv = 0` (tome `η = Hv`: `⟨Hv, Hv⟩ = 0`). O físico não guarda um ponto — guarda a equação que o transporte resolve. -/

name: TGLExt.transport
head: def transport (ρ : Matrix n n ℂ) (t s : ℝ) (a : Matrix n n ℂ) : Matrix n n ℂ := sigma ρ (t - s) a
doc: /-- O TRANSPORTE modular de dois parâmetros: `𝒯_{t,s} := σ_{t−s}` — a lei da passagem entre inscrições (VERBO = transporte). -/

name: TGLExt.transport_refl
head: @[simp] theorem transport_refl (ρ : Matrix n n ℂ) (t : ℝ) (a : Matrix n n ℂ) : transport ρ t t a = a := by simp [transport, sigma, modPow_zero]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] `𝒯_{t,t} = id`: o transporte nulo é a identidade. -/

name: TGLExt.transport_comp
head: theorem transport_comp (ρ : Matrix n n ℂ) (t r s : ℝ) (a : Matrix n n ℂ) : transport ρ t r (transport ρ r s a) = transport ρ t s a := by unfold transport rw [sigma_sigma, sub_add_sub_cancel]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ A LEI DE COMPOSIÇÃO: `𝒯_{t,r} ∘ 𝒯_{r,s} = 𝒯_{t,s}` — a testemunha é uma lei de composição temporal/modular, não um habitante imóvel. -/

name: TGLExt.transport_fixes_name
head: theorem transport_fixes_name (ρ : Matrix n n ℂ) (t s : ℝ) (a : Matrix n n ℂ) : gibbs ρ (transport ρ t s a) = gibbs ρ a := gibbs_sigma ρ (t - s) a
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ O NOME É FIXADO PELO SEU PRÓPRIO TRANSPORTE: `ω(𝒯_{t,s}(a)) = ω(a)` — o estado crítico (KMS) é exatamente aquele cuja lei de transporte o preserva (o encontro do variacional v52 com o transporte: o físico é a relação, não o ponto). -/

name: TGLExt.transport_trace
head: theorem transport_trace (ρ : Matrix n n ℂ) (t s : ℝ) (a : Matrix n n ℂ) : (transport ρ t s a).trace = a.trace := by unfold transport sigma rw [Matrix.trace_mul_cycle, modPow_neg_mul, one_mul]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ O TRANSPORTE INTERNO PRESERVA O TRAÇO: `c_{t,s} = 1` — o par honesto da compatibilidade `τ ∘ 𝒯 = c·τ` (interno `c = 1` AQUI; dual `c = e^{−s}`, já tipado em `DualScalingData`, v45 — e é EXATAMENTE essa diferença que obstrui o traço nos degraus discretos). -/

name: TGLExt.transport_corner
head: theorem transport_corner (ρ H : Matrix n n ℂ) (h : Commute ρ H) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (t s : ℝ) : transport ρ t s (cfc f H) = cfc f H := corner_fixed_by_flow ρ H h f (t - s)
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ O CANTO É COVARIANTEMENTE CONSTANTE: sob o transporte gerado pelo PRÓPRIO fluxo, `P_F(t) = 𝒯_{t,s}(P_F) = P_F` (canto espectral de gerador comutante). A família NÃO-trivial de cantos exige transporte EXTERNO (`U(g)` de Poincaré) — o gate aberto do canto covariante. -/

name: TGLExt.NamedTransportData
head: structure NamedTransportData (M : Type) where /-- o transporte `𝒯_{t,s}`. -/ T : ℝ → ℝ → M → M /-- o NOME transportado (o funcional). -/
doc: /-- A LEI DO TRANSPORTE COM NOME: o tipo da testemunha do operador (`𝔚 = ({W_t}, {𝒯_{t,s}}, ℒ)` na face finita): transporte de dois parâmetros + funcional transportado. HONESTIDADE: o TIPO admite habitantes triviais (`T = id`); o conteúdo está no TERMO canônico sobre o fluxo modular (`canonicalNamedTransport`) e nos teoremas ★ acima — a mesma disciplina do v22/v23 (rigidez medida, não suposta). -/

name: TGLExt.canonicalNamedTransport
head: noncomputable def canonicalNamedTransport (ρ : Matrix n n ℂ) : NamedTransportData (Matrix n n ℂ) where T := fun t s a => transport ρ t s a name := gibbs ρ
doc: /-- ★ O TERMO: o transporte modular canônico com o Nome de Gibbs — construído, não postulado (primeiro o termo; existência corolário). -/

name: TGLExt.canonicalNamedTransport_exists
head: theorem canonicalNamedTransport_exists (ρ : Matrix n n ℂ) : Nonempty (NamedTransportData (Matrix n n ℂ)) := ⟨canonicalNamedTransport ρ⟩
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ EXISTÊNCIA (corolário do termo): a testemunha-transporte com Nome existe sobre toda matriz densidade. -/

name: TGLExt.excite_holonomy
head: theorem excite_holonomy (A B x : Matrix n n ℂ) : excite A (excite B x) - excite B (excite A x) = excite (excite A B) x := by simp only [excite] noncomm_ring
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ A HOLONOMIA INFINITESIMAL FECHA NO COMUTADOR: `δ_A ∘ δ_B − δ_B ∘ δ_A = δ_{[A,B]}` — a falha de comutação de dois transportes infinitesimais É a excitação gerada pelo comutador dos geradores ("gravidade = curvatura do transporte", face infinitesimal; a ponte com `[h₊, h×] = 2J` do v49: a geometria fecha no gerador de helicidade). -/

name: TGLExt.excite_holonomy_flat
head: theorem excite_holonomy_flat (A B : Matrix n n ℂ) (h : Commute A B) (x : Matrix n n ℂ) : excite A (excite B x) - excite B (excite A x) = 0 := by rw [excite_holonomy]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] TRANSPORTE PLANO: geradores comutantes ⟹ holonomia zero — a curvatura mede exatamente a não-comutatividade (sem contraste, sem gravidade). -/

name: ChatgptAudit.TransverseGibbs.weights_interior
head: theorem weights_interior (k s : ℝ) (i : Fin 2) : 0 < transverseWeights k s i ∧ transverseWeights k s i < 1 := by have h := abs_lt.mp (magnetization_strict_bound k s) fin_cases i <;> norm_num [transverseWeights, signOutcome] <;> constructor <;> linarith

name: ChatgptAudit.TransverseGibbs.weights_zero
head: theorem weights_zero (k : ℝ) (i : Fin 2) : transverseWeights k 0 i = 1/2 := by simp [transverseWeights, magnetization_zero]

name: ChatgptAudit.TransverseGibbs.weights_first_jet
head: theorem weights_first_jet (k : ℝ) (i : Fin 2) : HasDerivAt (fun s => transverseWeights k s i) (signOutcome i * susceptibility k / 2) 0 := by simpa [transverseWeights] using

name: ChatgptAudit.TransverseGibbs.responseWeights
head: def responseWeights (k velocity t : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ := transverseWeights k (velocity*t)  theorem response_weights_smooth (k velocity : ℝ) (i : Fin 2) :

name: ChatgptAudit.TransverseGibbs.response_weights_smooth
head: theorem response_weights_smooth (k velocity : ℝ) (i : Fin 2) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun t => responseWeights k velocity t i) := (weights_smooth k i).comp (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id)

name: ChatgptAudit.TransverseGibbs.responseCurve
head: def responseCurve (k velocity : ℝ) : DiagonalStateCurve (fun _ : Fin 2 => (1/2 : ℝ)) where weights := responseWeights k velocity tangent := fun t i => deriv (fun s => responseWeights k velocity s i) t at_zero := by intro i; simpa [responseWeights] using weights_zero k i

name: ChatgptAudit.TransverseGibbs.response_first_jet
head: theorem response_first_jet (k velocity : ℝ) (i : Fin 2) : HasDerivAt (fun t => responseWeights k velocity t i) (velocity * signOutcome i * susceptibility k / 2) 0 := by have ho : HasDerivAt (fun s => transverseWeights k s i)

name: ChatgptAudit.TransverseGibbs.response_tangent_zero
head: theorem response_tangent_zero (k velocity : ℝ) (i : Fin 2) : (responseCurve k velocity).tangent 0 i = velocity * signOutcome i * susceptibility k / 2 := (response_first_jet k velocity i).deriv

name: ChatgptAudit.TransverseGibbs.response_fisher
head: theorem response_fisher (k velocity : ℝ) : diagonalFisher (fun _ : Fin 2 => (1/2 : ℝ)) ((responseCurve k velocity).tangent 0) = (susceptibility k * velocity)^2 := by simp [diagonalFisher, Fin.sum_univ_two, response_tangent_zero, signOutcome]

name: ChatgptAudit.TransverseGibbs.response_relative_entropy_limit
head: theorem response_relative_entropy_limit (k velocity : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun t => diagonalRelativeEntropy (responseWeights k velocity t) (fun _ : Fin 2 => (1/2 : ℝ)) / t^2) (𝓝[<] 0) (𝓝 ((susceptibility k * velocity)^2 / 2)) := by

name: ChatgptAudit.TransverseGibbs.uniform_modular_increment_zero
head: theorem uniform_modular_increment_zero (k velocity t : ℝ) : modularIncrement (fun _ : Fin 2 => (1/2 : ℝ)) (responseWeights k velocity t) = 0 := by simp [modularIncrement, Fin.sum_univ_two, responseWeights, transverseWeights, signOutcome] ring

name: ChatgptAudit.TransverseGibbs.entropy_response_identity
head: theorem entropy_response_identity (k velocity t : ℝ) : finiteEntropy (responseWeights k velocity t) - finiteEntropy (fun _ : Fin 2 => (1/2 : ℝ)) = -diagonalRelativeEntropy (responseWeights k velocity t)

name: ChatgptAudit.TransverseGibbs.response_entropy_quadratic_limit
head: theorem response_entropy_quadratic_limit (k velocity : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun t => (finiteEntropy (responseWeights k velocity t) - finiteEntropy (fun _ : Fin 2 => (1/2 : ℝ))) / t^2) (𝓝[<] 0) (𝓝 (-((susceptibility k * velocity)^2 / 2))) := by

name: ChatgptAudit.Flow018.transverseProjection
head: def transverseProjection (v : Coordinate4) (ell : Coordinate4 →L[ℝ] ℝ) : Coordinate4 →L[ℝ] Coordinate4 := ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ Coordinate4-ell.smulRight v

name: ChatgptAudit.Flow018.initialPosition
head: def initialPosition (p v : Coordinate4) (ell : Coordinate4 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (z : Coordinate4) : Coordinate4 := p+transverseProjection v ell z  theorem exists_normalized_covector (v : Coordinate4) (hv : v≠0) :

name: ChatgptAudit.Flow018.exists_normalized_covector

name: ChatgptAudit.Flow018.transverse_projection_decomposition

name: ChatgptAudit.Flow018.transverse_projection_velocity
head: theorem transverse_projection_velocity (v : Coordinate4) (ell : Coordinate4 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hell : ell v=1) : transverseProjection v ell v=0 := by simp [transverseProjection,hell]

name: ChatgptAudit.Flow018.initial_position_in_section
head: theorem initial_position_in_section (p v : Coordinate4) (ell : Coordinate4 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hell : ell v=1) (z : Coordinate4) : ell (initialPosition p v ell z-p)=0 := by simp [initialPosition,transverseProjection,map_sub,hell]

name: ChatgptAudit.Flow018.initial_position_shift
head: theorem initial_position_shift (p v : Coordinate4) (ell : Coordinate4 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hell : ell v=1) (z : Coordinate4) (s : ℝ) : initialPosition p v ell (z+s • v)=initialPosition p v ell z := by simp only [initialPosition,map_add,map_smul,transverse_projection_velocity v ell hell,smul_zero,add_zero]

name: ChatgptAudit.Flow018.initial_time_shift
head: theorem initial_time_shift (v : Coordinate4) (ell : Coordinate4 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hell : ell v=1) (z : Coordinate4) (s : ℝ) : ell (z+s • v)=ell z+s := by simp [map_add,map_smul,hell]

name: ChatgptAudit.Flow018.initial_position_smooth
head: theorem initial_position_smooth (p v : Coordinate4) (ell : Coordinate4 →L[ℝ] ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (initialPosition p v ell) := contDiff_const.add (transverseProjection v ell).contDiff

name: ChatgptAudit.Flow018.transportedNullSeed
head: def transportedNullSeed (A B : TensorField4) (p v : Coordinate4) (x : Coordinate4) : Coordinate4 := (B x).mulVec ((A p).mulVec v)  theorem transported_seed_initial (A B : TensorField4) (p v : Coordinate4)

name: ChatgptAudit.Flow018.transported_seed_initial
head: theorem transported_seed_initial (A B : TensorField4) (p v : Coordinate4) (hBA : B p*A p=1) : transportedNullSeed A B p v p=v := by simp only [transportedNullSeed,Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,hBA,Matrix.one_mulVec]

name: ChatgptAudit.Flow018.transported_seed_null
head: theorem transported_seed_null (A B : TensorField4) (p v x : Coordinate4) (hAB : A x*B x=1) (hn : tensorQuad (frameMetricField A p) v=0) : tensorQuad (frameMetricField A x) (transportedNullSeed A B p v x)=0 := by rw [frameMetricField,tensorQuad_congruence,transportedNullSeed,Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,hAB,Matrix.one_mulVec]

name: ChatgptAudit.Flow018.transported_seed_nonzero
head: theorem transported_seed_nonzero (A B : TensorField4) (p v x : Coordinate4) (hBA : B p*A p=1) (hAB : A x*B x=1) (hv : v≠0) : transportedNullSeed A B p v x≠0 := by intro hz

name: ChatgptAudit.Flow018.transported_seed_smooth
head: theorem transported_seed_smooth (U : Set Coordinate4) (A B : TensorField4) (hB : SmoothMatrixOn U B) (p v : Coordinate4) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (transportedNullSeed A B p v) U := by apply contDiffOn_pi.2

name: TGLExt.einstein_coefficient_from_clausius
head: theorem einstein_coefficient_from_clausius (kappa a G : ℝ) (hG : G ≠ 0) : (kappa / (2 * Real.pi)) * (a / (4 * G)) = kappa * a / (8 * Real.pi * G) := by have hpi : Real.pi ≠ 0 := Real.pi_ne_zero field_simp

name: TGLExt.jacobi_commutator_bianchi_seed
head: theorem jacobi_commutator_bianchi_seed {n : Type} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A B C : Matrix n n ℝ) : (A * B - B * A) * C - C * (A * B - B * A) + ((B * C - C * B) * A - A * (B * C - C * B))

name: ChatgptAudit.Unitary022.flowVelocity
head: def flowVelocity (a b frequency t : ℝ) : PairMatrix := (-frequency*Real.sin (frequency*t):ℂ) • 1+ (-Complex.I*(frequency*Real.cos (frequency*t):ℂ)) • axisHamiltonian a b

name: ChatgptAudit.Unitary022.frequency_cos_derivative
head: theorem frequency_cos_derivative (frequency t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun s => Real.cos (frequency*s)) (-frequency*Real.sin (frequency*t)) t := by convert ((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul frequency).cos using 1 <;> first | rfl | (dsimp; ring)

name: ChatgptAudit.Unitary022.frequency_sin_derivative
head: theorem frequency_sin_derivative (frequency t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun s => Real.sin (frequency*s)) (frequency*Real.cos (frequency*t)) t := by convert ((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul frequency).sin using 1 <;> first | rfl | (dsimp; ring)

name: ChatgptAudit.Unitary022.pair_flow_derivative
head: theorem pair_flow_derivative (a b frequency t : ℝ) (i j : Fin 2) : HasDerivAt (fun s => pairFlow a b frequency s i j) (flowVelocity a b frequency t i j) t := by have hh := (((frequency_cos_derivative frequency t).ofReal_comp.mul_const ((1:PairMatrix) i j)).add

name: ChatgptAudit.Unitary022.velocity_is_schrodinger
head: theorem velocity_is_schrodinger (a b frequency t : ℝ) (h : a^2+b^2=1) : flowVelocity a b frequency t= (-Complex.I) • (pairHamiltonian a b frequency*pairFlow a b frequency t) := by simp only [flowVelocity,pairHamiltonian,pairFlow,mul_add,smul_mul_assoc,mul_smul_comm,

name: ChatgptAudit.Unitary022.pair_flow_schrodinger
head: theorem pair_flow_schrodinger (a b frequency t : ℝ) (h : a^2+b^2=1) (i j : Fin 2) : HasDerivAt (fun s => pairFlow a b frequency s i j) (((-Complex.I) • (pairHamiltonian a b frequency*pairFlow a b frequency t)) i j) t := by rw [← velocity_is_schrodinger a b frequency t h]

name: ChatgptAudit.Unitary022.initialPair
head: def initialPair (u v : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℂ := ![(u:ℂ),(v:ℂ)] def evolvedPair (a b frequency u v t : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℂ := pairFlow a b frequency t *ᵥ initialPair u v

name: ChatgptAudit.Unitary022.evolvedPair
head: def evolvedPair (a b frequency u v t : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℂ := pairFlow a b frequency t *ᵥ initialPair u v  theorem evolved_pair_zero (a b frequency u v : ℝ) :

name: ChatgptAudit.Unitary022.evolved_pair_zero
head: theorem evolved_pair_zero (a b frequency u v : ℝ) : evolvedPair a b frequency u v 0=initialPair u v := by simp [evolvedPair,pair_flow_zero]

name: ChatgptAudit.Unitary022.evolved_pair_first
head: theorem evolved_pair_first (a b frequency u v t : ℝ) : evolvedPair a b frequency u v t 0= (u*Real.cos (frequency*t):ℂ)-Complex.I*((a*u+b*v)*Real.sin (frequency*t):ℂ) := by simp [evolvedPair,pairFlow,axisHamiltonian,initialPair,Matrix.mulVec,dotProduct,Fin.sum_univ_two]

name: ChatgptAudit.Unitary022.evolved_pair_second
head: theorem evolved_pair_second (a b frequency u v t : ℝ) : evolvedPair a b frequency u v t 1= (v*Real.cos (frequency*t):ℂ)-Complex.I*((b*u-a*v)*Real.sin (frequency*t):ℂ) := by simp [evolvedPair,pairFlow,axisHamiltonian,initialPair,Matrix.mulVec,dotProduct,Fin.sum_univ_two]

name: TGLExt.UmPosto.reading_recovers_implies_injective
head: theorem reading_recovers_implies_injective {Q R : Type*} (i : Q → R) (L : R → Q) (h : ∀ q, L (i q) = q) : Function.Injective i := by intro a b hab have hL := congrArg L hab
doc: /-- [KERNEL] a leitura que recupera a identidade inscrita torna a inscrição injetiva -/

name: TGLExt.UmPosto.injective_admits_reading
head: theorem injective_admits_reading {Q R : Type*} [Nonempty Q] (i : Q → R) (hi : Function.Injective i) : ∃ L : R → Q, ∀ q, L (i q) = q := ⟨Function.invFun i, fun q => Function.leftInverse_invFun hi q⟩
doc: /-- [KERNEL] a recíproca: toda inscrição injetiva de um tipo habitado admite leitura que a recupera -/

name: TGLExt.UmPosto.constant_registry_recognizes_nothing
head: theorem constant_registry_recognizes_nothing {Q R : Type*} (r : R) (a b : Q) (hab : a ≠ b) : ¬ ∃ L : R → Q, ∀ q, L ((fun _ : Q => r) q) = q := by rintro ⟨L, hL⟩ exact hab ((hL a).symm.trans (hL b))
doc: /-- [KERNEL] um registro que confirma todos os referentes não reconhece nenhum: com duas identidades distintas, a inscrição constante não admite leitura que recupere -/

name: TGLExt.UmPosto.unique_recognition_iff_injective
head: theorem unique_recognition_iff_injective {Q R : Type*} (i : Q → R) : (∀ q : Q, ∃! p : Q, i p = i q) ↔ Function.Injective i := by constructor · intro h a b hab
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ∃! : cada registro da imagem corresponde a exatamente uma identidade se e só se a inscrição é injetiva -/

name: TGLExt.UmPosto.covariant_reading_returns_transported
head: theorem covariant_reading_returns_transported {Q R : Type*} (i : Q → R) (L : R → Q) (T : Q → Q) (U : R → R) (h : ∀ q, L (i q) = q) (hcov : ∀ q, i (T q) = U (i q)) (q : Q) : L (U (i q)) = T q := by rw [← hcov q, h]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] permanência reconhecível: com a inscrição covariante (i ∘ T = U ∘ i) e a leitura que recupera, ler o registro transportado devolve a identidade transportada -/

name: TGLExt.UmPosto.intertwiner_reads_dynamics
head: theorem intertwiner_reads_dynamics {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] (k : Matrix n m ℂ) (T : Matrix m m ℂ) (D : Matrix n n ℂ) (hiso : kᴴ * k = 1) (hint : k * T = D * k) : T = kᴴ * D * k := by calc T = (kᴴ * k) * T := by rw [hiso, Matrix.one_mul]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ a forma da interface de H2: uma isometria k (k† k = 1) que entrelaça a dinâmica da torre T com a dinâmica modular D (k T = D k) faz T = k† D k — a dinâmica da torre é a modular lida pela inscrição -/

name: TGLExt.UmPosto.intertwines_iff_range_invariant
head: theorem intertwines_iff_range_invariant {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] (k : Matrix n m ℂ) (D : Matrix n n ℂ) : k * (kᴴ * D * k) = D * k ↔ (1 - k * kᴴ) * D * k = 0 := by have e : k * (kᴴ * D * k) = k * kᴴ * D * k := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★ o critério exato: ler de volta PAGA (k (k† D k) = D k) se e só se a imagem da inscrição é invariante pela dinâmica, (1 − k k†) D k = 0 -/

name: TGLExt.UmPosto.reading_back_does_not_make_covariant
head: theorem reading_back_does_not_make_covariant : ∃ (k : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 1) ℂ) (D : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ), kᴴ * k = 1 ∧ ¬ (k * (kᴴ * D * k) = D * k) := by refine ⟨!![1; 0], !![0, 1; 1, 0], ?_, ?_⟩
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★ a honestidade: ler de volta não é pagar. Existe uma isometria k e uma dinâmica D tais que a leitura T := k† D k é consistente, mas k NÃO entrelaça T com D. O Um pressuposto não é o Um posto. -/

name: TGLExt.UmPostoRelacao.UmPosto
head: structure UmPosto (S I : Type) where crossing : IdentityCollapse S I before : S after : S
doc: /-- [DEF] o Um posto como RELAÇÃO: uma travessia com perda que preserva a leitura, um evento efetivo (medido antes de ser posto) e uma leitura legível (que distingue) -/

name: TGLExt.UmPostoRelacao.Pressupposed
head: def Pressupposed {S I : Type} (read : S → I) : Prop := ∀ x y : S, read x = read y  /-- [KERNEL] o posto ancora a referência: depois da travessia a leitura é a mesma e a forma está fixada -/ theorem posto_anchors_the_reading {S I : Type} (P : UmPosto S I) :
doc: /-- [DEF] a leitura pressuposta: aceita todos os referentes ao mesmo tempo, não seleciona nenhum -/

name: TGLExt.UmPostoRelacao.posto_anchors_the_reading
head: theorem posto_anchors_the_reading {S I : Type} (P : UmPosto S I) : P.crossing.identity P.after = P.crossing.identity P.before ∧ P.crossing.step P.after = P.after := transition_preserves_identity_and_is_fixed P.crossing P.measured
doc: /-- [KERNEL] o posto ancora a referência: depois da travessia a leitura é a mesma e a forma está fixada -/

name: TGLExt.UmPostoRelacao.posto_paid_loss
head: theorem posto_paid_loss {S I : Type} (P : UmPosto S I) : ¬ ∃ R : S → S, Function.LeftInverse R P.crossing.step := collapse_has_no_left_inverse P.crossing
doc: /-- [KERNEL] o posto pagou perda: a travessia não se desfaz (sem inversa à esquerda) -/

name: TGLExt.UmPostoRelacao.posto_is_not_the_lossless_mirror
head: theorem posto_is_not_the_lossless_mirror {S I : Type} (P : UmPosto S I) : P.crossing.step ≠ id := collapse_is_not_identity P.crossing
doc: /-- [KERNEL] o posto não é o espelho sem perda: a travessia não é a identidade -/

name: TGLExt.UmPostoRelacao.posto_is_not_a_reflection
head: theorem posto_is_not_a_reflection {S I : Type} (P : UmPosto S I) (J : S → S) (hJ : Function.Involutive J) : P.crossing.step ≠ J := involution_cannot_be_collapse P.crossing J hJ
doc: /-- [KERNEL] o posto não é um reflexo: nenhuma involução é a travessia -/

name: TGLExt.UmPostoRelacao.posto_was_measured_before_being_posited
head: theorem posto_was_measured_before_being_posited {S I : Type} (P : UmPosto S I) : P.before ≠ P.after := P.measured.2
doc: /-- [KERNEL] medido antes de ser posto: houve evento — o antes não é o depois -/

name: TGLExt.UmPostoRelacao.no_posto_reading_is_pressupposed
head: theorem no_posto_reading_is_pressupposed {S I : Type} (P : UmPosto S I) : ¬ Pressupposed P.crossing.identity := by intro h obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ := P.legible
doc: /-- [KERNEL] nenhuma leitura de posto é pressuposta: o posto é legível -/

name: TGLExt.UmPostoRelacao.pressupposed_stays_pressupposed_under_any_crossing
head: theorem pressupposed_stays_pressupposed_under_any_crossing {S I : Type} (read : S → I) (h : Pressupposed read) (T : S → S) (n : ℕ) : Pressupposed (read ∘ T^[n]) := by intro x y exact h _ _
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★ JAMAIS: a leitura pressuposta continua pressuposta depois de QUALQUER travessia T, repetida QUALQUER número n de vezes — nenhuma travessia converte o pressuposto em posto -/

name: TGLExt.UmPostoRelacao.pressupposed_is_never_posto
head: theorem pressupposed_is_never_posto {S I : Type} (read : S → I) (h : Pressupposed read) (T : S → S) (n : ℕ) (P : UmPosto S I) : P.crossing.identity ≠ read ∘ T^[n] := by intro hP exact no_posto_reading_is_pressupposed P (hP ▸ pressupposed_stays_pressupposed_under_any_crossing read h T n)
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★ o pressuposto jamais será o posto: nenhuma travessia, repetida quantas vezes for, produz a partir de uma leitura pressuposta a leitura legível que todo posto tem -/

name: TGLExt.UmPostoRelacao.pressupposed_stays_pressupposed_under_any_renaming
head: theorem pressupposed_stays_pressupposed_under_any_renaming {S I J : Type} (read : S → I) (h : Pressupposed read) (g : I → J) : Pressupposed (g ∘ read) := fun x y => congrArg g (h x y)
doc: /-- [KERNEL] mudança de nome não põe: renomear a leitura pressuposta (qualquer g) a mantém pressuposta -/

name: TGLExt.UmPostoRelacao.pressupposed_is_never_posto_under_crossing_and_renaming
head: theorem pressupposed_is_never_posto_under_crossing_and_renaming {S I J : Type} (read : S → J) (h : Pressupposed read) (T : S → S) (n : ℕ) (g : J → I) (P : UmPosto S I) : P.crossing.identity ≠ g ∘ (read ∘ T^[n]) := by intro hP
doc: /-- [KERNEL] ★★ JAMAIS, forma completa: nenhuma travessia repetida quantas vezes for, seguida de qualquer mudança de nome, produz a partir de uma leitura pressuposta a leitura legível que todo posto tem -/

name: TGLExt.UmPostoRelacao.exampleCrossing

doc: /-- For L1 intersect L2, the ordinary Fourier integral agrees almost everywhere with the isometric L2 transform. Equality is obtained from distributions and locally integrable test-function uniqueness, not assumed from a name match. -/

name: TGLV350.Fourier.fourier_integral_memLp_two
head: theorem fourier_integral_memLp_two (f : ℝ → H) (hf1 : Integrable f) (hf2 : MemLp f 2) : MemLp (𝓕 f) 2 := (memLp_congr_ae (fourier_integral_ae_eq_L2 f hf1 hf2)).mpr (Lp.memLp (𝓕 (hf2.toLp f) : Lp (α := ℝ) H 2 volume))

name: TGLV350.Fourier.L2_integral_norm_sq
head: theorem L2_integral_norm_sq (F : Lp (α := ℝ) H 2 volume) : (∫ x : ℝ, ‖F x‖ ^ 2) = ‖F‖ ^ 2 := by have h := congrArg (RCLike.re : ℂ → ℝ) (L2.inner_def (𝕜 := ℂ) F F) rw [← integral_re (L2.integrable_inner (𝕜 := ℂ) F F)] at h

name: TGLV350.Fourier.integral_norm_sq_eq_L2
head: theorem integral_norm_sq_eq_L2 (f : ℝ → H) (hf : MemLp f 2) : (∫ x : ℝ, ‖f x‖ ^ 2) = ‖hf.toLp f‖ ^ 2 := by rw [← L2_integral_norm_sq] apply integral_congr_ae

name: TGLV350.Fourier.fourier_integral_norm_sq
head: theorem fourier_integral_norm_sq (f : ℝ → H) (hf1 : Integrable f) (hf2 : MemLp f 2) : (∫ x : ℝ, ‖(𝓕 f) x‖ ^ 2) = ∫ x : ℝ, ‖f x‖ ^ 2 := by calc _ = ∫ x : ℝ, ‖(𝓕 (hf2.toLp f) : Lp (α := ℝ) H 2 volume) x‖ ^ 2 := by
doc: /-- Plancherel for the actual Bochner Fourier integral, with L1 and L2 hypotheses discharged separately. -/

name: TGLV350.Fourier.fourier_integral_lintegral_norm_sq
head: theorem fourier_integral_lintegral_norm_sq (f : ℝ → H) (hf1 : Integrable f) (hf2 : MemLp f 2) : (∫⁻ x : ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal (‖(𝓕 f) x‖ ^ 2)) = ∫⁻ x : ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal (‖f x‖ ^ 2) := by

name: TGLV350.Fourier.fourier_integral_ae_injective
head: theorem fourier_integral_ae_injective (f g : ℝ → H) (hf : Integrable f) (hg : Integrable g) (he : ∀ x : ℝ, (𝓕 f) x = (𝓕 g) x) : f =ᵐ[volume] g := by have hpair : ∀ φ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ), (∫ x : ℝ, φ x • f x) = ∫ x : ℝ, φ x • g x := by
doc: /-- Injectivity of the ordinary Fourier integral on integrable functions, as equality almost everywhere. No continuity of the original functions or integrability of their transforms is assumed. -/

doc: /-- An actual star-algebra equivalence transports the star commutant. -/

name: TGLV350.Regular.centralizer_image
head: theorem centralizer_image (e : (H →L[ℂ] H) ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H)) (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) : e '' ((StarSubalgebra.centralizer ℂ S) : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) = ((StarSubalgebra.centralizer ℂ (e '' S)) : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) := by

name: TGLV350.Regular.generated_transport

name: TGLV350.Regular.generated_maps_into

name: TGLV350.Regular.hilbertPairDiagonal_inr
head: theorem hilbertPairDiagonal_inr (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (v : H) : hilbertPairDiagonal T (hilbertPairInr v) = hilbertPairInr (T v) := by change toLp 2 (T 0,T v) = toLp 2 (0,T v) rw [map_zero]

head: theorem hilbertBlockA_commutes (P : WithLp 2 (H × H) →L[ℂ] WithLp 2 (H × H)) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hc : ∀ x, P (hilbertPairDiagonal T x) = hilbertPairDiagonal T (P x)) : Commute (hilbertBlockA P) T := by

name: TGLV350.Regular.hilbertBlockB_commutes

name: TGLV350.Regular.hilbertBlockD_commutes
head: theorem hilbertBlockD_commutes (P : WithLp 2 (H × H) →L[ℂ] WithLp 2 (H × H)) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hc : ∀ x, P (hilbertPairDiagonal T x) = hilbertPairDiagonal T (P x)) : Commute (hilbertBlockD P) T := by

name: TGLV350.Regular.hilbertBlockB_from_rotated
head: theorem hilbertBlockB_from_rotated (P : WithLp 2 (H × H) →L[ℂ] WithLp 2 (H × H)) (x y : H) (hp : P (toLp 2 (y,-x)) = 0) : hilbertBlockB P x = hilbertBlockA P y := by have he : toLp 2 (y,-x) = hilbertPairInl y - hilbertPairInr x := by

name: TGLV350.Regular.hilbertBlockBadjoint_from_fixed
head: theorem hilbertBlockBadjoint_from_fixed (S : Submodule ℂ (WithLp 2 (H × H))) [CompleteSpace S] (x y : H) (hp : S.starProjection (toLp 2 (x,y)) = toLp 2 (x,y)) : (hilbertBlockB S.starProjection).adjoint x = y - hilbertBlockD S.starProjection y := by

name: TGLV350.Regular.hilbertProjectionWitness
head: def hilbertProjectionWitness (S : Submodule ℂ (WithLp 2 (H × H))) [CompleteSpace S] (v : H) : H := hilbertBlockA S.starProjection v + v - hilbertBlockD S.starProjection v

name: TGLV350.Regular.hilbertBlockD_adjoint

name: TGLV350.Regular.hilbertBlockA_energy

name: TGLV350.Regular.inlNormSq

name: TGLV350.Regular.hilbertBlockB_mul_D
head: theorem hilbertBlockB_mul_D (S : Submodule ℂ (WithLp 2 (H × H))) [CompleteSpace S] : hilbertBlockB S.starProjection * hilbertBlockD S.starProjection = (1-hilbertBlockA S.starProjection) * hilbertBlockB S.starProjection := by

name: TGLV350.Regular.homogeneous_base_adjoint

name: TGLV350.Regular.fibre_norm_le
head: theorem fibre_norm_le (T : H →L[ℂ] H) : ‖fibre T‖ ≤ ‖T‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compLpL_le T  theorem fibre_apply_norm_le (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (f : RegularHilbert H) :
doc: /-- The norm estimate used only for uniform control of the vector variable. -/

name: TGLV350.Regular.fibre_apply_norm_le

head: theorem fibre_lipschitz_of_norm_le (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (C : ℝ) (hT : ‖T‖ ≤ C) : LipschitzWith (⟨max C 0, le_max_right C 0⟩ : NNReal) (fibre T) := by apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul intro f g

name: TGLV350.Regular.characterPhase
head: def characterPhase (s x : ℝ) : ℂ := Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (s : ℂ) * (x : ℂ))  theorem characterPhase_norm (s x : ℝ) : ‖characterPhase s x‖ = 1 := by simp [characterPhase, Complex.norm_exp, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]

name: TGLV350.Regular.partialPositiveResolvent_norm_le

name: TGLV350.Regular.partialPositiveResolvent_injective

name: TGLV350.Regular.partialPositiveResolvent_symmetric
head: theorem partialPositiveResolvent_symmetric (hs : T.IsFormalAdjoint T) : (partialPositiveResolvent T hp hr).IsSymmetric := by intro z w obtain ⟨x,hx,he⟩ := partialPositiveResolvent_equation T hp hr z

name: TGLV350.Regular.partialPositiveResolvent_nonneg

name: TGLV350.Regular.partialPositiveResolvent_le_one
head: theorem partialPositiveResolvent_le_one (hs : T.IsFormalAdjoint T) : partialPositiveResolvent T hp hr ≤ 1 := by apply sub_nonneg.mp apply (ContinuousLinearMap.nonneg_iff_isPositive _).mpr

name: TGLV350.Regular.partialPositiveResolvent_graph

name: TGLV350.Regular.ClosedPositiveForm.ext

head: theorem scalarGNSAmbientAction_preserves (P : SiteProfile) (B : (regularCoreAlgebra P).toStarSubalgebra) : ∀ v ∈ scalarGNSSubspace P, scalarGNSAmbientAction P B v ∈ scalarGNSSubspace P := by have h : Set.MapsTo (scalarGNSAmbientAction P B)

name: TGLV350.Regular.scalarGNSAction
head: def scalarGNSAction (P : SiteProfile) (B : (regularCoreAlgebra P).toStarSubalgebra) : ScalarGNSHilbert P →L[ℂ] ScalarGNSHilbert P := (scalarGNSAmbientAction P B).restrict (scalarGNSAmbientAction_preserves P B)

name: TGLV350.Regular.scalarGNSAction_apply

name: TGLV350.Regular.scalarGNSAction_norm_le
head: theorem scalarGNSAction_norm_le (P : SiteProfile) (B : (regularCoreAlgebra P).toStarSubalgebra) : ‖scalarGNSAction P B‖ ≤ ‖B.val‖ := by apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg _) intro v

name: TGLV350.Regular.scalarGNSAction_intertwines
