name: TGLV350.Regular.measurableCut_operatorFieldLift
head: theorem measurableCut_operatorFieldLift (S : Set ℝ) (hS : MeasurableSet S) (F : StrongIntegral.Family (H := H)) (f : RegularHilbert H) : measurableCut S hS (operatorFieldLift F f) = operatorFieldLift F (measurableCut S hS f) := by
doc: /-- Measurable cuts commute with a bounded operator field on the same L² space. -/

name: TGLV350.Regular.measurableCut_nat_joint_zero
head: theorem measurableCut_nat_joint_zero (f : RegularHilbert H) (h : ∀ n : ℕ, measurableCut (Set.Ioc (-(n : ℝ)) (n : ℝ)) measurableSet_Ioc f = 0) : f = 0 := by have hz : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, x ∈ Set.Ioc (-(n : ℝ)) (n : ℝ) → f x = 0 := by
doc: /-- Exhausting cuts are jointly injective; no individual cut is asserted faithful. -/

name: TGLV350.Regular.scalarGNSCutMap
head: def scalarGNSCutMap (P : SiteProfile) (R : ℝ) : ScalarGNSHilbert P →L[ℂ] RegularHilbert (RegularHilbert (TowerHilbert P)) := (measurableCut (Set.Ioc (-R) R) measurableSet_Ioc).comp (scalarGNSSubspace P).subtypeL
doc: /-- A contraction from the actual scalar GNS completion into its ambient L² space. Its identification with the bounded cut functional is a separate norm theorem. -/

name: TGLV350.Regular.scalarGNSCutMap_norm_le
head: theorem scalarGNSCutMap_norm_le (P : SiteProfile) (R : ℝ) (v : ScalarGNSHilbert P) : ‖scalarGNSCutMap P R v‖ ≤ ‖v‖ := measurableCutLp_norm_le (Set.Ioc (-R) R) measurableSet_Ioc v.val

name: TGLV350.Regular.scalarGNSCutMap_intertwines
head: theorem scalarGNSCutMap_intertwines (P : SiteProfile) (R : ℝ) (B : (regularCoreAlgebra P).toStarSubalgebra) (v : ScalarGNSHilbert P) : scalarGNSCutMap P R (scalarGNSRepresentation P B v) = dualOrbitRepresentation B.val (scalarGNSCutMap P R v) :=

name: TGLV350.Regular.scalarGNSCutMap_joint_zero
head: theorem scalarGNSCutMap_joint_zero (P : SiteProfile) (v : ScalarGNSHilbert P) (h : ∀ n : ℕ, scalarGNSCutMap P (n : ℝ) v = 0) : v = 0 := by apply Subtype.ext exact measurableCut_nat_joint_zero v.val h

name: TGLV350.Regular.measurableCut_norm_sq
head: theorem measurableCut_norm_sq (S : Set ℝ) (hS : MeasurableSet S) (f : RegularHilbert H) : ‖measurableCut S hS f‖ ^ 2 = ∫ x : ℝ in S, ‖f x‖ ^ 2 := by rw [← Fourier.L2_integral_norm_sq,← integral_indicator hS] apply integral_congr_ae

name: TGLV350.Regular.dualCutFunctional_square_re
head: theorem dualCutFunctional_square_re (R : ℝ) (v : RegularHilbert H) (A : RegularHilbert H →L[ℂ] RegularHilbert H) : (dualCutFunctional R v (star A * A)).re = dualHaarFactor * ∫ s in (-R)..R, ‖dualAmbient s A v‖ ^ 2 := by

name: TGLV350.Regular.scalarGNSCutMap_embedding_norm_sq
head: theorem scalarGNSCutMap_embedding_norm_sq (P : SiteProfile) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (A : finiteDualLeftIdeal P) : ‖scalarGNSCutMap P R (scalarGNSEmbedding P A)‖ ^ 2 = (dualCutFunctional R (regularVacuum P) (star A.val.val * A.val.val)).re := by
doc: /-- The cutoff contraction realizes exactly the bounded functional already constructed. The factor is the original Haar factor; no new normalization or state is inserted. -/

name: TGLV350.Regular.dualOrbit_generated_mem

name: TGLV350.Regular.scalarGNSRepresentation_preserves_positive_isLUB

head: theorem scalarGNSRepresentation_preserves_positive_directed_isLUB (P : SiteProfile) (S : Set (regularCoreAlgebra P).toStarSubalgebra) (B : (regularCoreAlgebra P).toStarSubalgebra) (hne : S.Nonempty) (hdir : DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) S)

name: TGLV350.Regular.scalarOrbit_memLp
head: theorem scalarOrbit_memLp (P : SiteProfile) (A : RegularHilbert (TowerHilbert P) →L[ℂ] RegularHilbert (TowerHilbert P)) (hA : HasFiniteDualSquare A) : MemLp (fun s : ℝ => dualAmbient s A (regularVacuum P)) 2 := by

name: TGLV350.Regular.scalarGNSOrbit
head: def scalarGNSOrbit (P : SiteProfile) (A : finiteDualLeftIdeal P) : RegularHilbert (RegularHilbert (TowerHilbert P)) := (Real.sqrt dualHaarFactor : ℝ) • (scalarOrbit_memLp P A.val.val A.property).toLp

name: TGLV350.Regular.scaledResolventDenominator
head: def scaledResolventDenominator (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (r : ℝ) : H →L[ℂ] H := r • 1 + (1-r) • T  theorem scaledResolventDenominator_sub (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (r : ℝ) :

name: TGLV350.Regular.scaledResolventDenominator_sub
head: theorem scaledResolventDenominator_sub (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (r : ℝ) : scaledResolventDenominator T r - T = r • (1-T) := by unfold scaledResolventDenominator rw [sub_smul,one_smul,smul_sub]

name: TGLV350.Regular.scaledResolventDenominator_alt
head: theorem scaledResolventDenominator_alt (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (r : ℝ) : scaledResolventDenominator T r = 1 + (r-1) • (1-T) := by unfold scaledResolventDenominator simp only [smul_sub,sub_smul,one_smul]

name: TGLV350.Regular.scaledResolventDenominator_positive
head: theorem scaledResolventDenominator_positive (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (h1 : T ≤ 1) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) : IsStrictlyPositive (scaledResolventDenominator T r) := by by_cases hle : r ≤ 1

name: TGLV350.Regular.scaledResolventDenominator_commutes
head: theorem scaledResolventDenominator_commutes (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (r : ℝ) : Commute T (scaledResolventDenominator T r) := by change T * (r • 1 + (1-r) • T) = (r • 1 + (1-r) • T) * T simp only [mul_add,add_mul,mul_smul_comm,smul_mul_assoc,mul_one,one_mul]

name: TGLV350.Regular.ring_inverse_commutes_of_unit
head: theorem ring_inverse_commutes_of_unit (T D : H →L[ℂ] H) (h : Commute T D) (hd : IsUnit D) : Commute T (Ring.inverse D) := by change T * Ring.inverse D = Ring.inverse D * T calc

name: TGLV350.Regular.scaledPositiveResolvent
head: def scaledPositiveResolvent (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (r : ℝ) : H →L[ℂ] H := T * Ring.inverse (scaledResolventDenominator T r)  theorem scaledPositiveResolvent_nonneg (T : H →L[ℂ] H)

name: TGLV350.Regular.scaledPositiveResolvent_nonneg
head: theorem scaledPositiveResolvent_nonneg (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (h1 : T ≤ 1) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) : 0 ≤ scaledPositiveResolvent T r := by have hd := scaledResolventDenominator_positive T hT h1 r hr

name: TGLV350.Regular.scaledPositiveResolvent_complement
head: theorem scaledPositiveResolvent_complement (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (h1 : T ≤ 1) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) : 1-scaledPositiveResolvent T r = r • ((1-T) * Ring.inverse (scaledResolventDenominator T r)) := by

name: TGLV350.Regular.scaledPositiveResolvent_le_one
head: theorem scaledPositiveResolvent_le_one (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (h1 : T ≤ 1) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) : scaledPositiveResolvent T r ≤ 1 := by rw [← sub_nonneg,scaledPositiveResolvent_complement T hT h1 r hr]

name: TGLV350.Regular.positive_roots_commute
head: theorem positive_roots_commute (A B : H →L[ℂ] H) (h : Commute A B) : Commute (CFC.sqrt A) (CFC.sqrt B) := by rw [CFC.sqrt_eq_cfc,CFC.sqrt_eq_cfc] exact ((h.cfc_nnreal NNReal.sqrt).symm.cfc_nnreal NNReal.sqrt).symm

name: TGLV350.Regular.positive_sqrt_product
head: theorem positive_sqrt_product (A B : H →L[ℂ] H) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (h : Commute A B) : CFC.sqrt (A*B) = CFC.sqrt A * CFC.sqrt B := by have hc := positive_roots_commute A B h

name: TGLV350.Regular.positive_sqrt_real_smul
head: theorem positive_sqrt_real_smul (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) : CFC.sqrt (r • A) = Real.sqrt r • CFC.sqrt A := by apply CFC.sqrt_unique · rw [smul_mul_assoc,mul_smul_comm,smul_smul,Real.mul_self_sqrt hr,

name: TGLV350.Regular.scaledResolvent_root_pair_first
head: theorem scaledResolvent_root_pair_first (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (h1 : T ≤ 1) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) : CFC.sqrt (scaledPositiveResolvent T r) = CFC.sqrt T * CFC.sqrt (Ring.inverse (scaledResolventDenominator T r)) := by

name: TGLV350.Regular.scaledResolvent_root_pair_second
head: theorem scaledResolvent_root_pair_second (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (h1 : T ≤ 1) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) : CFC.sqrt (1-scaledPositiveResolvent T r) = Real.sqrt r • (CFC.sqrt (1-T) * CFC.sqrt (Ring.inverse (scaledResolventDenominator T r))) := by

name: TGLV350.Regular.unit_operator_surjective

name: TGLV350.Regular.squareResolvent
head: def squareResolvent (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (n : ℕ) : H →L[ℂ] H := positiveResolvent (((n : ℝ)+1) • (A*A))  private theorem selfadjointSquare_nonneg (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (hA : star A = A) :

name: TGLV350.Regular.selfadjointSquare_nonneg

name: TGLV350.Regular.scaledSelfadjointSquare_nonneg
head: private theorem scaledSelfadjointSquare_nonneg (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (hA : star A = A) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ ((n : ℝ)+1) • (A*A) := smul_nonneg (by positivity) (selfadjointSquare_nonneg A hA)

head: theorem squareResolvent_nonneg (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (hA : star A = A) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ squareResolvent A n := positiveResolvent_nonneg _ (scaledSelfadjointSquare_nonneg A hA n)

head: theorem squareResolvent_le_one (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (hA : star A = A) (n : ℕ) : squareResolvent A n ≤ 1 := positiveResolvent_le_one _ (scaledSelfadjointSquare_nonneg A hA n)

name: TGLV350.Regular.squareResolvent_antitone
head: theorem squareResolvent_antitone (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (hA : star A = A) : Antitone (squareResolvent A) := by intro n m hnm apply positiveResolvent_antitone (scaledSelfadjointSquare_nonneg A hA n)

name: TGLV350.Regular.squareResolvent_commutes
head: theorem squareResolvent_commutes (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (hA : star A = A) (n : ℕ) : Commute A (squareResolvent A n) := by apply ring_inverse_commutes_of_unit · change A * (1 + ((n : ℝ)+1) • (A*A)) =

name: TGLV350.Regular.squareResolvent_energy_bound
head: theorem squareResolvent_energy_bound (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (hA : star A = A) (n : ℕ) (v : H) : ((n : ℝ)+1) * ‖squareResolvent A n (A v)‖^2 ≤ ‖v‖^2 / 4 := by have hsym := ContinuousLinearMap.isSelfAdjoint_iff_isSymmetric.mp hA

name: TGLV350.Regular.squareResolvent_tendsto_zero_on_rangeClosure

head: theorem bounded_application_tendsto {ι : Type*} (l : Filter ι) (A : ι → H →L[ℂ] H) (C : ℝ) (hbound : ∀ i, ‖A i‖ ≤ C) (v : ι → H) (v₀ w : H) (hv : Tendsto v l (𝓝 v₀)) (hfixed : Tendsto (fun i => A i v₀) l (𝓝 w)) :

name: TGLV350.Regular.operatorField_jointly_continuous
head: theorem operatorField_jointly_continuous (F : StrongIntegral.Family (H := H)) : Continuous (fun p : H × ℝ => F.op p.2 p.1) := by apply continuous_prod_of_continuous_lipschitzWith _ (⟨F.bound,F.bound_nonneg⟩ : NNReal) F.continuous_apply

name: TGLV350.Regular.operatorFieldLift_ae

name: TGLV350.Regular.operatorFieldLift_norm_le
head: theorem operatorFieldLift_norm_le (F : StrongIntegral.Family (H := H)) : ‖operatorFieldLift F‖ ≤ F.bound := ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ F.bound_nonneg (operatorFieldLp_norm_le F)

name: TGLV350.StrongIntegral.vectorIntegral

name: TGLV354.boundedAbsolute_ker

name: TGLV354.coreProjectionSpaces

name: TGLV354.CoreProjection.operator_le_iff
head: theorem CoreProjection.operator_le_iff {N : VonNeumannAlgebra H} (p q : CoreProjection N) : p.operator ≤ q.operator ↔ p ≤ q := by rw [(show IsStarProjection p.operator from isStarProjection_starProjection).le_iff_mul_eq_right (show IsStarProjection q.operator from isStarProjection_starProjection)]

head: def CoreProjection.ofOperator (N : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (e : H →L[ℂ] H) (he : IsStarProjection e) (hm : e ∈ N) : CoreProjection N := ⟨⟨e.range,ContinuousLinearMap.IsIdempotentElem.isClosed_range he.isIdempotentElem⟩, (VonNeumannAlgebra.IsStarProjection.mem_iff he N).mp hm⟩

head: theorem CoreProjection.operator_ofOperator (N : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (e : H →L[ℂ] H) (he : IsStarProjection e) (hm : e ∈ N) : (CoreProjection.ofOperator N e he hm).operator = e := by obtain ⟨hp,hh⟩ := isStarProjection_iff_eq_starProjection_range.mp he

name: TGLV354.CoreProjection.operator_bot
head: @[simp] theorem CoreProjection.operator_bot (N : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : (⊥ : CoreProjection N).operator=0 := Submodule.starProjection_bot  theorem CoreProjection.sup_apply_eq_zero {N : VonNeumannAlgebra H}

name: TGLV354.CoreProjection.sup_apply_eq_zero
head: theorem CoreProjection.sup_apply_eq_zero {N : VonNeumannAlgebra H} (p q : CoreProjection N) (x : H) (hp : p.operator x=0) (hq : q.operator x=0) : (p ⊔ q).operator x=0 := by apply (Submodule.starProjection_apply_eq_zero_iff _).mpr

head: theorem cyclicTraceCandidate_related (P : SiteProfile) {a b : (regularCoreAlgebra P).toStarSubalgebra} (h : ShiftRelated a b) : cyclicTraceCandidate P a = cyclicTraceCandidate P b := by apply le_antisymm

name: TGLV354.TraceCompletion.cyclicTraceCandidate_cyclic

name: TGLV354.TraceCompletion.candidate_star_le

name: TGLV354.TraceCompletion.cyclicTraceCandidate_star
head: theorem cyclicTraceCandidate_star (P : SiteProfile) (a : (regularCoreAlgebra P).toStarSubalgebra) : cyclicTraceCandidate P (star a) = cyclicTraceCandidate P a := by apply le_antisymm (candidate_star_le P a)

name: TGLV354.TraceCompletion.dual_cancel
head: private theorem dual_cancel (P : SiteProfile) (s : ℝ) (a : (regularCoreAlgebra P).toStarSubalgebra) : regularDualAction P s (regularDualAction P (-s) a) = a := by apply Subtype.ext

name: TGLV354.TraceCompletion.positive_dual_cancel

name: TGLV354.TraceCompletion.cyclicTraceCandidate_dual

name: TGLV354.TraceCompletion.ShiftRelated
head: def ShiftRelated {A : Type*} [Monoid A] (a b : A) : Prop := ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ∃ r s : A, a * r = r * b ∧ s * a = b * s ∧ a ^ n = r * s ∧ b ^ n = s * r

name: TGLV354.TraceCompletion.ShiftRelated.refl
head: theorem refl (a : A) : ShiftRelated a a := by exact ⟨1, Nat.one_pos, 1, a, by simp, by simp, by simp, by simp⟩  theorem symm (h : ShiftRelated a b) : ShiftRelated b a := by

name: TGLV354.TraceCompletion.ShiftRelated.symm
head: theorem symm (h : ShiftRelated a b) : ShiftRelated b a := by obtain ⟨n, hn, r, s, hr, hs, ha, hb⟩ := h exact ⟨n, hn, s, r, hs.symm, hr.symm, hb, ha⟩

name: TGLV354.TraceCompletion.ShiftRelated.trans
head: theorem trans (h : ShiftRelated a b) (k : ShiftRelated b c) : ShiftRelated a c := by obtain ⟨n, hn, r, s, hr, hs, ha, hb⟩ := h obtain ⟨m, hm, u, v, hu, hv, hb', hc⟩ := k have hp : ∀ j : ℕ, a ^ j * r = r * b ^ j := by

name: TGLV354.TraceCompletion.ShiftRelated.cyclic
head: theorem cyclic (x y : A) : ShiftRelated (x*y) (y*x) := by exact ⟨1, Nat.one_pos, x, y, by simp only [mul_assoc], by simp only [mul_assoc], by simp, by simp⟩

name: TGLV354.TraceCompletion.ShiftRelated.map
head: theorem map {B : Type*} [Monoid B] (f : A →* B) (h : ShiftRelated a b) : ShiftRelated (f a) (f b) := by obtain ⟨n, hn, r, s, hr, hs, ha, hb⟩ := h refine ⟨n, hn, f r, f s, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩

name: TGLV354.TraceCompletion.ShiftRelated.star_transport

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH2.killingFlow_zero
head: theorem killingFlow_zero (C : ContratoH2 W R N) : C.killingFlow 0 = LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℂ W.H := by unfold ContratoH2.killingFlow rw [mul_zero, C.boost.V_zero]

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH2.modularEnergy_of_boostEnergy
head: theorem modularEnergy_of_boostEnergy (C : ContratoH2 W R N) {ψ : W.H} {b : ℝ} (h : HasBoostEnergy C.boost.V ψ b) : HasModularEnergy C.Δit ψ (2 * Real.pi * b) := by unfold HasBoostEnergy at h unfold HasModularEnergy
doc: /-! ## §F — as energias -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH2.modularEnergy_unique
head: theorem modularEnergy_unique {H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] {D : ℝ → (H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H)} {ψ : H} {k k' : ℝ} (h : HasModularEnergy D ψ k) (h' : HasModularEnergy D ψ k') : k = k' := by have hu := h.unique h'

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH2.vac_modularEnergy
head: theorem vac_modularEnergy (C : ContratoH2 W R N) : HasModularEnergy C.Δit W.vac 0 := by unfold HasModularEnergy have : (fun t : ℝ => ⟪W.vac, C.Δit t W.vac⟫_ℂ) = fun _ => ⟪W.vac, W.vac⟫_ℂ := by funext t; rw [Δit_vac]

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH2.vac_boostEnergy
head: theorem vac_boostEnergy (C : ContratoH2 W R N) : HasBoostEnergy C.boost.V W.vac 0 := by unfold HasBoostEnergy have : (fun s : ℝ => ⟪W.vac, C.boost.V s W.vac⟫_ℂ) = fun _ => ⟪W.vac, W.vac⟫_ℂ := by funext s; rw [C.boost.V_vac]

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH2.inner_vac_Δit
head: theorem inner_vac_Δit (C : ContratoH2 W R N) (t : ℝ) (φ : W.H) : ⟪W.vac, C.Δit t φ⟫_ℂ = ⟪W.vac, φ⟫_ℂ := by have h := (C.Δit t).inner_map_map W.vac φ rw [Δit_vac] at h

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH2.bilateral_no_first_order
head: theorem bilateral_no_first_order (C : ContratoH2 W R N) {φ : W.H} {k : ℝ} (hk : HasModularEnergy C.Δit φ k) (ε : ℝ) : HasModularEnergy C.Δit (W.vac + (ε : ℂ) • φ) (ε ^ 2 * k) := by unfold HasModularEnergy at hk ⊢
doc: /-- [DERIVED] ★★ (cético 2, CeticoFirstLaw.lean 39e2508fdde98aef, transposto) a energia modular BILATERAL da perturbação Ω + εφ é ε²·k_φ: SEM termo de 1ª ordem. É por isso que o δS de H3 v3.1 NÃO é esta energia, e sim a carga UNILATERAL do corte nulo (`windowEntropy`). -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.implementer_unique
head: theorem implementer_unique {W : TGLSpecificAQFTWitness} {R : TGLModularRealization W} (D₁ D₂ : ℝ → (W.H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] W.H)) (h₁v : ∀ t, D₁ t W.vac = W.vac) (h₂v : ∀ t, D₂ t W.vac = W.vac) (h₁ : ∀ (t : ℝ) (a : R.modular.wedgeAlgebra.toStarSubalgebra),
doc: /-! ## §E — o implementador é ÚNICO -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.tower_excluded
head: theorem tower_excluded {W : TGLSpecificAQFTWitness} {R : TGLModularRealization W} {N : KillingNormalization} (D : ℝ → (W.H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] W.H)) (hDv : ∀ t, D t W.vac = W.vac) (hD : ∀ (t : ℝ) (a : R.modular.wedgeAlgebra.toStarSubalgebra),
doc: /-- (T3, cético 1) ★ A TORRE: se um implementador do fluxo de R (fixando Ω) tem autovetor fora de ℂΩ, NENHUM contrato v3.1 existe sobre (W, R, N). -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH2.Δit_determined
head: theorem Δit_determined (C C' : ContratoH2 W R N) (t : ℝ) : C.Δit t = C'.Δit t := implementer_unique C.Δit C'.Δit C.Δit_vac C'.Δit_vac C.flow_implemented C'.flow_implemented t  /-- [DERIVED] o Δit NÃO depende do índice N (dois habitantes sobre N e N' têm o mesmo Δit). -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH2.Δit_index_free
head: theorem Δit_index_free {N' : KillingNormalization} (C : ContratoH2 W R N) (C' : ContratoH2 W R N') (t : ℝ) : C.Δit t = C'.Δit t := implementer_unique C.Δit C'.Δit C.Δit_vac C'.Δit_vac C.flow_implemented C'.flow_implemented t
doc: /-- [DERIVED] o Δit NÃO depende do índice N (dois habitantes sobre N e N' têm o mesmo Δit). -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH2.boostMat_det_isUnit
head: theorem boostMat_det_isUnit (s : ℝ) : IsUnit (boostMat s).det := by have h := congrArg Matrix.det (boostMat_isLorentz s) rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose] at h have hη : eta4.det ≠ 0 := by
doc: /-! ## §G — o frame -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH2.feeds_finite_face
head: theorem feeds_finite_face (C : ContratoH2 W R N) {x : Fin 4 → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ rightWedge) : (C.E x)⁻¹ * C.E x = 1 ∧ LorentzByCongruence (solderMetric4 (C.E x)⁻¹) := four_frame_gives_lorentz_metric (C.E x) (C.det_unit_on x hx)

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH2.det_unit_along_orbit
head: theorem det_unit_along_orbit (C : ContratoH2 W R N) (s : ℝ) {x : Fin 4 → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ rightWedge) : IsUnit (C.E (wedgeBoostMap s x)).det := by rw [C.dragged s x hx, Matrix.det_mul] exact (boostMat_det_isUnit s).mul (C.det_unit_on x hx)

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.curvedFrame_not_dragged
head: theorem curvedFrame_not_dragged : ¬ ∀ (s : ℝ) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ), x ∈ rightWedge → theCurvedFrame.E (wedgeBoostMap s x) = boostMat s * theCurvedFrame.E x := by intro h

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.curvedFrame_fiducial_not_modular
head: theorem curvedFrame_fiducial_not_modular (κ : ℝ) : ¬ ∀ x ∈ rightWedge, ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ (fun i => theCurvedFrame.E x i 0) = c • killingField κ x := by intro h

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH2.frame_ne_curvedFrame_by_drag
head: theorem frame_ne_curvedFrame_by_drag (C : ContratoH2 W R N) : C.E ≠ theCurvedFrame.E := by intro hE apply curvedFrame_not_dragged intro s x hx

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH2.frame_ne_curvedFrame_by_fiducial
head: theorem frame_ne_curvedFrame_by_fiducial (C : ContratoH2 W R N) : C.E ≠ theCurvedFrame.E := by intro hE apply curvedFrame_fiducial_not_modular C.kappa intro x hx

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.shift_point
head: theorem shift_point (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) (l μ : ℝ) : (x + l • nullDir) + (μ - l) • nullDir = x + μ • nullDir := by rw [add_assoc, ← add_smul] congr 2
doc: /-- aritmética de pontos no gerador. -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.nullPlaneCharge_of_zero
head: theorem nullPlaneCharge_of_zero {W : TGLSpecificAQFTWitness} (T : StressTensorData W) (ψ : W.H) (h : ∀ x, nullEnergy T ψ x = 0) : nullPlaneCharge T ψ = 0 := by unfold nullPlaneCharge have : (fun p : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) => p.1 * nullEnergy T ψ (p.1 • nullDir + screenEmbed p.2))
doc: /-- [DERIVED] a carga nula de uma energia nula identicamente nula é 0. -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.nullEnergy_vac
head: theorem nullEnergy_vac {W : TGLSpecificAQFTWitness} (T : StressTensorData W) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) : nullEnergy T W.vac x = 0 := by simp [nullEnergy, pairing, T.T_vac]
doc: /-- [DERIVED] o vácuo não tem energia nula (T_vac). -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.nullEnergy_covariant
head: theorem nullEnergy_covariant {W : TGLSpecificAQFTWitness} (T : StressTensorData W) (a : Fin 4 → ℝ) (ψ : W.H) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) : nullEnergy T (W.U a ψ) x = nullEnergy T ψ (x - a) := by simp [nullEnergy, T.T_covariant]
doc: /-- [DERIVED] a energia nula é covariante (T_covariant). -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.areaDensity_smul
head: theorem areaDensity_smul (c : ℝ) (h : (Fin 4 → ℝ) → Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) : areaDensity (fun y => c • h y) x = c * areaDensity h x := by simp [areaDensity] ring

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH3.response_vac
head: theorem response_vac (C : ContratoH3 W R N T) : C.response W.vac = 0 := by unfold ContratoH3.response have h : T.T W.vac = 0 := by funext x; exact T.T_vac x rw [h, C.propagator_zero]
doc: /-- [DERIVED] a resposta do vácuo é nula (T_vac + propagator_zero). -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH3.response_covariant_v31
head: theorem response_covariant_v31 (C : ContratoH3 W R N T) (a : Fin 4 → ℝ) (ψ : W.H) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) : C.response (W.U a ψ) x = C.response ψ (x - a) := by unfold ContratoH3.response have h : T.T (W.U a ψ) = fun y => T.T ψ (y - a) := by funext y; exact T.T_covariant a ψ y
doc: /-- [DERIVED] ★ a COVARIÂNCIA DA RESPOSTA é teorema (T_covariant + propagator_covariant). -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH3.same_source_same_geometry
head: theorem same_source_same_geometry (C : ContratoH3 W R N T) {ψ φ : W.H} (h : T.T ψ = T.T φ) : C.response ψ = C.response φ := by unfold ContratoH3.response rw [h]
doc: /-- [DERIVED] ★★ MESMA FONTE, MESMA GEOMETRIA: dois estados com o mesmo ⟨T⟩ têm a mesma resposta (não há escolha por estado — a objeção central dos dois céticos). -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH3.theta_along
head: theorem theta_along (C : ContratoH3 W R N T) {ψ : W.H} (hψ : ψ ∈ C.admissible) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) (l : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun μ => areaDensity (C.response ψ) (x + μ • nullDir)) (C.theta ψ (x + l • nullDir)) l := by
doc: /-- [DERIVED] θ é a derivada da densidade de área em TODO parâmetro do gerador (não só em 0). -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH3.theta_deriv_along
head: theorem theta_deriv_along (C : ContratoH3 W R N T) {ψ : W.H} (hψ : ψ ∈ C.admissible) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) (l : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun μ => C.theta ψ (x + μ • nullDir)) (-(8 * Real.pi * C.G) * nullEnergy T ψ (x + l • nullDir)) l := by
doc: /-- [DERIVED] a lei local em TODO parâmetro do gerador. -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH3.first_law_window
head: theorem first_law_window (C : ContratoH3 W R N T) {ψ : W.H} (hψ : ψ ∈ C.admissible) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) (c d : ℝ) (hθ : C.theta ψ (x + d • nullDir) = 0) : windowArea (C.response ψ) x c d = 8 * Real.pi * C.G * windowCharge T ψ x c d := by have hcont : Continuous (fun l : ℝ => nullEnergy T ψ (x + l • nullDir)) :=
doc: /-- [DERIVED] ★★★ A PRIMEIRA LEI DA JANELA (integração EXATA, sem janela pequena): em todo gerador nulo por x, para todo corte c e toda janela [c, d] cuja expansão se anula no fim (equilíbrio, θ(d) = 0), a(d) − a(c) = 8πG ∫_c^d (λ − c) T_nn(x + λn) dλ. Prova: F(μ) = (μ − c)θ(μ) − a(μ) tem F′ = (μ − c)·θ′ = −8πG(μ − c)T_nn (FTC). -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH3.bekenstein_hawking_window
head: theorem bekenstein_hawking_window (C : ContratoH3 W R N T) {ψ : W.H} (hψ : ψ ∈ C.admissible) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) (c d : ℝ) (hθ : C.theta ψ (x + d • nullDir) = 0) : windowEntropy T ψ x c d = windowArea (C.response ψ) x c d / (4 * C.G) := by rw [first_law_window C hψ x c d hθ]
doc: /-- [DERIVED] ★★ BEKENSTEIN–HAWKING DA JANELA: δS = δA/(4G), com δS = 2π × a carga unilateral do corte. -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH3.clausius_window
head: theorem clausius_window (C : ContratoH3 W R N T) (ψ : W.H) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) (c d : ℝ) : windowHeat C.H2.kappa T ψ x c d = C.H2.unruhTemperature * windowEntropy T ψ x c d := by unfold windowHeat windowEntropy ContratoH2.unruhTemperature field_simp
doc: /-- [DERIVED] CLAUSIUS da janela: δQ = T_U·δS — IDENTIDADE (δS := δQ/T_U, a leitura do cético 2). -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH3.einstein_coefficient_window
head: theorem einstein_coefficient_window (C : ContratoH3 W R N T) {ψ : W.H} (hψ : ψ ∈ C.admissible) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) (c d : ℝ) (hθ : C.theta ψ (x + d • nullDir) = 0) : windowHeat C.H2.kappa T ψ x c d = C.H2.kappa * windowArea (C.response ψ) x c d / (8 * Real.pi * C.G) := by
doc: /-- [DERIVED] ★ o 8πG da janela: δQ = κ·δA/(8πG). -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH3.kappa_cancels_window
head: theorem kappa_cancels_window (C : ContratoH3 W R N T) (ψ : W.H) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) (c d : ℝ) : windowHeat C.H2.kappa T ψ x c d / C.H2.unruhTemperature = windowEntropy T ψ x c d := by rw [clausius_window] have hT : C.H2.unruhTemperature ≠ 0 := by
doc: /-- [DERIVED] κ cancela: δQ/T_U = δS. -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH3.nontrivial_null_energy
head: theorem nontrivial_null_energy (C : ContratoH3 W R N T) : ∃ ψ ∈ C.admissible, ∃ x : Fin 4 → ℝ, nullEnergy T ψ x ≠ 0 := by obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, k, hk, hk0⟩ := C.admissible_nontrivial refine ⟨ψ, hψ, ?_⟩
doc: /-- [DERIVED] ★ a energia nula NÃO se anula: há estado admissível e ponto com T_nn ≠ 0 (de `admissible_nontrivial` + `modular_charge`). -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH3.expansion_not_constant
head: theorem expansion_not_constant (C : ContratoH3 W R N T) : ∃ ψ ∈ C.admissible, ∃ x : Fin 4 → ℝ, ∃ l : ℝ, C.theta ψ (x + l • nullDir) ≠ C.theta ψ (x + 0 • nullDir) := by obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, x, hx⟩ := nontrivial_null_energy C
doc: /-- [DERIVED] ★★ A EXPANSÃO NÃO É CONSTANTE: em todo habitante há estado admissível e gerador em que θ varia. (Refuta todo «ajustador» cuja densidade de área é afim ao longo dos geradores.) -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH3.response_not_identically_zero
head: theorem response_not_identically_zero (C : ContratoH3 W R N T) : ¬ ∀ ψ ∈ C.admissible, C.response ψ = 0 := by intro h0 obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, x, l, hne⟩ := expansion_not_constant C
doc: /-- [DERIVED] a resposta nula é recusada: se `response ψ = 0` para todo estado admissível, contradição. -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH3.slope_response_excluded
head: theorem slope_response_excluded (C : ContratoH3 W R N T) (c : W.H → ℝ) (M : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ) (hresp : ∀ ψ x, C.response ψ x = (c ψ * x 0) • M) : False := by apply response_not_identically_zero C intro ψ hψ
doc: /-- [DERIVED] ★★ (refuta o ajustador «inclinação por estado» dos céticos, porte linear de `toyResp`/`expFrame`) NENHUM habitante tem resposta da forma h_ψ(x) = (c(ψ)·x⁰)·M: a covariância força c ≡ 0, e então a resposta é nula — recusada acima. -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH3.exp_response_excluded
head: theorem exp_response_excluded (C : ContratoH3 W R N T) (c : W.H → ℝ) (M : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ) (hresp : ∀ ψ x, C.response ψ x = (Real.exp (c ψ * x 0) - 1) • M) : False := by apply response_not_identically_zero C
doc: /-- [DERIVED] ★★ (refuta o porte exponencial do ajustador) NENHUM habitante tem resposta h_ψ(x) = (e^{c(ψ)·x⁰} − 1)·M: a covariância força e^{−c(ψ)} = 1, logo c ≡ 0 e a resposta é nula. -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH3.slope_propagator_excluded
head: theorem slope_propagator_excluded (C : ContratoH3 W R N T) (c : ((Fin 4 → ℝ) → Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ) → ℝ) (M : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ) (hP : ∀ f x, C.propagator f x = (c f * x 0) • M) : False := slope_response_excluded C (fun ψ => c (T.T ψ)) M (fun ψ x => hP (T.T ψ) x)
doc: /-- [DERIVED] ★★ o ajustador POR FONTE (o porte mais forte dos céticos na v3.1) é excluído: nenhum habitante tem propagador da forma 𝔉(f)(x) = (c(f)·x⁰)·M. -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH3.exp_propagator_excluded
head: theorem exp_propagator_excluded (C : ContratoH3 W R N T) (c : ((Fin 4 → ℝ) → Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ) → ℝ) (M : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ) (hP : ∀ f x, C.propagator f x = (Real.exp (c f * x 0) - 1) • M) : False := exp_response_excluded C (fun ψ => c (T.T ψ)) M (fun ψ x => hP (T.T ψ) x)
doc: /-- [DERIVED] ★★ idem para o porte exponencial por fonte. -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH3.rescaleG
head: def rescaleG (C : ContratoH3 W R N T) (G' : ℝ) (hG' : 0 < G') : ContratoH3 W R N T where H2 := C.H2 G := G' G_pos := hG'
doc: /-- ★ G NÃO É PREDITO (rota de Jacobson, G = 1/(4ħη) é entrada): de todo habitante sai outro, com o MESMO H2, a MESMA classe e o MESMO T, e G' arbitrário — a resposta escala por G'/G. [KNOWN: Jacobson 1995.] -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH3.G_not_predicted
head: theorem G_not_predicted (C : ContratoH3 W R N T) (G' : ℝ) (hG' : 0 < G') : ∃ C' : ContratoH3 W R N T, C'.H2 = C.H2 ∧ C'.G = G' ∧ C'.admissible = C.admissible := ⟨rescaleG C G' hG', rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH3.theta_vac
head: theorem theta_vac (C : ContratoH3 W R N T) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) : C.theta W.vac x = 0 := by have h : HasDerivAt (fun l : ℝ => areaDensity (C.response W.vac) (x + l • nullDir)) (C.theta W.vac x) 0 := C.theta_is_expansion W.vac C.vac_admissible x have hfun : (fun l : ℝ => areaDensity (C.response W.vac) (x + l • nullDir)) = fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
doc: /-- [DERIVED] (lê `vac_admissible`) o VÁCUO ESTÁ EM EQUILÍBRIO: θ_Ω ≡ 0. -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH3.windowCharge_covariant
head: theorem windowCharge_covariant (a : Fin 4 → ℝ) (ψ : W.H) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) (c d : ℝ) : windowCharge T (W.U a ψ) x c d = windowCharge T ψ (x - a) c d := by unfold windowCharge congr 1

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH3.windowArea_covariant
head: theorem windowArea_covariant (C : ContratoH3 W R N T) (a : Fin 4 → ℝ) (ψ : W.H) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) (c d : ℝ) : windowArea (C.response (W.U a ψ)) x c d = windowArea (C.response ψ) (x - a) c d := by unfold windowArea areaDensity rw [response_covariant_v31, response_covariant_v31]

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH3.first_law_translated
head: theorem first_law_translated (C : ContratoH3 W R N T) {ψ : W.H} (hψ : ψ ∈ C.admissible) (a : Fin 4 → ℝ) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) (c d : ℝ) (hθ : C.theta (W.U a ψ) (x + d • nullDir) = 0) : windowArea (C.response ψ) (x - a) c d = 8 * Real.pi * C.G * windowCharge T ψ (x - a) c d := by
doc: /-- [DERIVED] ★ (lê `admissible_translate`) A LEI VALE EM TODA A FAMÍLIA TRANSLADADA DE HORIZONTES: a primeira lei da janela do estado U(a)ψ no gerador por x é a do estado ψ no gerador por x − a — o mesmo G, o mesmo T. -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH3.response_null_null_zero
head: theorem response_null_null_zero (C : ContratoH3 W R N T) {ψ : W.H} (hψ : ψ ∈ C.admissible) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) : pairing (C.response ψ x) nullDir nullDir = 0 := by unfold pairing ContratoH3.response rw [C.lightcone_gauge ψ hψ x, dotProduct_zero]
doc: /-- [DERIVED] (lê `lightcone_gauge`) o gerador continua NULO na métrica perturbada: δg_nn = nᵀ h n = 0. -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH3.response_row_null
head: theorem response_row_null (C : ContratoH3 W R N T) {ψ : W.H} (hψ : ψ ∈ C.admissible) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) : Matrix.vecMul nullDir (C.response ψ x) = 0 := by unfold ContratoH3.response rw [← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, C.response_symm ψ hψ x, C.lightcone_gauge ψ hψ x]
doc: /-- [DERIVED] (lê `response_symm` + `lightcone_gauge`) o gauge vale nos DOIS índices: nᵀ h = 0. -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH3.areaDensity_is_linearized_area
head: theorem areaDensity_is_linearized_area (C : ContratoH3 W R N T) {x : Fin 4 → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ rightWedge) (h : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun ε : ℝ => Real.sqrt |(screenBlockV31 (solderMetric4 (C.H2.E x)⁻¹ + ε • h)).det|) (-(h 2 2 + h 3 3) / 2) 0 := by

doc: /-- o vetor nulo do horizonte futuro da cunha: n = (1, 1, 0, 0). -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.boostMat_add
head: theorem boostMat_add (a b : ℝ) : boostMat (a + b) = boostMat a * boostMat b := by have h := congrArg Subtype.val (theBoost_add a b) change boostMat a * boostMat b = boostMat (a + b) at h exact h.symm
doc: /-- [DERIVED] ★ A LEI DE GRUPO DO BOOST: boostMat(a+b) = boostMat a · boostMat b (lida de `theBoost_add`, PoincareGroup.lean:173). -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.boostMat_zero
head: theorem boostMat_zero : boostMat 0 = 1 := by ext i j fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [boostMat]

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.wedgeBoostMap_add
head: theorem wedgeBoostMap_add (a b : ℝ) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) : wedgeBoostMap (a + b) x = wedgeBoostMap a (wedgeBoostMap b x) := by simp only [wedgeBoostMap, boostMat_add, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.wedgeBoostMap_zero

head: theorem wedgeBoostMap_smul (s c : ℝ) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) : wedgeBoostMap s (c • x) = c • wedgeBoostMap s x := by simp [wedgeBoostMap, Matrix.mulVec_smul]

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.wedgeBoostMap_apply0
head: theorem wedgeBoostMap_apply0 (s : ℝ) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) : wedgeBoostMap s x 0 = Real.cosh s * x 0 + Real.sinh s * x 1 := by simp [wedgeBoostMap, boostMat, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_four]

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.wedgeBoostMap_apply1
head: theorem wedgeBoostMap_apply1 (s : ℝ) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) : wedgeBoostMap s x 1 = Real.sinh s * x 0 + Real.cosh s * x 1 := by simp [wedgeBoostMap, boostMat, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_four]

head: theorem wedgeBoostMap_nullDir (s : ℝ) : wedgeBoostMap s nullDir = Real.exp s • nullDir := by funext i fin_cases i <;> simp [nullDir, wedgeBoostMap, boostMat, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_four,

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.kmsStrip

head: def KMSAt (W : TGLSpecificAQFTWitness) (α : ℝ → (W.H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] W.H)) (β : ℝ) : Prop := ∀ A ∈ W.net rightWedge, ∀ B ∈ W.net rightWedge, ∃ F : ℂ → ℂ, DiffContOnCl ℂ F (kmsStrip β) ∧ (∃ M : ℝ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 ≤ z.im → z.im ≤ β → ‖F z‖ ≤ M) ∧

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.HasModularEnergy
head: def HasModularEnergy {H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (Δit : ℝ → (H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H)) (ψ : H) (k : ℝ) : Prop := HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ⟪ψ, Δit t ψ⟫_ℂ) (-(I * (k : ℂ))) 0
doc: /-- a expectativa do hamiltoniano modular BILATERAL K = −log Δ: d/dt ⟪ψ, Δ^{it}ψ⟫|₀ = −i·k. -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.HasBoostEnergy
head: def HasBoostEnergy {H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (V : ℝ → (H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H)) (ψ : H) (b : ℝ) : Prop := HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ⟪ψ, V s ψ⟫_ℂ) (I * (b : ℂ)) 0
doc: /-- a expectativa do gerador do boost B (V(s) = e^{isB}): d/ds ⟪ψ, V(s)ψ⟫|₀ = i·b. -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.NoEigenOutsideVacuum
head: def NoEigenOutsideVacuum (W : TGLSpecificAQFTWitness) (D : ℝ → (W.H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] W.H)) : Prop := ∀ (v : W.H) (r : ℝ), (∀ t : ℝ, D t v = ChatgptAudit.modularPhase t r • v) → v ∈ (ℂ ∙ W.vac)  /-! ## 2. O GRUPO DE BOOSTS da cunha, representado em W.H — idêntico à v3 -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.WedgeBoostRep
head: structure WedgeBoostRep (W : TGLSpecificAQFTWitness) where V : ℝ → (W.H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] W.H) V_zero : V 0 = LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℂ W.H V_add : ∀ a b : ℝ, V (a + b) = (V b).trans (V a)
doc: /-- **WedgeBoostRep W** — representação unitária fortemente contínua do grupo de boosts, tipada pela `boostMat` do kernel. As paredes `no_injective_isometric_boost_intertwiner` (ModularSignatureObstruction:102) e `tower_modular_cannot_intertwine_nonzero_boost` (Order007Bridges:47) NÃO são contrariadas: V age em W.H e U é multiplicativo; nenhuma aplicação LINEAR injetiva ℝ⁴ → W.H é entrelaçada. -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.KillingNormalization
head: structure KillingNormalization where point : Fin 4 → ℝ point_in_wedge : point ∈ rightWedge
doc: /-- **KillingNormalization** [INPUT, EXTERNO ao par] — o relógio que fixa a ESCALA do campo de Killing: um ponto de referência na cunha (o observador/detector cujo tempo próprio é o tempo físico). No espaço plano nada no par (W, R) escolhe esse ponto (teorema `kappa_is_input`); κ é a aceleração própria dele. Para o κ_H de um buraco negro, a normalização é a assintótica (ξ → ∂_t no infinito) — FORA deste tipo plano [OPEN]. -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH2
head: structure ContratoH2 (W : TGLSpecificAQFTWitness) (R : TGLModularRealization W) (N : KillingNormalization) where /-- (A) a normalização do campo de Killing — determinada por N (`observer_unit`). -/ kappa : ℝ
doc: /-- **ContratoH2 W R N** (v3.1) — igual à v3 (fidelidade, espectro contínuo, BW como campo, KMS), com o observador fiducial substituído pelo ÍNDICE N: `observer_unit` pede |ξ_κ| = 1 NO PONTO DE REFERÊNCIA de N, logo κ = 1/ρ(N) (teorema `kappa_eq_inv_radius`) — fixo dado N, livre como função de (W, R). -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH2.unruhTemperature
head: def unruhTemperature (C : ContratoH2 W R N) : ℝ := C.kappa / (2 * Real.pi)  /-- o FLUXO DE KILLING do campo ξ_κ, em tempo de Killing τ: τ ↦ V(κτ). -/ def killingFlow (C : ContratoH2 W R N) (τ : ℝ) : W.H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] W.H := C.boost.V (C.kappa * τ)
doc: /-- a temperatura de Unruh em tempo de Killing: o NÚMERO κ/2π (que ela é a temperatura KMS do fluxo de Killing é o teorema `unruh_is_kms`). -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH2.killingFlow
head: def killingFlow (C : ContratoH2 W R N) (τ : ℝ) : W.H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] W.H := C.boost.V (C.kappa * τ)  end ContratoH2
doc: /-- o FLUXO DE KILLING do campo ξ_κ, em tempo de Killing τ: τ ↦ V(κτ). -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.StressTensorData
head: structure StressTensorData (W : TGLSpecificAQFTWitness) where T : W.H → (Fin 4 → ℝ) → Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ T_vac : ∀ x : Fin 4 → ℝ, T W.vac x = 0 T_covariant : ∀ (a : Fin 4 → ℝ) (ψ : W.H) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ), T (W.U a ψ) x = T ψ (x - a)
doc: /-- **StressTensorData W** [INPUT: índice do par, não do habitante de H3] — a expectativa T(ψ)(x) = ⟨ψ, T_ab(x) ψ⟩ (componentes covariantes), nula no vácuo (ordenamento normal) e COVARIANTE por translações na convenção do kernel (Ad U(a) net(O) = net(O + a) ⟹ U(a)* T(x) U(a) = T(x − a)). ⚠ Não se tipa aqui a forma sesquilinear nem a covariância de Lorentz (não são necessárias às paredes abaixo; são refinamento [OPEN]). -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.pairing
head: def pairing (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ) (u v : Fin 4 → ℝ) : ℝ := dotProduct u (A.mulVec v)  /-- a densidade de energia nula T_nn(ψ)(x) = nᵃ nᵇ T_ab. -/ def nullEnergy {W : TGLSpecificAQFTWitness} (T : StressTensorData W) (ψ : W.H) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) : ℝ :=
doc: /-- o pareamento T(u, v) = uᵀ T v. -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.nullEnergy
head: def nullEnergy {W : TGLSpecificAQFTWitness} (T : StressTensorData W) (ψ : W.H) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) : ℝ := pairing (T.T ψ x) nullDir nullDir  /-- o ponto transversal (0, 0, y², y³). -/
doc: /-- a densidade de energia nula T_nn(ψ)(x) = nᵃ nᵇ T_ab. -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.screenEmbed
head: def screenEmbed (y : Fin 2 → ℝ) : Fin 4 → ℝ := ![0, 0, y 0, y 1]  /-- a CARGA NULA BILATERAL de ψ no plano nulo do horizonte: ∫∫ λ T_nn(λn + y) dλ d²y (sobre λ ∈ ℝ). [KNOWN: −log Δ = 2π × esta carga (CTT 2017); aqui é o lado direito do campo `modular_charge`.] -/
doc: /-- o ponto transversal (0, 0, y², y³). -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.nullPlaneCharge
head: def nullPlaneCharge {W : TGLSpecificAQFTWitness} (T : StressTensorData W) (ψ : W.H) : ℝ := ∫ p : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ), p.1 * nullEnergy T ψ (p.1 • nullDir + screenEmbed p.2)  /-- o bloco (2,3) de uma métrica: a métrica induzida na tela. -/
doc: /-- a CARGA NULA BILATERAL de ψ no plano nulo do horizonte: ∫∫ λ T_nn(λn + y) dλ d²y (sobre λ ∈ ℝ). [KNOWN: −log Δ = 2π × esta carga (CTT 2017); aqui é o lado direito do campo `modular_charge`.] -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.screenBlockV31
head: def screenBlockV31 (g : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ := !![g 2 2, g 2 3; g 3 2, g 3 3]  /-- a DENSIDADE DE ÁREA LINEARIZADA da tela numa perturbação de métrica h (fundo de tela plana −1₂):
doc: /-- o bloco (2,3) de uma métrica: a métrica induzida na tela. -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.areaDensity
head: def areaDensity (h : (Fin 4 → ℝ) → Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) : ℝ := -(h x 2 2 + h x 3 3) / 2  /-- a CARGA UNILATERAL da janela [c, d] do gerador por x, acima do corte c:
doc: /-- a DENSIDADE DE ÁREA LINEARIZADA da tela numa perturbação de métrica h (fundo de tela plana −1₂): a(h)(x) = −(h₂₂ + h₃₃)/2. -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.windowCharge
head: def windowCharge {W : TGLSpecificAQFTWitness} (T : StressTensorData W) (ψ : W.H) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) (c d : ℝ) : ℝ := ∫ l in c..d, (l - c) * nullEnergy T ψ (x + l • nullDir)
doc: /-- a CARGA UNILATERAL da janela [c, d] do gerador por x, acima do corte c: ∫_c^d (λ − c)·T_nn(ψ)(x + λn) dλ (o campo de Killing do corte c é (λ − c)n). -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.windowEntropy
head: def windowEntropy {W : TGLSpecificAQFTWitness} (T : StressTensorData W) (ψ : W.H) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) (c d : ℝ) : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi * windowCharge T ψ x c d
doc: /-- a entropia da janela: δS = 2π × a carga unilateral (a primeira lei do corte nulo [KNOWN: CTT 2017]; por construção, δS = δQ/T_U — Clausius como LEITURA). -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.windowHeat
head: def windowHeat {W : TGLSpecificAQFTWitness} (κ : ℝ) (T : StressTensorData W) (ψ : W.H) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) (c d : ℝ) : ℝ := κ * windowCharge T ψ x c d
doc: /-- o calor da janela com o Killing do corte normalizado por κ: δQ = κ × a carga unilateral. -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.windowArea
head: def windowArea (h : (Fin 4 → ℝ) → Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ) (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) (c d : ℝ) : ℝ := areaDensity h (x + d • nullDir) - areaDensity h (x + c • nullDir)  /-! ## 5. CONTRATO H3 v3.1 -/
doc: /-- a variação da densidade de área entre os cortes c e d do gerador por x. -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH3
head: structure ContratoH3 (W : TGLSpecificAQFTWitness) (R : TGLModularRealization W) (N : KillingNormalization) (T : StressTensorData W) where /-- o MESMO horizonte: o contrato H2 sobre o MESMO par (W, R) e a MESMA normalização N. -/ H2 : ContratoH2 W R N
doc: /-- **ContratoH3 W R N T** (v3.1) — o tipo que `qgPrice_H3_localHorizonEquilibrium_discharged` terá de habitar.  O MESMO horizonte (o `H2`, com o MESMO κ, Δit, boost e n); G fixo; a matéria é o ÍNDICE T (não um campo); a classe admissível é fechada por translações; o elo matéria ↔ fluxo modular é campo; a resposta é uma perturbação de métrica dada por um PROPAGADOR fixo e covariante, no gauge do cone de luz; e a lei é LOCAL em todo gerador nulo de direção n: dθ/dλ = −8πG·T_nn. Bekenstein–Hawking, Clausius e o 8πG são TEOREMAS de janela. -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoH3.response
head: def response (C : ContratoH3 W R N T) (ψ : W.H) : (Fin 4 → ℝ) → Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ := C.propagator (T.T ψ)  end ContratoH3
doc: /-- a resposta geométrica de ψ: h_ψ := 𝔉(T(ψ)) (definição; não é campo). -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Contract.ContratoImportH3
head: structure ContratoImportH3 (W : TGLSpecificAQFTWitness) (R : TGLModularRealization W) (N : KillingNormalization) (T : StressTensorData W) (h2 : ContratoH2 W R N) where produce : ContratoH2 W R N → ContratoH3 W R N T same_horizon : ∀ h : ContratoH2 W R N, (produce h).H2 = h
doc: /-- **ContratoImportH3 W R N T h2** (v3.1): o índice `h2` é o termo H2 do MESMO (W, R, N); a função produz, de todo H2 no par, um H3 sobre o MESMO H2 e o MESMO tensor T. -/

name: ORDEM016.Photon.Transport.liftW

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.QubitScalar.radius_strictAnti
head: theorem radius_strictAnti (p k : ℝ) (hk : 0 < k) : StrictAnti (radius p k) := by intro s t hst apply Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (radicand_nonneg p k t hk.le) have he : Real.exp (-2*t) < Real.exp (-2*s) := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by linarith)

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.QubitScalar.entropy_strictMonoOn
head: theorem entropy_strictMonoOn (p k : ℝ) (hk : 0 < k) (hkp : k < p*(1-p)) : StrictMonoOn (entropy p k) (Ici 0) := by intro s hs t ht hst apply Real.binEntropy_strictAntiOn

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.QubitScalar.entropy_abs_identity
head: theorem entropy_abs_identity (p : ℝ) : Real.binEntropy ((1+|2*p-1|)/2) = Real.binEntropy p := by by_cases hp : 0 ≤ 2*p-1 · rw [abs_of_nonneg hp]

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.QubitScalar.radius_lower_bound

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.QubitScalar.asymptotic_argument_mem

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.QubitScalar.entropy_le_diagonal

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.QubitScalar.deficit_nonneg

head: theorem shift_mp (s : ℝ) : MeasurePreserving (fun ξ : ℝ => ξ + -s) volume volume := measurePreserving_add_right volume (-s)  /-- **D(s)** — a dilatacao, como isometria linear de L^2 (composicao com xi ↦ xi - s). -/
doc: /-! ## 2. A dilatacao (o boost lido na reta): D(s) f (xi) = f(xi - s) -/

name: FormaInscrita.RetaDeLuz.D
head: def D (s : ℝ) : L2R →ₗᵢ[ℂ] L2R := Lp.compMeasurePreservingₗᵢ ℂ (fun ξ : ℝ => ξ + -s) (shift_mp s)  theorem D_ae (s : ℝ) (f : L2R) : D s f =ᵐ[volume] fun ξ => f (ξ + -s) :=
doc: /-- **D(s)** — a dilatacao, como isometria linear de L^2 (composicao com xi ↦ xi - s). -/

name: FormaInscrita.RetaDeLuz.D_ae
head: theorem D_ae (s : ℝ) (f : L2R) : D s f =ᵐ[volume] fun ξ => f (ξ + -s) := Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving f (shift_mp s)  /-- [DERIVED] D (s + t) = D s ∘ D t (lei de grupo). -/

name: FormaInscrita.RetaDeLuz.D_add
head: theorem D_add (s t : ℝ) (f : L2R) : D (s + t) f = D s (D t f) := by apply Lp.ext have hq := (shift_mp s).quasiMeasurePreserving have hcomp : (fun ξ => (D t f) (ξ + -s)) =ᵐ[volume] fun ξ => f (ξ + -s + -t) :=
doc: /-- [DERIVED] D (s + t) = D s ∘ D t (lei de grupo). -/

name: FormaInscrita.RetaDeLuz.D_zero
head: theorem D_zero (f : L2R) : D 0 f = f := by apply Lp.ext filter_upwards [D_ae 0 f] with ξ h rw [h]

name: FormaInscrita.RetaDeLuz.D_inv
head: theorem D_inv (s : ℝ) (f : L2R) : D s (D (-s) f) = f := by rw [← D_add, add_neg_cancel, D_zero]  /-! ## 3. ★ A RELACAO DE BORCHERS entre os operadores concretos -/

name: FormaInscrita.RetaDeLuz.borchers_dilation
head: theorem borchers_dilation (s a : ℝ) (f : L2R) : D s (U a (D (-s) f)) = U (Real.exp (-s) * a) f := by apply Lp.ext have hq := (shift_mp s).quasiMeasurePreserving
doc: /-- [DERIVED] ★ D(s) U(a) D(-s) = U(e^{-s} a): a dilatacao contrai a translacao nula. -/

name: FormaInscrita.RetaDeLuz.modularCandidate
head: def modularCandidate (t : ℝ) : L2R →ₗᵢ[ℂ] L2R := D (2 * Real.pi * t)  /-- [DERIVED, definicional no fator 2 pi] Delta^{it} U(a) Delta^{-it} = U(e^{-2 pi t} a). -/ theorem borchers_bw_form (t a : ℝ) (f : L2R) :
doc: /-- o grupo «modular» na normalizacao de Bisognano--Wichmann: Delta^{it} := D(2 pi t). ⚠ DEFINICAO: que isto seja o grupo modular de um subespaco padrao e [OPEN] neste arquivo. -/

name: FormaInscrita.RetaDeLuz.borchers_bw_form
head: theorem borchers_bw_form (t a : ℝ) (f : L2R) : modularCandidate t (U a (modularCandidate (-t) f)) = U (Real.exp (-(2 * Real.pi * t)) * a) f := by have h : 2 * Real.pi * -t = -(2 * Real.pi * t) := by ring unfold modularCandidate
doc: /-- [DERIVED, definicional no fator 2 pi] Delta^{it} U(a) Delta^{-it} = U(e^{-2 pi t} a). -/

name: FormaInscrita.RetaDeLuz.transSymbol_ne_one
head: theorem transSymbol_ne_one {a : ℝ} (ha : a ≠ 0) : ∃ ξ : ℝ, transSymbol a ξ ≠ 1 := by have hm1 : (-1 : ℂ) ≠ 1 := by norm_num rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne ha with h | h · refine ⟨Real.log (Real.pi / -a), ?_⟩
doc: /-- [DERIVED] o simbolo nao e identicamente 1 se a ≠ 0: em xi0 = log(pi/|a|) ele vale −1. -/

name: FormaInscrita.RetaDeLuz.U_faithful
head: theorem U_faithful (a : ℝ) (h : U a = 1) : a = 0 := by by_contra ha obtain ⟨ξ₀, hξ₀⟩ := transSymbol_ne_one ha -- o conjunto aberto onde o simbolo difere de 1, cortado a um intervalo limitado

head: theorem lightray_not_faithful_in_four {X : Type*} (F : ℝ → X) (x1 : X) (hF : F 0 = x1) (ℓ : (Fin 4 → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) : ∃ a : Fin 4 → ℝ, a ≠ 0 ∧ F (ℓ a) = x1 := by have hrank := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker ℓ

head: theorem lightray_lift_not_faithful : ∃ a : Fin 4 → ℝ, a ≠ 0 ∧ U (a 0 + a 1) = 1 := by let ℓ : (Fin 4 → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ := (LinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 4 => ℝ) 0) +

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.ker_threeLocks
head: theorem ker_threeLocks (D₁ D₂ D₃ : E →L[𝕜] E) : (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D₁ * D₁ + ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D₂ * D₂ + ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D₃ * D₃).ker = D₁.ker ⊓ D₂.ker ⊓ D₃.ker := by
doc: /-- A forma com tres operadores, literal: ker (D₁†D₁ + D₂†D₂ + D₃†D₃) = ker D₁ ⊓ ker D₂ ⊓ ker D₃. -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.isSelfAdjoint_penalty
head: theorem isSelfAdjoint_penalty {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (D : ι → E →L[𝕜] E) : IsSelfAdjoint (penalty D) := by unfold penalty refine isSelfAdjoint_sum _ fun j _ => ?_
doc: /-- A penalidade e auto-adjunta. -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.selector_nonpos
head: theorem selector_nonpos {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (D : ι → E →L[𝕜] E) (x : E) : RCLike.re ⟪x, (-penalty D) x⟫_𝕜 ≤ 0 := by rw [ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, inner_neg_right, map_neg, re_inner_penalty, neg_nonpos] exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _
doc: /-- A seletora apofatica A_C = −H e nao-positiva: Re⟪x, A_C x⟫ ≤ 0. -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.H_mul_proj
head: theorem H_mul_proj (H : E →L[𝕜] E) [H.ker.HasOrthogonalProjection] : H * H.ker.starProjection = 0 := by ext x rw [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.proj_mul_H
head: theorem proj_mul_H (H : E →L[𝕜] E) (hH : IsSelfAdjoint H) [H.ker.HasOrthogonalProjection] : H.ker.starProjection * H = 0 := by ext x

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.mul_exp_eq_of_mul_eq_zero
head: theorem mul_exp_eq_of_mul_eq_zero (𝕂 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕂] [NormedAlgebra 𝕂 𝔸] (P A : 𝔸) (h : P * A = 0) : P * NormedSpace.exp A = P := by have hs := (NormedSpace.exp_series_hasSum_exp' (𝕂 := 𝕂) A).mul_left P have h1 : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => P * ((n !⁻¹ : 𝕂) • A ^ n)) P := by
doc: /-- Algebra pura: se P A = 0 entao P · exp A = P (pela serie). -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.exp_mul_eq_of_mul_eq_zero
head: theorem exp_mul_eq_of_mul_eq_zero (𝕂 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕂] [NormedAlgebra 𝕂 𝔸] (P A : 𝔸) (h : A * P = 0) : NormedSpace.exp A * P = P := by have hs := (NormedSpace.exp_series_hasSum_exp' (𝕂 := 𝕂) A).mul_right P have h1 : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => ((n !⁻¹ : 𝕂) • A ^ n) * P) P := by
doc: /-- Simetrica: se A P = 0 entao exp A · P = P. -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.flow
head: noncomputable def flow (H : E →L[𝕜] E) (u : 𝕜) : E →L[𝕜] E := NormedSpace.exp ((-u) • H)  /-- O semigrupo real: T_s = exp(−s H), s ∈ ℝ lido em 𝕜. -/ noncomputable def T (H : E →L[𝕜] E) (s : ℝ) : E →L[𝕜] E := flow H (s : 𝕜)
doc: /-- O fluxo da seletora, com parametro em 𝕜: flow H u = exp(−u H). -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.T
head: noncomputable def T (H : E →L[𝕜] E) (s : ℝ) : E →L[𝕜] E := flow H (s : 𝕜)  variable (H : E →L[𝕜] E) (hH : IsSelfAdjoint H) [H.ker.HasOrthogonalProjection]
doc: /-- O semigrupo real: T_s = exp(−s H), s ∈ ℝ lido em 𝕜. -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.reading
head: noncomputable abbrev reading : E →L[𝕜] E := H.ker.starProjection  include hH in theorem proj_mul_flow (u : 𝕜) : reading H * flow H u = reading H := by
doc: /-- A leitura: I(x) = P x. -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.proj_mul_flow
head: theorem proj_mul_flow (u : 𝕜) : reading H * flow H u = reading H := by refine mul_exp_eq_of_mul_eq_zero 𝕜 _ _ ?_ rw [mul_smul_comm, proj_mul_H H hH, smul_zero]

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.flow_mul_proj
head: theorem flow_mul_proj (u : 𝕜) : flow H u * reading H = reading H := by refine exp_mul_eq_of_mul_eq_zero 𝕜 _ _ ?_ rw [smul_mul_assoc, H_mul_proj H, smul_zero]

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.proj_mul_T
head: theorem proj_mul_T (s : ℝ) : reading H * T H s = reading H := proj_mul_flow H hH _  include hH in /-- A conservacao da leitura: I(T_s x) = I(x). -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.reading_T
head: theorem reading_T (s : ℝ) (x : E) : reading H (T H s x) = reading H x := by rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply, proj_mul_T H hH]  /-- O setor da familia fica parado: z ∈ F ⟹ T_s z = z. -/
doc: /-- A conservacao da leitura: I(T_s x) = I(x). -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.T_fix_of_mem_ker
head: theorem T_fix_of_mem_ker (s : ℝ) {z : E} (hz : z ∈ H.ker) : T H s z = z := by have hPz : reading H z = z := Submodule.starProjection_eq_self_iff.2 hz have := congrArg (fun A : E →L[𝕜] E => A z) (flow_mul_proj H (s : 𝕜)) simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply, hPz] at this
doc: /-- O setor da familia fica parado: z ∈ F ⟹ T_s z = z. -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.T_decomp
head: theorem T_decomp (s : ℝ) (x : E) : T H s x = reading H x + T H s (x - reading H x) := by have hP : T H s (reading H x) = reading H x := T_fix_of_mem_ker H s (H.ker.starProjection_apply_mem x)
doc: /-- A decomposicao T_s x = P x + T_s (x − P x): a componente da familia permanece. -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.verdict
head: noncomputable def verdict {X Y : Type*} (I : X → Y) (r y : X) : ℤ := if I y = I r then 1 else 0  variable {𝕜 E : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [CompleteSpace E]
doc: /-- V_r(y) = 1 se I(y) = I(r), 0 caso contrario (o criterio da secao 1 do texto). -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.verdict_T
head: theorem verdict_T (H : E →L[𝕜] E) (hH : IsSelfAdjoint H) [H.ker.HasOrthogonalProjection] (s : ℝ) (x : E) : verdict (fun y => reading H y) x (T H s x) = 1 := by simp [verdict, reading_T H hH s x]
doc: /-- V_x(T_s x) = 1: a transformacao efetiva e verificada pela leitura da familia. -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.verdict_eq_one_iff
head: theorem verdict_eq_one_iff {X Y : Type*} (I : X → Y) (r y : X) : verdict I r y = 1 ↔ I y = I r := by unfold verdict; split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]
doc: /-- O veredito binario e o bit da verdade: verdict ∈ {0,1} e vale 1 sse as leituras coincidem. -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.name_verifies_T
head: theorem name_verifies_T (H : E →L[𝕜] E) (hH : IsSelfAdjoint H) [H.ker.HasOrthogonalProjection] (s : ℝ) : (⟨fun x => reading H x⟩ : TGLExt.NameInstrument E E).Verifies (fun x => T H s x) := fun x => reading_T H hH s x
doc: /-- Ponte com a folha v336 da arvore (`TGLExt.NameInstrument.Verifies`, read (f x) = read x): a leitura P e um Nome que VERIFICA cada T_s, e (pela folha) toda iterada de T_s. -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.name_verifies_T_iterate
head: theorem name_verifies_T_iterate (H : E →L[𝕜] E) (hH : IsSelfAdjoint H) [H.ker.HasOrthogonalProjection] (s : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : (⟨fun x => reading H x⟩ : TGLExt.NameInstrument E E).Verifies ((fun x => T H s x)^[n]) := TGLExt.name_verifies_iterate _ (name_verifies_T H hH s) n

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.mem_range_iff_fixed
head: theorem mem_range_iff_fixed (P : M →ₗ[R] M) (hP : IsIdempotentElem P) (z : M) : z ∈ LinearMap.range P ↔ P z = z := by constructor · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.pow_eq_self
head: theorem pow_eq_self (P : M →ₗ[R] M) (hP : IsIdempotentElem P) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : P ^ n = P := hP.pow_eq hn  theorem apply_eq_apply_iff (P : M →ₗ[R] M) (x y : M) :

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.apply_eq_apply_iff
head: theorem apply_eq_apply_iff (P : M →ₗ[R] M) (x y : M) : P x = P y ↔ x - y ∈ LinearMap.ker P := by rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, map_sub, sub_eq_zero]

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.starProjection_range_iff_fixed
head: theorem starProjection_range_iff_fixed {𝕜 E : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] (K : Submodule 𝕜 E) [K.HasOrthogonalProjection] (z : E) : z ∈ LinearMap.range (K.starProjection : E →ₗ[𝕜] E) ↔ K.starProjection z = z := by
doc: /-- Instanciado na leitura: Im P = Fix P para a projecao ortogonal. -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.FlowTendsToFamily
head: def FlowTendsToFamily {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (Tf : ℝ → X → X) (P : X → X) : Prop := ∀ x, Tendsto (fun s => Tf s x) atTop (𝓝 (P x))  /-- Abstrata: com P ∘ T_s = P (s ≥ 0) e o limite nomeado, uma leitura continua e conservada
doc: /-- Hipotese NOMEADA: o semigrupo converge (ponto a ponto) para a projecao da familia. -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.conserved_iff_factors
head: theorem conserved_iff_factors {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y] (Tf : ℝ → X → X) (P : X → X) (hPT : ∀ s, 0 ≤ s → ∀ x, P (Tf s x) = P x) (hlim : FlowTendsToFamily Tf P) (l : X → Y) (hl : Continuous l) : (∀ s, 0 ≤ s → ∀ x, l (Tf s x) = l x) ↔ ∀ x, l x = l (P x) := by
doc: /-- Abstrata: com P ∘ T_s = P (s ≥ 0) e o limite nomeado, uma leitura continua e conservada ao longo do semigrupo sse fatora pela familia: l = l ∘ P. -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.conserved_iff_factors_T
head: theorem conserved_iff_factors_T (H : E →L[𝕜] E) (hH : IsSelfAdjoint H) [H.ker.HasOrthogonalProjection] (hlim : FlowTendsToFamily (fun s x => T H s x) (fun x => reading H x)) {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y] (l : E → Y) (hl : Continuous l) :
doc: /-- Instanciada no semigrupo da seletora. -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.hasDerivAt_reading_flow
head: theorem hasDerivAt_reading_flow (x : E) (u : 𝕜) : HasDerivAt (fun v : 𝕜 => reading H (flow H v x)) 0 u := by have : (fun v : 𝕜 => reading H (flow H v x)) = fun _ => reading H x := by funext v
doc: /-- d/du P(flow u x) = 0 (parametro em 𝕜; para 𝕜 = ℝ e literalmente d/ds). -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.hasDerivAt_reading_T
head: theorem hasDerivAt_reading_T [NormedSpace ℝ E] (x : E) (s : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => reading H (T H r x)) 0 s := by have : (fun r : ℝ => reading H (T H r x)) = fun _ => reading H x := funext fun r => reading_T H hH r x
doc: /-- A forma literal em s ∈ ℝ: d/ds P(T_s x) = 0 (qualquer estrutura real em E serve: a funcao e constante por `reading_T`). -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.hasDerivAt_flow
head: theorem hasDerivAt_flow (u : 𝕜) : HasDerivAt (fun v : 𝕜 => flow H v) ((-H) * flow H u) u := by have h := hasDerivAt_exp_smul_const' (𝕂 := 𝕜) (-H) u have e : ∀ v : 𝕜, (-v) • H = v • (-H) := fun v => by rw [neg_smul, smul_neg]
doc: /-- A dinamica inteira: d/du flow u = (−H) · flow u. -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.hasDerivAt_flow_apply
head: theorem hasDerivAt_flow_apply (x : E) (u : 𝕜) : HasDerivAt (fun v : 𝕜 => flow H v x) (-(H (flow H u x))) u := by have h := (hasDerivAt_flow H u).clm_apply (hasDerivAt_const u x) simpa using h
doc: /-- Aplicada a x: d/du flow u x = −H (flow u x). -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.flow_derivative_ne_zero_at_zero
head: theorem flow_derivative_ne_zero_at_zero (x : E) (hx : x ∉ H.ker) : HasDerivAt (fun v : 𝕜 => flow H v x) (-(H x)) 0 ∧ -(H x) ≠ 0 := by refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩ · have h := hasDerivAt_flow_apply H x 0
doc: /-- Dinamica nao nula: fora da familia, a derivada em u = 0 e −H x ≠ 0, enquanto a derivada da leitura e 0. -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.exp_apply_of_eigen
head: theorem exp_apply_of_eigen (A : E →L[𝕜] E) (μ : 𝕜) (v : E) (hv : A v = μ • v) : NormedSpace.exp A v = NormedSpace.exp μ • v := by have hpow : ∀ n : ℕ, (A ^ n) v = μ ^ n • v := by intro n
doc: /-- exp age num autovetor como a exponencial escalar do autovalor. -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.T_apply_eigen
head: theorem T_apply_eigen (H : E →L[𝕜] E) (ev : ℝ) (v : E) (hv : H v = (ev : 𝕜) • v) (s : ℝ) : T H s v = ((Real.exp (-(s * ev)) : ℝ) : 𝕜) • v := by have hA : ((-(s : 𝕜)) • H) v = ((-(s : 𝕜)) * (ev : 𝕜)) • v := by rw [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, hv, smul_smul]
doc: /-- No autovetor de autovalor real ev: T_s v = e^{−s·ev} v. -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.flowTendsToFamily_of_finiteDimensional
head: theorem flowTendsToFamily_of_finiteDimensional (H : E →L[𝕜] E) (hH : IsSelfAdjoint H) (hpos : ∀ x, 0 ≤ RCLike.re ⟪x, H x⟫_𝕜) : FlowTendsToFamily (fun s x => T H s x) (fun x => reading H x) := by intro x
doc: /-- ★ O limite espectral: para H auto-adjunto com forma nao-negativa, em dimensao finita, T_s x → P x quando s → ∞ (os modos zero ficam; os demais decaem como e^{−s·ev}). -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.conserved_iff_factors_penalty
head: theorem conserved_iff_factors_penalty {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (D : ι → E →L[𝕜] E) {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y] (l : E → Y) (hl : Continuous l) : (∀ s, 0 ≤ s → ∀ x, l (T (penalty D) s x) = l x) ↔ ∀ x, l x = l (reading (penalty D) x) := by
doc: /-- ★ A reciproca INCONDICIONAL em dimensao finita, para a penalidade dos vinculos: uma leitura continua e conservada ao longo de T_s = exp(−s H_3L) sse l = l ∘ P. -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.profA
head: noncomputable def profA (χ : ℝ) : ℝ := (cosh (χ / 2))⁻¹ noncomputable def profQ (χ : ℝ) : ℝ := tanh (χ / 2)  theorem hasDerivAt_profA (χ : ℝ) :

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.profQ
head: noncomputable def profQ (χ : ℝ) : ℝ := tanh (χ / 2)  theorem hasDerivAt_profA (χ : ℝ) : HasDerivAt profA (-(1 / 2) * profA χ * profQ χ) χ := by

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.hasDerivAt_profA
head: theorem hasDerivAt_profA (χ : ℝ) : HasDerivAt profA (-(1 / 2) * profA χ * profQ χ) χ := by have hc : HasDerivAt (fun y => cosh (y / 2)) (sinh (χ / 2) * (1 / 2)) χ := ((hasDerivAt_id' χ).div_const 2).cosh

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.hasDerivAt_profQ
head: theorem hasDerivAt_profQ (χ : ℝ) : HasDerivAt profQ ((1 / 2) * profA χ ^ 2) χ := by have hc : HasDerivAt (fun y => cosh (y / 2)) (sinh (χ / 2) * (1 / 2)) χ := ((hasDerivAt_id' χ).div_const 2).cosh

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.profA_zero
head: theorem profA_zero : profA 0 = 1 := by simp [profA] theorem profQ_zero : profQ 0 = 0 := by simp [profQ]  /-- a'(0) = 0. -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.profQ_zero
head: theorem profQ_zero : profQ 0 = 0 := by simp [profQ]  /-- a'(0) = 0. -/ theorem profA_deriv_zero : deriv profA 0 = 0 := by

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.profA_deriv_zero
head: theorem profA_deriv_zero : deriv profA 0 = 0 := by rw [(hasDerivAt_profA 0).deriv, profQ_zero, mul_zero]  /-- q'(0) = 1/2. -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.profQ_deriv_zero
head: theorem profQ_deriv_zero : deriv profQ 0 = 1 / 2 := by rw [(hasDerivAt_profQ 0).deriv, profA_zero]; norm_num  /-- a''(0) = −1/4. -/

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.profA_second_deriv_zero
head: theorem profA_second_deriv_zero : deriv (deriv profA) 0 = -(1 / 4) := by have hd : deriv profA = fun χ => -(1 / 2) * profA χ * profQ χ := by funext χ; exact (hasDerivAt_profA χ).deriv rw [hd]

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.reading_zero_of_kernel_bot
head: theorem reading_zero_of_kernel_bot (H : E →L[𝕜] E) [H.ker.HasOrthogonalProjection] (hk : H.ker = ⊥) : reading H = 0 := by unfold reading simp [hk]

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.verdict_one_of_kernel_bot
head: theorem verdict_one_of_kernel_bot (H : E →L[𝕜] E) [H.ker.HasOrthogonalProjection] (hk : H.ker = ⊥) (x y : E) : verdict (reading H) x y = 1 := by simp [verdict, reading_zero_of_kernel_bot H hk]

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.operator_zero_of_kernel_top
head: theorem operator_zero_of_kernel_top (H : E →L[𝕜] E) (hk : H.ker = ⊤) : H = 0 := by ext x have hx : x ∈ H.ker := by rw [hk]; trivial

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.flow_identity_of_kernel_top
head: theorem flow_identity_of_kernel_top (H : E →L[𝕜] E) (hk : H.ker = ⊤) (s : ℝ) : T H s = 1 := by rw [operator_zero_of_kernel_top H hk] simp [T, flow]

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.T_add
head: theorem T_add (H : E →L[𝕜] E) (s t : ℝ) : T H (s+t) = T H s * T H t := by unfold T flow have he : (-((s+t : ℝ) : 𝕜)) • H = (-(s : 𝕜)) • H + (-(t : 𝕜)) • H := by push_cast

name: ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.iterate_T_eq_nat_time
